v.t: adv. 否则, 不同地, 别的方式
v.s: Go at once, otherwise you will be late.
v.sz: 立刻走，否则你会迟到。
sx: This process must be stopped immediately, otherwise the server will break down.
这个进程必须立即停止，否则服务器会故障。
I'll expect you tomorrow unless you let me know otherwise.
你不改口的话，我明天就来等你了。

v.t: n. 最主要者, 原色 / a. 主要的, 初期的, 根本的, 原始的, 首要的, 基本的
v.s: My mother used to pick me up every day when I was at primary school.
v.sz: 我读小学的时候，我母亲每天来接我。
sx: This problem is too difficult for primary school children to solve.
这个问题让小学生解决太难了。
My primary concern is your safety.
我最关心的是你的安全。

v.t: n. 目的, 意向, 决心, 用途, 效果, 论题 / vt. 意欲, 企图, 计划
v.s: The purpose of criticism is to construct, not to destroy.
v.sz: 批评的目的是建设而不是破坏。
sx: What is the ultimate purpose of education?
教育的最终目的到底是什么?
The purpose of this interview is to assess whether or not you are suitable for the company.
这次面试的意义是评断你适不适合这家公司。

v.t: a. 有责任的, 负责的, 责任重大的
v.s: To solve a problem, you must find the one responsible for it.
v.sz: 解铃还须系铃人。
sx: We are responsible for your protection from now on.
从此起我们为您的安全负责。
A drunk driver was responsible for the car accident.
喝醉的驾驶员对车祸有责任。

v.t: n. 商店, 工厂, 车间 / vi. 购物, 到处寻找 / vt. 选购
v.s: This book is available at one shop only.
v.sz: 只有一家商店卖这本书。
sx: I had a cup of coffee at the coffee shop.
我在咖啡店里喝了一杯咖啡。
There is a good shop in front of the station.
车站前有一家不错的商店。

v.t: n. 病人 / a. 不舒服, 有病的, 恶心的, 厌恶的, 渴望的, 病态的 / vt. 呕吐, 追击, 使(狗)去攻击
v.s: Because my mother is sick, my father will cook today.
v.sz: 母亲病了，所以今天由父亲下厨。
sx: You should take care of your sick mother.
你应该照顾你生病的母亲。
Take this medicine in case you get sick.
万一你生病了，吃这个药。

v.t: n. 教师, 老师, 导师
v.s: In a crisis, you must get in touch with your teacher.
v.sz: 在危险的时候你必须跟你的老师联系。
sx: Experience is the best teacher.
经验是最好的老师。
You must have been surprised to meet your teacher in such a place.
在那种地方碰到你的老师，你应该很惊讶吧。

v.t: n. 理论, 学说, 原理, 意见, 推测
v.s: Theory and practice should go hand in hand.
v.sz: 理论得联系实际。
sx: Your theory has no scientific basis.
你的理论并没有科学根据。
He put forward a new theory.
他提出了一种新理论。

v.t: n. 代理机构, 经销商, 中介
v.s: I work in a travel agency.
v.sz: 我在旅行社工作.
sx: We'll need a head hunting agency to find the right man for this executive position.
我们需要人力仲介公司帮我们找到合适的人来担任这个管理职位。
The basic job of an advertising agency is to figure out how to turn a desire into a need.
广告商最基本的工作就是把人的欲望转化成需要。

v.t: vt. 避免, 防止, 撤消
v.s: Why do you always avoid that topic?
v.sz: 你为什么总是逃避这个话题？
sx: In order to avoid misunderstandings, they went through the contract again.
为了避免误解，他们又过了一遍合同。
Noise pollution could be avoided if only people were more sensitive to the environment.
如果大家都懂得关心环境的话，就不会有噪音污染了。

v.t: n. 照相机, 摄影机, 密谈室, 暗箱
v.s: Your camera is only half the size of mine.
v.sz: 你的照相机只有我那台的一半大小。
sx: My camera can shoot high-definition video.
我的录像机可以拍高清视频。
I take my camera wherever I go.
我无论去甚么地方也带著相机。

v.t: n. 捕捉, 陷阱, 捕捉之物, 抓, 拉手 / vt. 捕捉, 赶上, 感染, 听清楚 / vi. 抓住, 燃着
v.s: You have to study hard to catch up with your class.
v.sz: 你必须用功读书赶上同学。
sx: You will not be able to catch the train.
你将无法赶上火车。
If you hurry, you will catch up with him.
如果你快一点，还能赶上他。

v.t: n. 单元, 细胞, 电池
v.s: Recently T Mall has had a sales promotion on cell phones.
v.sz: 最近天猫上有手机促销活动。
sx: Can you give me your cell number?
你能告诉我你的手机号吗？
I need to charge my cell phone.
我需要给手机充电。

v.t: n. 海岸, 滑坡 / v. 沿海岸而行
v.s: His cottage is on the coast.
v.sz: 他的村屋在海岸上。
sx: The students were for the most part from the West Coast.
大部分的学生来自西海岸。
More than a third of the world population lives near a coast.
全世界有超过三分之一的人在沿岸地区居住。

v.t: n. 药, 麻药, 麻醉药 / vi. 吸毒 / vt. 使服麻醉药, 使麻木
v.s: Do you have a drug problem?
v.sz: 你是不是吸毒吸傻了？
sx: When it comes to drugs, there's a very fine line between use and abuse.
用药和滥药只差一线。
Tom has a long history of drug abuse.
汤姆有长期滥用药物的历史。

v.t: n. 经济, 理财, 节约
v.s: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
v.sz: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。
sx: A stable economy is the aim of every government.
经济繁荣稳定，是每个政府都想达到的目标。
We must strengthen our economy.
我们必须加强经济实力。

v.t: n. 环境, 外界, 围绕
v.s: They live in a good environment.
v.sz: 他们的生活环境很好。
sx: The effects of the atmosphere and ocean on the environment are very important.
大气与海洋对于地球环境的影响十分重大。
An increase in the number of cars will affect the urban environment.
车辆增多会影响到城市的环境。

v.t: n. 执行部门, 执行委员会, 执行者, 经理主管人员 / a. 执行的, 善于执行的, 善于经营的
v.s: One must be an executive in some company.
v.sz: 我们在任何公司都应该是执行者。
sx: I trust his executive ability.
我相信他的执行能力。
We'll need a head hunting agency to find the right man for this executive position.
我们需要人力仲介公司帮我们找到合适的人来担任这个管理职位。

v.t: n. 脚, 步调, 英尺, 底部, 末尾, 步兵 / vt. 走在...上, 给...换底, 支付 / vi. 跳舞, 步行, 总计
v.s: How did you get this injury on your foot?
v.sz: 脚上的伤是怎么回事？
sx: There is an old castle at the foot of the mountain.
山脚下有一座古老的城堡。
How long does it take from here to your house on foot?
从这里步行到你家要多长时间？

v.t: n. 门厅, 走廊, 会堂
v.s: There is a crowd of people in front of the town hall.
v.sz: 市政大厅前有一群人。
sx: Can we speak in the hall?
我们能在走廊里说话吗？
The teacher assembled the students in the hall.
老师在礼堂把学生们集合起来。

v.t: n. 块, 大多数, 质量, 大量, 群众, 弥撒 / a. 群众的, 大规模的, 整个的 / vt. 使集合, 集中 / vi. 聚集
v.s: There is a mass of dark clouds in the sky.
v.sz: 空中有一大片乌云。
sx: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
大量生产降低许多商品的价格。
Nowadays it's not possible to protect oneself against weapons of mass destruction.
如今要保护自己不受大规模杀伤性武器的伤害是不可能的。

v.t: n. 意义, 含义, 目的, 意图 / a. 意味深长的
v.s: Get the meaning of a word from its context.
v.sz: 从前文后理来推断一个字的意思。
sx: The meaning of a word is determined by the context where it is used.
一个字的意思是由上文下理决定的。
Will you please explain the meaning of this sentence to me?
您能为我解释这句句子的意思吗？

v.t: n. 任务, 代表团, 使命, 传教团 / vt. 派遣, 向...传教
v.s: With their cooperation, the mission had been successfully finished.
v.sz: 在他们的默契合作下，任务完美地完成了。
sx: This is a dangerous mission.
这是个危险的任务。
He accomplished his mission.
他完成了他的使命。

v.t: n. 政治, 政治学, 政见, 政治活动
v.s: The youth of our land are not interested in politics.
v.sz: 我们国家的年轻人对政治普遍不感兴趣。
sx: Sometimes politics is really hard to avoid.
有时候，政治真的很难逃避。
He has no interest in politics.
他对政治没有兴趣。

v.t: n. 砰然声, 枪击, 含气饮料, 流行音乐, 通俗艺术 / a. 流行的, 热门的, 通俗的 / vt. 使发出爆裂声, 开枪打, 突然伸出 / vi. 发出爆裂声, 射击, 突然出现, 瞪大 / adv. 突然, 砰地
v.s: Young people all like pop music.
v.sz: 年轻人都喜欢流行乐。
sx: I like pop music.
我喜欢流行音乐。
I love K-Pop.
我喜欢韩国流行音乐。

v.t: n. 状态, 情形, 地位, 要人身份
v.s: I believe that a fine education can change one's social status.
v.sz: 我相信良好的教育能改变人的社会地位。
sx: Can you tell me about your marital status?
能告诉我你的婚姻状况吗？
Obviously, they are jealous of his wealth and status.
他们很明显在嫉妒他的财富和地位。

v.t: adv. 因此, 所以
v.s: I think, therefore I am.
v.sz: 我思故我在。
sx: Therefore, for the glorious God, you must accept each other, and accept Jesus Christ in the same way.
所以，为了荣耀上帝，你们要彼此接纳，就像基督接纳你们一样。

v.t: n. 审判, 试验, 艰苦, 麻烦事, 考验 / a. 审讯的, 试验性的
v.s: The truth finally came out at his trial.
v.sz: 在他的裁判下，真相终于大白。
sx: The subscription service is available for a fixed monthly fee with a one-month free trial.
此订阅服务的月费为固定金额，并提供免费试用一个月。
Customers who purchase a new device can enjoy additional trial period as a promotional offer.
购买新装置的用户可享有额外试用优惠。

v.t: adv. 真实地, 不假
v.s: No money, no job, no friends. He was truly at loose ends.
v.sz: 没钱，没工作，没朋友，他真是无所适从。
sx: Cleaning up the house is truly my most dreaded task.
打扫屋子真的是我最害怕的工作。
I truly do not understand the question.
我真的不懂这个问题。

v.t: n. 天气, 气象, 处境 / a. 迎风的 / vt. 使受风吹雨打, 侵蚀, 使风化, 经受住 / vi. 风化, 受侵蚀, 经受风雨
v.s: I would rather stay at home than go out in this hot weather.
v.sz: 在这种暑天里我宁愿呆在家也不出去。
sx: The weather has a great deal to do with our health.
天气和我们的健康有很大的关系。
A glass of cold water is very refreshing in hot weather.
一杯冷水在暑热的天气里十分提神。

v.t: n. 活动, 行动, 活跃, 活力
v.s: Every month at our company, they run a community activity.
v.sz: 在我们公司每月都会举办社团活动。
sx: Do you take part in any community activities?
你参加社团活动吗？
The town was full of activity.
小镇充满了活力。

v.t: n. 应用, 申请, 志愿书, 应用程序
v.s: The infrastructure of an application is directly related to its overall performance.
v.sz: 一个应用的架构直接关系到它的整体性能。
sx: Please fill in this application form.
请填好这张申请表。
You need to attach your photo to the application form.
你必须把你的照片贴在申请书上。

v.t: n. 咖啡, 咖啡色
v.s: This coffee is too hot for me to drink.
v.sz: 这咖啡热得我没办法喝。
sx: Ow, the coffee is very hot!
噢，咖啡太烫了。
The coffee enabled me to stay awake during the dull concert.
咖啡让我在沉闷的音乐会中保持清醒。

v.t: n. 综合体, 情结, 络合物 / a. 复杂的, 组合的
v.s: The situation was much more complex than he had thought.
v.sz: 事情可比他所想的要复杂得多。
sx: Grammar is a very complex thing.
语法是很复杂的。
This is a very complex problem.
这是一个非常复杂的问题。

v.t: n. 情况, 条件 / vt. 使健康, 以...为条件, 决定, 使适应
v.s: We will only consent on that condition.
v.sz: 我们只会在那样的条件下同意。
sx: Many people consider a high salary to be a condition for success.
不少人以高薪为成功的条件。
Traffic conditions on the highway are normal this morning.
今天早上高速公路上的交通状况正常。

v.t: n. 分, 分开, 除法, 部门(如部、处、系等), 师
v.s: All the top teams of the UK are in the premier division.
v.sz: 英国所有的顶尖球队都在超级联赛中。
sx: The children haven't studied division yet.
孩子们还没上过除法。

v.t: n. 傍晚, 晚间, 末期
v.s: We take great pleasure in meeting all of you this evening.
v.sz: 我们很高兴今晚能见到大家。
sx: I feed my cat every morning and every evening.
每天早晚，我给我的猫喂食。
The President is to speak on television this evening.
总统今晚将会在电视上发表演说。

v.t: n. 飞行, 射程, 逃走, 飞跃, 飞机航程, 班机, 迁徙, 飞逝 / vi. 迁徙 / vt. 射击(飞禽), 为(箭)装上羽毛, 使惊飞
v.s: I want to quickly confirm my flight again.
v.sz: 我想要再确认一下我的航班。
sx: A couple of flights were delayed on account of the earthquake.
一些航班由于地震被延误了。
Sorry, the flight is already full.
对不起，航班已经客满了。

v.t: n. 自由, 坦率, 特权
v.s: Individual freedom is the soul of democracy.
v.sz: 个人自由是民主的精髓。
sx: The best thing in the world is freedom of speech.
世上最好的事情，就是言论自由。
War is peace. Freedom is slavery. Ignorance is strength.
战争即和平，自由即奴役，无知即力量。

v.t: n. 热, 热度, 体温, 高潮 / vi. 加热, 激昂, 加剧 / vt. 把...加热, 使激动
v.s: Heat is a form of energy.
v.sz: 热是一种能量。
sx: My father does not like the heat of summer.
我爸爸不喜欢夏天炎热的天气。
How are you keeping off this intense heat?
你是怎么避开这酷暑的？

v.t: n. 面谈, 访问, 接见, 面试 / vt. 接见, 对...进行面谈(试)
v.s: The purpose of this interview is to assess whether or not you are suitable for the company.
v.sz: 这次面试的意义是评断你适不适合这家公司。
sx: Hi, I have an appointment with the general manager. This is my interview notice.
您好，我跟总经理有约十点见面，这是我的面试通知。
The interviewer introduces the topic of the interview.
采访者介绍了采访的主题。

v.t: n. 图书馆, 藏书, 库
v.s: Excuse me, do you know where the economics department library is?
v.sz: 不好意思，请问你知道经济学部图书馆在哪里吗？
sx: How far is it to the library from here?
图书馆离这里有多远？
I see him in the library now and then.
有时我会在图书馆看见他。

v.t: n. 位置, 场所, 特定区域
v.s: Give me your location.
v.sz: 给我你的位置。
sx: I suggest we move to a safer location.
我建议我们去个更安全的地方。
A bookstore in that location wouldn't make enough money to survive.
那个地点的书店无法赚足够的钱生存下去。

v.t: n. 谋杀 / vt. 谋杀, 损毁, 破坏 / vi. 犯杀人罪
v.s: The police are investigating the murder.
v.sz: 警方正在调查那起谋杀案。
sx: The court declared him innocent on the charge of murder.
法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。
The murder happened between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m.
凶杀案于凌晨三到五点间发生。

v.t: n. 王后, 女王 / vt. 立为女王 / vi. 做女王
v.s: The Queen has gone to a lot of trouble for the Duchess.
v.sz: 女王为公爵夫人费心做了很多。
sx: I have the queen of hearts.
我有红桃Q。
He bowed to the Queen.
他向女王鞠躬。

v.t: vt. 接受, 承认, 同意, 相信, 赞成, 承担, 承兑, 采纳, 接纳, 容忍 / vi. 同意
v.s: People can accept praise more easily than criticism.
v.sz: 赞扬比批评更容易让人接受。
sx: I do not know whether to accept or to refuse.
我不知道是否该同意或拒绝。
Will you accept this job?
你会接受这份工作吗？

v.t: a. 真实的, 实际的, 现行的
v.s: Many people are skeptical about the actual effects of traditional Chinese medicine.
v.sz: 很多人对中药的真实效果持怀疑态度。
sx: To date nobody knows the actual size of the cosmos.
宇宙的实际大小至今无人知道。
Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。

v.t: vi. 出现, 显得, 来到
v.s: Speak of the devil and he is sure to appear.
v.sz: 说曹操，曹操就到。
sx: The king will appear in person tomorrow evening.
国王明晚会亲自出现。
Why would you appear in my unit?
你为什么会出现在我工作单位？

v.t: n. 尝试, 企图 / vt. 尝试, 企图
v.s: They attempted to break through the enemy line.
v.sz: 他们试图冲破敌军防线。
sx: His attempt to escape was successful.
他尝试逃走而成功了。
He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
他试图游过河，但是失败了。

v.t: n. 海峡, 航道, 频道 / vt. 引导, 在...上挖沟, 形成河道
v.s: What is on Channel 10?
v.sz: 第十台在播甚么节目？
sx: He is the only American who has swum the English Channel.
他是游过英吉利海峡的唯一一个美国人。

v.t: n. 距离, 远方, 遥远
v.s: Even though the distance between us is great, we still communicate.
v.sz: 尽管距离很远，我们还是保持着通信联系。
sx: They heard a gun go off in the distance.
他们听到远处传来一下枪声。
I live within walking distance of school.
我学校离我家只是几步路的路程。

v.t: n. 交换, (电话)交换局, 交换机, 汇兑, 交易所 / v. 交换, 交易, 兑换
v.s: Could you please exchange some small change with me?
v.sz: 请你帮我换一点零钱行吗？
sx: What is the exchange rate today?
今天的汇率是多少？
I would like to exchange this watch for a cheaper one.
我想用这块手表换一块便宜一点的。

v.t: n. 脂肪, 脂油, 肥肉 / a. 肥的, 胖的, 油腻的 / n. 文件分配表
v.s: Between you and me, the fat ugly man is on a diet.
v.sz: 那个丑男人在节食，这个我们知道就好。
sx: I am not too rich, too fat or too happy.
我不太有钱、不太胖，也不太快乐。
This cat here is almost as fat as that one.
这里这只猫跟那里那只差不多一样灵敏。

v.t: n. 发现, 发现物, 决定, 裁决
v.s: He is constantly finding fault with other people.
v.sz: 他总是挑别人的毛病。
sx: We are finding it difficult to decide which one to buy.
我们发现很难决定买哪个。
I have no difficulty finding people who disagree with you.
我找跟您意见相左的人毫无困难。

v.t: n. 玻璃, 玻璃杯, 透镜 / vt. 装玻璃于, 反射, 反映 / vi. 成玻璃状
v.s: A glass of cold water is very refreshing in hot weather.
v.sz: 一杯冷水在暑热的天气里十分提神。
sx: May I have a glass of milk, please?
请问能给我一杯牛奶吗？
Would you care for another glass of beer?
再来一杯啤酒怎么样？

v.t: a. 移动的, 易变的, 机动的 / n. 活动物体
v.s: Most young people have a mobile phone.
v.sz: 年轻人几乎都有手机。
sx: Do you have a mobile?
您有手机吗？
He has no mobile.
他没有手机。

v.t: n. 北方人 / a. 北方的, 向北的, 自北方来的
v.s: The city is at the northern end of Japan.
v.sz: 城市位于日本的最北端。
sx: Japan is located in the Northern Hemisphere.
日本位于北半球。
Southern men, Northern women.
南男北女。

v.t: a. 有力的, 有权力的, 强大的
v.s: Love is more powerful than death.
v.sz: 爱情比死亡更强大。
sx: America has the world’s largest economy, and its army is the most powerful.
美国是世界最大的经济体并拥有最强的军队。
He has powerful arms.
他的手臂很有力。

v.t: a. 更重要的, 较早的, 在先的 / n. 小隐修院院长, 大隐修院副院长
n. 保护, 防卫, 贸易保护制度
v.s: Which is more important, economic development or environmental protection?
v.sz: 发展经济和保护环境哪一个更重要?
sx: You need protection.
你需要保护。
Condoms offer protection against STDs.
避孕套可以预防性传播疾病。

v.t: vt. 收到, 接到, 得到, 接待, 迎接, 承受 / vi. 收到, 会客
v.s: The more public the work, the more criticism you receive.
v.sz: 工作越公开，批评就越多。
sx: Anyone who can recover the money he lost will receive a reward.
凡能将他遗失的钱寻回者可得到酬金。
Please send me a reply as soon as you receive this mail.
收到此邮件后请尽快给我答复。

v.t: a. 宗教性的, 虔诚的, 宗教上的, 严谨的 / n. 修道士, 出家人
v.s: I'm a deeply religious man and believe in life after death.
v.sz: 我是一个虔诚的教徒，我相信死后的生命。
sx: He is not religious.
他不信教。
You can't really be Algerian and not religious.
只要是阿尔及利亚人，不信教是不可能的。

v.t: n. 骑马, 乘坐, 乘车, 搭便车 / vt. 骑, 乘坐, 压迫, 控制 / vi. 骑马, 乘车, 漂游
v.s: I usually ride my bike to school. I mean to the office.
v.sz: 我通常踏单车上学⋯⋯啊，说错了，应该是上班才对。
sx: Do you want me to give you a ride?
要不要我载你一程？
Can I ride this horse for a while?
可以让我骑一会儿这匹马吗？

v.t: n. 王室, 皇族 / a. 王室的, 皇家的, 盛大的, 庄严的
v.s: Kate has become a full member of the royal family.
v.sz: 凯萨琳已成为皇室的正式成员。
sx: Some believe that the British Royal Family is directly descended from the line of King David.
有些人相信英国皇室是大卫王的后裔。
Sue checked in at the Royal Hotel.
苏在皇家饭店登记投宿。

v.t: n. 幕, 银幕, 屏风, 掩蔽物, 屏蔽, 筛子 / vt. 掩蔽, 放映, 拍摄, 掩护, 筛, 甄别 / vi. 拍电影
v.s: Overall, the movie was a success from script to screen.
v.sz: 总的来说，这部电影从剧本到银幕是成功的。
sx: This computer has a sharp screen.
这台电脑的屏幕很清晰。
I prefer a phone with a large screen.
我更喜欢萤幕大的手机。

v.t: vt. 可作...用, 服务, 经历, 招待, 供应, 送交, 对待 / vi. 服务, 服役, 侍应, 适合, 有用, 开球 / n. 发球, 轮到发球
v.s: This hotel does not serve lunch.
v.sz: 这家旅馆不提供午餐。
sx: Have you ever served as a witness in a court case?
你曾是一宗司法案件的证人？
First come, first serve.
先到先得。

v.t: a. 慢的, 缓慢的, 迟缓的, 迟钝的, 冷漠的, 落后的 / adv. 慢地, 迟缓地 / v. (使)慢下来
v.s: Why is my internet access so slow?
v.sz: 我的网怎么会这么慢？
sx: He who is slow to anger has great understanding.
不轻易发怒的，大有聪明。
I am a slow reader.
我看书很慢的。

v.t: n. 种, 类, 外形
v.s: The giant panda is a surviving ancient animal species.
v.sz: 大熊猫是一种残存的古动物。
sx: It is an endangered species.
这是一个濒临灭绝的物种。
There are many endangered species.
有许多濒危物种。

v.t: n. 演讲, 说话, 谈话, 言语, 引语, 民族语言
v.s: His speech was short and to the point.
v.sz: 他的演讲简短且切中要害。
sx: The best thing in the world is freedom of speech.
世上最好的事情，就是言论自由。
His speech has had a positive effect on all of his coworkers.
他的讲话对所有同事产生了积极影响。

v.t: n. 交通, 通行, 运输, 交通量, 贸易, 交易, 交往, 通信量 / vi. 交易, 做买卖 / vt. 用...作交换
v.s: The driver does not have responsibility for the traffic accident.
v.sz: 司机不需要为这次的交通意外负责。
sx: You must be careful of the traffic when you cross the street.
你横穿马路要小心。
There is not much traffic on this road.
这条路上的车辆不多。

v.t: n. 树, 木料, 树状物 / vt. 把...赶上树
v.s: The tree was ready to fall at any moment.
v.sz: 那棵树随时会倒下来。
sx: The bicycle under the tree is mine.
那辆在树下的自行车是我的。
Apparently, they nest in a tree in front of the house.
很明显的，牠们在房前的树上筑巢。

v.t: pron. 谁
v.s: I have no friend with whom to talk about it.
v.sz: 我没有任何可以谈这件事的朋友。
sx: The people whom I meet are kind.
我遇到的人都很仁慈。
To whom did you give the book?
你把书给谁了？

v.t: a. 令人惊奇的, 奇妙的, 极好的
v.s: It would be wonderful if you could sing at our wedding.
v.sz: 你能在我们的婚礼上唱歌就太好了。
sx: We live in a wonderful period.
我们生活在一个精彩的时代。
Language is wonderful.
语言很奇妙。

v.t: n. 飞机场
v.s: I have to go to the airport to meet my family.
v.sz: 我要去机场迎接我的家人。
sx: Please tell me how to get to the airport.
请你告诉我机场怎么去。
Can I pick my ticket up at the airport?
我能在机场领取机票吗？

v.t: v. 开始
v.s: If you want security in your old age, begin saving now.
v.sz: 如果你想安享晚年，现在就要开始储蓄了。
sx: If we begin early, we can finish by lunch.
如果我们早点开始的话，就能在午饭时间之前完成。
Since you are here, we might as well begin.
既然你在这里, 那我们就开始吧。

v.t: n. 底部 / a. 底部的 / vt. 给...装底, 查明真相 / vi. 到达底部, 建立基础
v.s: Truth is difficult to find at the bottom of a well.
v.sz: 在井底很难找到真理。
sx: There is sand at the bottom of the ocean.
海洋底部有沙子。
I thank you from the bottom of my heart.
我打心底里感激你。

v.t: n. 要求, 需求, 需要 / v. 要求, 查询
v.s: I am sorry, we are unable to satisfy your demand.
v.sz: 对不起，我们无法满足您的要求。
sx: There is close relationship between supply and demand.
供应和需求之间的关系十分密切。
I demand an explanation for this mistake.
我要求说明这个错误。

v.t: n. 引擎, 发动机, 机车 / vt. 安装发动机于
v.s: When was the last time you cut the engine?
v.sz: 你最后一次关掉引擎是什么时候？
sx: More than 90 percent of visits to a web page are from search engines.
一个网页超过百分之九十的访问量是来自于搜索引擎的。
Something is wrong with the engine.
引擎不知哪里发生了故障。

v.t: pron. 每个人, 人人
v.s: I think everybody should learn another language.
v.sz: 我认为大家都应该学另外一种语言。
sx: She is not only beautiful but also kind to everybody.
她不仅漂亮，而且对每个人都很好。
Everybody talks about the weather, but nobody does anything about it.
每个人都在谈论天气, 但是没有人为它做任何事情。

v.t: a. 出名的, 极好的
v.s: I have a friend whose father is a famous writer.
v.sz: 我有个朋友的父亲是知名的作家。
sx: He is a famous baseball player.
他是一位著名的棒球选手。
She is a famous singer.
她是一个著名的歌手。

v.t: n. 投资
v.s: In our opinion, solar panels are a good investment.
v.sz: 在我们看来，太阳能电池是一项很好的投资。
sx: Tom doubled his investment in a year.
汤姆一年内增加了一倍的投资。
Algeria should become China's main investment hot spot in the Mediterranean region.
阿尔及利亚应该成为中国在地中海地区的主要投资热点。

v.t: n. 谎言, 假象, 位置 / vi. 躺着, 说谎, 位于, 展现, 存在, 停泊 / vt. 谎骗
v.s: People who will lie for you, will lie to you.
v.sz: 会为你说谎的人，就会对你说谎。
sx: You look pale. You had better lie down in bed at once.
你的脸色这么差，还是赶快去睡觉吧。
If he could lie about that, he is likely to lie about anything.
如果他在那件事上说谎，他就可能在任何事上都说谎。

v.t: n. 合伙人, 股东, 伙伴, 伴侣 / vt. 与...合伙, 组成一对 / vi. 做伙伴, 当助手
v.s: Mr. Goat Butt never told me there would be a partner.
v.sz: 羊屁股先生可没告诉我还有搭档。
sx: The teacher and her partner took the people attending the wedding to a park.
老师和她爱人带着参加婚礼的人来到一个公园。
I don't have a partner.
我没有伙伴。

v.t: a. 忧愁的, 悲哀的
v.s: If one day you leave, I will be very sad.
v.sz: 如果有一天你走了，我会很难过的。
sx: When we are very sad, we will cry.
我们非常难过的时候就会哭。
I feel sad every now and then.
我不时地觉得难过。

v.t: n. 解决, 解答, 溶液
v.s: I am certain that we will find a solution.
v.sz: 我确信我们会找到解决办法的。
sx: Please find a solution to the problem.
请找到问题的解决方法。
He thought of a good solution.
他想到了一个解决的好办法。

v.t: n. 南方人, 男风 / a. 向南方的, 来自南方的
v.s: Our restaurant is near the southern bus station.
v.sz: 我们的饭店在汽车南站的附近。
sx: I bought a house on a small hill in southern France in preparation of building a retirement home.
我在法国南边的一座小山买了一所房子，准备在那里建设老人院。
Southern men, Northern women.
南男北女。

v.t: n. 正方形, 街区, 广场, 平方, 直角尺 / a. 正方形的, 正直的, 公正的, 平方的, 方正的, 结清的 / adv. 成直角地, 对准地 / vi. 一致, 符合, 结清 / vt. 使成方形, 使平方自乘, 调正, 结清, 使一致
v.s: The area of the factory is 1,000 square meters.
v.sz: 工厂的面积是1000平方米。
sx: We learned at school that the square root of nine is three.
我们上课时学了九的根是三。
If you go to Beijing, definitely have a look at Tiananmen Square.
要是去北京的话，一定要看一下天安门广场。

v.t: n. 结构, 构造, 建筑物 / vt. 构成, 组织
v.s: The structure of the brain is complicated.
v.sz: 头脑的结构很复杂。
sx: This is the most massive structure I have ever seen.
这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。

v.t: a. 传统的, 惯例的
v.s: I cannot write traditional characters, but I am fine reading them.
v.sz: 我不会写繁体字，但我可以读。
sx: Mid-Autumn Day is a traditional holiday in China.
中秋节是中国的传统节日。
It was a very traditional ceremony.
那是一个十分传统的仪式。

v.t: adv. 两次, 两倍
v.s: The new tunnel is twice as long as the old one.
v.sz: 新建的隧道比以前的那一条长两倍。
sx: This tunnel is twice as long as that one.
这条隧道是那条的两倍长。
My room is twice as large as yours.
我的房间比你大一倍。

v.t: n. 风, 气息, 气味, 呼吸, 风声, 趋势, 空谈, 卷绕, 弯曲 / vt. 使通风, 嗅出, 使喘气, 吹号角, 上发条, 缠绕, 包, 绞起, 吊起, 使弯曲, 使迂回 / vi. 嗅出猎物, 吹响号角, 卷曲, 蜿蜒, 迂回, 缠绕
v.s: Without air there can be no wind or sound on the moon.
v.sz: 月球表面没有空气，所以没有风，也没有声音。
sx: There was no wind at all yesterday.
昨天一点风也没有。
The strong wind indicates that a storm is coming.
强风暗示著即将到来的暴雨。

v.t: n. 担心, 烦恼, 忧虑, 苦恼, 撕咬 / vt. 使烦恼, 使焦虑, 使苦恼, 困扰, 折磨, 撕咬 / vi. 烦恼, 担心, 撕咬
v.s: She was worried that she might be late for the train.
v.sz: 她担心她赶不上火车。
sx: You worry about your weight too much.
你太担心你的体重了。
How long have you had this worry?
你有这烦恼多久了？

v.t: n. 公共汽车
v.s: Hurry up, and you will be in time for the bus.
v.sz: 快点，你就能准时搭上公交车了。
sx: May I have a bus schedule?
我可以有张公车的时刻表吗？
The bus was behind schedule.
公交车迟到了。

v.t: n. 分
v.s: You gave me only fifty cents.
v.sz: 你只给了我五十美分。

v.t: vt. 计算, 视为 / vi. 计数 / n. 计算, 合计, 计数, 伯爵
v.s: Those who count their blessings experience more joy.
v.sz: 知足者常乐。
sx: You can count on her.
你可以相信她。
Count me in.
算我一个.

v.t: a. 批评的, 决定性的, 危险的, 临界的
v.s: Your mother is in critical condition.
v.sz: 你母亲现在情况危殆。
sx: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.
我不明白为什么你这么批评他。
Now is the critical moment. Please stop being so stubborn and inflexible, completely unable to adapt flexibility.
现在正是关键的时候了，请不要还那么死脑筋，丝毫不知权变。

v.t: a. 新鲜的, 新奇的, 另外的, 淡的, 精神饱满的, 冒失的 / adv. 最新地, 刚刚 / n. 开始, 泛滥
v.s: He is fresh from college, so he has no experience.
v.sz: 他刚刚大学毕业，所以没什么经验。
sx: A little fresh air will do me good.
呼吸点新鲜空气会让我好些。
A little fresh air does the body good.
一点新鲜空气对身体有好处。

v.t: n. 湖, 池, 色淀 / v. (使)血球溶解
v.s: The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.
v.sz: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。
sx: There are many lakes in the area where you live.
在你生活的地方有许多湖泊。
The old church by the lake is very beautiful.
河边的老教堂很漂亮。

v.t: a. 心智的, 精神病的, 心理的, 颏的 / n. 精神病患者
v.s: Mental health is as important as physical health.
v.sz: 精神的健康和身体的健康一样重要。
sx: His trouble was chiefly mental.
他主要是心理的问题。

v.t: adv. 大概, 大部分, 主要
v.s: I mostly have fruit for breakfast.
v.sz: 我早饭主要吃水果。

v.t: n. 嘴, 口, 口腔, 口状物 / vi. 装腔作势说话, 做鬼脸 / vt. 说出, 做作地说
v.s: It is rude to talk when your mouth is full.
v.sz: 边吃东西边谈话是非常没有礼貌的。
sx: You must not speak with your mouth full.
嘴里有东西的时候不准说话。
Never look a gift horse in the mouth.
获人赠马，休看马口。

v.t: n. 拥有者, 物主, 所有人
v.s: Who is the owner of this house?
v.sz: 谁是这间房子的主人？
sx: Who does the car belong to when the owner dies?
主人死后车子归谁呢？
Assets have earning power or some other value to their owner.
资产对所有者来说，具有盈利能力或一些其他的价值。

v.t: adv. 先, 先前, 以前, 前, (非正式)过早, 过急, 在前, 在...以前, 在先
v.s: Previously people believed the earth was flat.
v.sz: 以前的人以为地球是平的。

v.t: vt. 了解, 实现, 使显得逼真, 变卖 / vi. 变卖
v.s: Some day you will come to realize the importance of saving.
v.sz: 你现在不好好储蓄金钱的话，终有一天会后悔的。
sx: The day will come when you will realize it.
有一天你会意识到它。
Do you realize what this means?
你明白这是什么意思了吗？

v.t: vi. 保持, 逗留, 剩余
v.s: The cause of his death still remains a mystery.
v.sz: 他的死因仍然是一个谜。
sx: I thought it best to remain silent.
我想最好还是保持沉默。
When only death remains, the last resort is to beg for food.
除死无大事，讨饭到了家。

v.t: n. 刻度, 衡量, 比例, 比例尺, 数值范围, 等级, 规模, 天平, 秤, 鳞, 积垢 / vt. 依比例决定, 攀登, 测量, 绘制, 刮鳞, 使生垢, 过秤 / vi. 剥落, 生水垢, 重量为, 攀登, 衡量
v.s: On a scale from 1 to 10, how have you been feeling?
v.sz: 从一到十分，你最近感觉如何？
sx: Please put your baggage on this scale.
请把你的行李放在这秤上。
I weighed myself on the bathroom scales.
我用浴室的体重计量了体重。

v.t: n. 得分, 抓痕, 二十个, 刻痕, 帐目, 乐谱, 起跑线, 终点线, 大量 / vt. 刻划, 划线, 获得, 评价, 把...记下 / vi. 刻痕, 记分, 得分
v.s: The game ended in a draw, and the final score was 2-2.
v.sz: 比赛以平局结束，最后比分是二比二。
sx: His scores are always better than mine, even though he doesn't study very much.
他的分数总比我高，尽管他学习得少一点。
He scored an own goal.
他踢了一个乌龙球。

v.t: n. 独立件, 抽印本 / a. 分开的, 各别的, 单独的, 分隔的 / vi. 分开, 隔开, 分居 / vt. 使分离, 使分开, 区分, 使分居
v.s: In our city, we carefully separate and collect garbage.
v.sz: 在我们的城市那，我们非常谨慎地分类收集垃圾。
sx: They are separated by a great distance.
他们之间隔着很远的距离。
You cannot separate the milk from the coffee once you put it in.
你一把它放进去，就不能把牛奶和咖啡分开了。

v.t: a. 聪明的, 漂亮的, 刺痛的, 剧烈的, 敏捷的, 巧妙的, 伶俐的, 潇洒的 / n. 刺痛, 痛苦 / vi. 刺痛
v.s: He is as smart as any other boy in the class.
v.sz: 他和班上其他男生一样聪明。
sx: You seem like a very smart person.
你看起来像一个聪明人。
You are smart. You must understand that.
你很聪明，你应该明白这个。

v.t: n. 面, 表面, 水面, 外表, 平面 / a. 表面的, 外观的, 肤浅的, 水面上的 / vt. 使成平面, 使浮出水面 / vi. 浮出水面, 呈现, 在地面上工作
v.s: Do you like to send it by air mail or by surface mail?
v.sz: 您寄航空还是海运？
sx: Your interpretation is based merely on the surface meaning.
你的理解有点望文生义了。
The surface of the object is fairly rough.
这件物件的表面颇为粗糙。

v.t: vt. 投, 掷, 抛, 发射, 摔下, 匆匆穿上(或脱下), 抛弃, 摆脱 / vi. 丢, 掷, 抛 / n. 投掷, 掷骰子, 冒险
v.s: Throw the ball back to me.
v.sz: 把球丢还给我。
sx: Throwing garbage on the street is not a good habit, remember?
在街上乱丢垃圾不是好习惯，记得吗？
My wife asked me to throw this old hat away.
老婆叫我把这顶旧帽子丢掉。

v.t: adv. 完全地
v.s: The truth is that nothing is totally true or false.
v.sz: 真相是没有甚么完全正确或错误。
sx: What you said is totally accurate.
你说的完全正确！
He is not totally wrong.
他并不完全是错的。

v.t: n. 婚礼, 结婚, 结婚周年纪念日, 结合
v.s: It would be wonderful if you could sing at our wedding.
v.sz: 你能在我们的婚礼上唱歌就太好了。
sx: Where is the wedding to be?
婚礼在哪儿举行？
The teacher and her partner took the people attending the wedding to a park.
老师和她爱人带着参加婚礼的人来到一个公园。

v.t: n. 利益 / vt. 有益于 / vi. 受益
v.s: Does doing things in this way have a benefit?
v.sz: 这么做有什么好处吗？
sx: In the end, I did manage to become friends with benefits with that girl.
最后我成功和那个女孩成为了炮友关系。
This event benefits no one.
这件事对谁都没有好处。

v.t: n. 预算 / vi. 编预算 / vt. 编入预算, 安排 / a. 廉价的
v.s: This is a low-budget movie.
v.sz: 这是一部低成本的电影。
sx: We are traveling on a tight budget.
我们很节省地旅行。
The calculation of the budget for next year is based on the costs this year.
明年预算的计算是基于今年的成本的。

v.t: n. 咔哒声, 啪嗒声 / vi. 作咔哒声 / vt. 使发咔哒声
v.s: Click the picture to go to the next page!
v.sz: 点击图片进入下一页!
sx: Did you hear the click?
你听到了点击声吗？
Don't click on that link.
不要点击那个链接。

v.t: n. 不动产, (人生的)阶段, 阶层, 财产
n. 信心, 信任, 忠实, 保证
v.s: He had lost all faith in his ability to succeed.
v.sz: 他完全丧失了能成功的信心。
sx: If you have no character to lose, people will have no faith in you.
如果你没有尝试过失败的角色，那么人们也就不会相信你。
My faith in the next generation is increasing.
我对我们的下一代愈来愈有信心了。

v.t: n. 流行, 风尚, 时样 / vt. 形成, 造, 作
v.s: This style of hat is now in fashion.
v.sz: 这种款式的帽子现在很流行。
sx: She was able to cook herself dinner, after a fashion.
她勉强能自己煮晚餐吃。
His clothes are out of fashion.
他的衣服过时了。

v.t: n. 面孔的一部分(如眼、口等), 特征, 容貌, 特色, 特写 / vt. 是...的特色, 特写, 放映 / vi. 起重要作用
v.s: The CAR-aoke feature in WHAT THE CAR? had me singing along with my car!
v.sz: 《WHAT THE CAR?》中的「CAR-aoke」功能让我能与汽车一起唱歌！
sx: Featuring new music by Rihanna and more.
收录蕾哈娜及更多艺人全新歌曲。
It's not a bug, it's an undocumented feature.
这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。

v.t: n. 基金, 资金, 存款, 财源, 贮藏 / vt. 提供资金, 积累
v.s: Lobbyists for the bill funneled bribes into a campaign fund.
v.sz: 该法案的说客把游说贿款汇入了竞选基金。
sx: He was arrested for abusing public funds.
他因滥用公共基金而被捕。

v.t: n. 一代, 一世, 产生
v.s: We should pass on our culture to the next generation.
v.sz: 我们应当把文化传承到下一代。
sx: My faith in the next generation is increasing.
我对我们的下一代愈来愈有信心了。
He's the leader of the next generation.
他是下一代人的领袖。

v.t: n. 听, 听觉, 听讯
v.s: My father is so old that he is hard of hearing.
v.sz: 我父亲很老了，耳朵也听不清楚了。
sx: My grandfather is a bit hard of hearing.
我爷爷的听力不太好。
I look forward to hearing from you.
我期待收到你的来信。

v.t: n. 小山, 丘陵, 小土堆 / vt. 作成土堆, 堆成小丘
v.s: There was a cottage on the side of the hill.
v.sz: 山坡上有一个茅屋。
sx: The building on the hill is our school.
山上的那栋建筑物就是我们的学校了。
There is a house on the hill.
山上有个房子。

v.t: n. 金属, 金属制品, 合金, 本质, 质料 / a. 金属制的 / vt. 以金属覆盖
v.s: The acid ate into the metal.
v.sz: 酸性腐蚀了金属。
sx: Iron is a metal.
铁是一种金属。
The value of a coin depends on the weight of the metal used.
钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。

v.t: n. 侧面, 轮廓, 传略 / vt. 描绘...轮廓, 写...的传略
v.s: Is my profile picture beautiful?
v.sz: 我的头像漂亮吗？
sx: Have you changed your profile picture recently?
你最近更改过你的头像吗？
Tom always has the cutest profile pictures.
汤姆永远有最可爱的头像。

v.t: vt. 拉, 拖, 拔, 牵, 撕开, 吸引 / vi. 拉, 拖, 拔, 有吸引力 / n. 拉, 拖, 拔, 拉力, 牵引力, 划船, 吸引
v.s: Did you pull the plug out?
v.sz: 插头是你拔的吗？
sx: Tom put the gun to his own head and pulled the trigger.
汤姆把枪顶到了自己头上，扣动了扳机。
He pulled with all his strength, but the rock would not move.
他用尽全力地拉，但那块大石还是纹丝不动。

v.t: n. 推, 推动, 奋斗, 攻击, 进取心 / vt. 推, 推动, 使伸出, 推行, 逼迫, 增加 / vi. 推, 推进, 增加, 努力争取
v.s: In case of fire, break the glass and push the red button.
v.sz: 万一发生火灾，打碎玻璃并按下红色按钮。
sx: You have only to push the button.
您只要按下按钮就行了。
Pushing customers to complete a task can be a headache.
催促客户去完成一件任务是很让人头疼的事。

v.t: n. 座, 座位, 位子, 席位, 所在地 / vt. 使坐下, 使就座, 为...设座于, 使就职 / vi. 安装在底座上
v.s: I left home early to get a good seat.
v.sz: 为了弄到一个好位子，我很早就出门了。
sx: Is this seat available?
这个位子空着吗？
Can you save this seat for me?
你可以帮我保留这个座位吗?

v.t: a. 性的, 性别的
v.s: Have you and her had a sexual relationship?
v.sz: 你和她有过性关系吗？

v.t: n. 目标, 靶子, 指标 / vt. 对准, 订指标
v.s: No matter how low the target, always aim higher.
v.sz: 无事掘小，小事掘大。
sx: I aimed my gun at the target.
我把我的手枪指向了目标。
The first attack missed the target.
第一次攻击错过了目标。

v.t: n. 理解, 谅解
v.s: For us, what’s most important is understanding the intention of the leadership.
v.sz: 对我们来说，最重要的是领会领导意图。
sx: He who is slow to anger has great understanding.
不轻易发怒的，大有聪明。
They have a secret understanding between them.
他们俩彼此心照不宣。

v.t: n. 村庄 / a. 乡村的, 村庄的
v.s: The only access to the village is from the river.
v.sz: 去那个村庄的唯一途径是过河。
sx: This village is free from air pollution.
这座村没有空气污染。
Our village is not short of water.
我们村不缺水。

v.t: n. 代理商, 政府代表, 动原, 媒介
v.s: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
v.sz: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
sx: Get in touch with your agent right away.
立刻联络你的经纪人。
Sami is a customer service agent.
莎米是一位客服。

v.t: n. 动物
v.s: Life in prison is worse than the life of an animal.
v.sz: 监狱生活比做畜牲还不如。
sx: Man is the only animal that can speak.
人是唯一会说话的动物。
I know the name of this animal.
我知道这种动物的名字。

v.t: vt. 涂, 应用 / vi. 申请, 适用
v.s: If you want this job, you must apply for it by tomorrow.
v.sz: 如果你想要这份工作的话，就一定要在明天之前申请。
sx: In order to apply, you have to go in person.
要申请的话，你得亲自去。
She applied her mind to her new job.
她专注在她的新工作上。

v.t: n. 权力, 当权者, 当局, 权威, 专家
v.s: He has a lot of authority.
v.sz: 他有很多职权。
sx: On what authority are you making us go?
凭什么让我们走？
The doctor is a great authority on children's diseases.
那位医生是儿童疾病的专家。

v.t: n. 基础, 主要成分
v.s: Your theory has no scientific basis.
v.sz: 你的理论并没有科学根据。
sx: Food, clothing and shelter are the basis of life.
衣食住是生存的基础。
The book is full of far-flung theories without any basis in scientific fact.
书中满是遥不可及、没有科学根据的理论。

v.t: vi. 拉, 拖, 拔剑 / vt. 拖拉, 挨近, 领取, 打成平局, 引导, 抽签决定, 画, 描写, 制订, 草拟, 吸引 / n. 拉, 拖, 拔出, 抽签, 平局
v.s: Draw a line from A to B.
v.sz: 请画一条从A到B的线。
sx: The game ended in a draw, and the final score was 2-2.
比赛以平局结束，最后比分是二比二。
Draw a straight line here.
在这里画一条直线。

v.t: n.<美国、加拿大>纨绔子弟，花花公子； <俚>男人，家伙； / vt.<俚>打扮得讲究或花哨
v.s: You suck dude! I have to tell you everything!
v.sz: 你好烂哦！ 我什么事都需要跟你讲！
sx: I'm a nice dude.
我是一个好人。

v.t: vt. 进入, 参加, 开始, 输入, 回车 / vi. 进去, 参加
v.s: To purchase a ticket, you need to enter your personal details.
v.sz: 你要先输入好个人资料，然后才能买票。
sx: Take off your hat when you enter a classroom.
进教室时请脱下帽子。
We were just about to enter the room.
我们正要进房间。

v.t: n. 基础, 根据, 建立
v.s: The rumor was without foundation.
v.sz: 谣言是毫无根据的。
sx: The truth and simplicity of nature is always the most important foundation of noteworthy art.
大自然的真实和质朴往往是值得注意的艺术中最重要的基石。
Mathematics are the foundation of all sciences.
数学是所有科学的基础。

v.t: n. 增益, 获得, 利润, 收获, 增加 / vt. 得到, 增进, 赚到 / vi. 获利, 增加
v.s: You gain more than you spend when you go to college.
v.sz: 上大学的时候，你得到的比付出的还多。
sx: How do I gain weight?
我怎么才能发胖？
No pain, no gain.
一分耕耘，一分收获。

v.t: n. 记忆, 记忆力, 回忆, 纪念, 存储 / n. 内存
v.s: Memory is an essential function of our brain.
v.sz: 记忆是我们大脑的一种主要功能。
sx: You have a very good memory.
你记性很好。
My memory failed me. I just could not remember his name.
我的记性不好。我简直不记得他的名字了。

v.t: n. 环, 环形物, 拳击场, 戒指, 角逐, 小集团, 铃声, 钟声, 声调 / vt. 包围, 套住, 按铃, 敲钟 / vi. 成环形, 响, 鸣, 按铃, 敲钟, 回响
v.s: The diamond was set in a gold ring.
v.sz: 钻石被镶在一个金戒指上。
sx: Give me a ring tomorrow.
明天打电话给我。
The scientists looked at tree-ring data.
科学家研究了树木年轮的数据。

v.t: n. 上升, 增加, 上涨, 高地, 升高, 出现 / vi. 升起, 起身, 起立, 上升, 上涨, 增长, 高耸, 起义, 浮现 / vt. 使飞起
v.s: This picture frame can make the picture rise in value.
v.sz: 这个画框能让画升值。
sx: Even if the sun were to rise in the west, I would not change my mind.
即使太阳从西边出来，我也不会改变主意。
The value of the dollar declines as the rate of inflation rises.
随着通货膨胀的发展美元贬值了。

v.t: n. 银, 银币, 银器 / a. 银的, 银制的, 银器的 / vt. 镀银 / vi. 变银白色
v.s: Speech is silver, but silence is golden.
v.sz: 雄辩如银，沉默如金。
sx: How do you buy silver?
你在哪买的银？
Donna was born with a silver spoon in her mouth.
Donna是含着金钥匙出生的。

v.t: n. 灵魂, 心灵, 精神, 精髓, 人, 化身, 典型, 鬼魂 / a. 黑人的
v.s: Individual freedom is the soul of democracy.
v.sz: 个人自由是民主的精髓。
sx: Since then he has put his soul into his work.
从那时起，他就把他整个灵魂投入到他的工作。
Me without you is like a body with no soul.
没有了你，我就像没有灵魂的躯体。

v.t: n. 传播, 散布, 伸展 / a. 双唇展开的, 伸展的 / vt. 展开, 铺开, 传播, 推广, 伸出, 涂, 敷, 延伸 / vi. 展开, 扩大, 传开, 延伸
v.s: The fire spread out in a fan-shape.
v.sz: 火势以扇形迅速蔓延。
sx: He spread his arms as though wanting to embrace the world.
他张开双臂, 似乎要拥抱这个世界。
I spread cheese on bread.
我把起司涂在面包上

v.t: n. 补给, 供给, 供应品 / vt. 补给, 供给, 提供, 补充 / vi. 替代
v.s: There is close relationship between supply and demand.
v.sz: 供应和需求之间的关系十分密切。
sx: However vast the darkness, we must supply our own light.
不论黑暗多么辽阔，我们都必须提供自身的光明。
The Red Cross constantly supplies food to the disaster areas.
红十字会不断地给灾区提供食物援助。

v.t: n. 浪费, 废物, 损耗, 消耗, 荒地, 垃圾, 地面风化物 / a. 废弃的, 荒芜的, 多余的 / vt. 浪费, 消耗, 使荒芜 / vi. 浪费, 消耗, 变消瘦
v.s: That lecture was a waste of time.
v.sz: 这场讲座是浪费时间。
sx: I would rather work for any company than waste another year.
我宁愿到不喜欢的公司工作，也不想浑浑噩噩的又过一年。
Some people think of reading as a waste of time.
有些人认为阅读简直浪费时间。

v.t: a. 怪异的, 超自然的, 不可思议的 / n. 命运, 预言, 符咒
v.s: I had a really weird dream yesterday.
v.sz: 我昨晚做了一个很奇怪的梦。
sx: Does that make me weird?
那让我奇怪吗？
These people are so weird.
这些人好奇怪。

v.t: n. 成人, 成虫 / a. 成年的, 成熟的
v.s: This person is new to being an adult.
v.sz: 此人涉世不深。
sx: I need something for an adult.
我需要一些成人的东西。
You are now an adult.
你现在是大人了。

v.t: adv. 表面上, 清楚地, 显然地
v.s: Apparently, they nest in a tree in front of the house.
v.sz: 很明显的，牠们在房前的树上筑巢。
sx: Apparently, there is nothing that cannot happen today.
显然，今天什么事都有可能发生。
Tom has apparently done that already.
很明显，汤姆已经做完了。

v.t: n. 艺术家, 画家
v.s: It is clear that he is a great artist.
v.sz: 他无庸置疑是个伟大的艺术家。
sx: My dream is to become an artist.
我梦想成为一名艺术家。
Not everybody can be an artist.
不是所有人都能当艺术家的。

v.t: n. 主席, 会长
v.s: He was invited to be the chairman of the club.
v.sz: 他受邀做俱乐部的主席。
sx: I'll recommend him as chairman, whether you are in favour of it or not.
你赞成也好，不赞成也好，我也会推荐他当主席的。
They made him the chairman of a club.
他们选他做俱乐部主席。

v.t: n. 版本, 版, 翻版
v.s: Which is more complete, the first edition or the second?
v.sz: 第一还是第二的版本比较齐全？
sx: I found the rare edition that I've been looking so long for.
找到了寻找已久的珍本。
Both of these are Song Dynasty block-printed editions.
这两本都是宋本。

v.t: n. 工程学, 工程, 操纵
v.s: Should we use genetic engineering on people?
v.sz: 我们应该对人使用基因编辑吗？

v.t: n. 等级, 年级, 阶段, 成绩, 程度, 坡度, 斜坡 / vt. 分等, 分级, 评分 / vi. 属于某等级, 逐渐变化
v.s: What grade is your sister in?
v.sz: 你的妹妹念几年级？
sx: Mary and Tom have been in love since the eighth grade.
玛丽和汤姆从8年级开始就相爱了。
They spoke of their high exam grades with understandable pride.
他们很骄傲地谈到考试中的好成绩，这种骄傲是可以理解的。

v.t: a. 健康的, 有益健康的, 卫生的
v.s: You should eat plenty of fruit to keep healthy.
v.sz: 你应该吃大量的水果来保持健康。
sx: You look as healthy as ever.
你看起来健康如昔。
Hopefully, we can all stay healthy.
希望我们都能保持健康。

v.t: n. 学会, 学院, 协会 / vt. 创立, 开始, 制定, 任命
v.s: A new classroom building was built in our institute last year.
v.sz: 去年我们学院建了一个新教学楼。

v.t: n. 方法, 办法, 条理, 秩序
v.s: Actually, the present method has plenty of room for improvement.
v.sz: 其实现时的方法还有很大的改善空间。
sx: This is by far the best method.
这绝对是最好的方法。
Such a method is out of date.
这种方法早已过时了。

v.t: adv. 显而易见地, 明显地
v.s: This is obviously dependent on the relationship...
v.sz: 这明显就是靠关系...
sx: Obviously, they are jealous of his wealth and status.
他们很明显在嫉妒他的财富和地位。
Obviously, we don't know if those thermos flasks are their own.
当然，那些热水瓶是不是他们自己的就不得而知了。

v.t: n. 选择权, 挑选, 选项
v.s: What other option is there?
v.sz: 还有其他选择吗？
sx: I don't have a lot of options.
我没有太多选择。
In the U.S., you have the option, when you enter a restaurant, to sit in the smoking or non-smoking section.
在美国，当你进入餐厅时，你可选择坐在吸烟区或是禁烟区。

v.t: n. 监狱, 监禁, 拘留所 / vt. 监禁
v.s: Life in prison is worse than the life of an animal.
v.sz: 监狱生活比做畜牲还不如。
sx: I promise that I will send you to prison.
我保证我会把你送进牢里。
The soul is the prison of the body.
灵魂是肉体的监牢。

v.t: n. 剩余物, 废墟, 残余
v.s: The cause of his death still remains a mystery.
v.sz: 他的死因仍然是一个谜。
sx: When only death remains, the last resort is to beg for food.
除死无大事，讨饭到了家。
There still remains much to be done.
还有很多东西要做。

v.t: n. 了不起的人, 大人物 / pron. 有人, 某人
v.s: If there is somebody to back me up, the business will be successful.
v.sz: 如果有人支持的话，生意是会成功的。
sx: We're looking for somebody who has experience in customer service.
我们正在寻找具有客服工作经验的人。
Somebody must care for the patient.
一定要有人照顾病人。

v.t: n. 石头, 宝石, 果核, 纪念碑, 结石 / vt. 投扔石子, 铺石头 / a. 石的, 石制的, 完全的
v.s: From a distance, this stone looks like a human face.
v.sz: 从远看得话，这个石头看起来像人的脸。
sx: This stone is too heavy to lift.
这块石头太重了无法抬起来。
He has a heart of stone.
他铁石心肠。

v.t: n. 力量, 实力, 强度, 浓度, 人数, 抵抗力
v.s: The ability to show weakness is a strength.
v.sz: 示弱是一种力量。
sx: Tom got the job on the strength of your recommendation.
多亏了你的推荐，汤姆得到了那份工作。
The warrior is conscious of both his strength and his weakness.
战士知道自己的力量和弱点。

v.t: n. 荒野, 荒地 / a. 野性的, 野蛮的, 野生的, 失控的, 任性的, 杂乱的, 轻率的, 狂热的, 疯狂的 / adv. 狂暴地, 失控地
v.s: Look out for the wild dog!
v.sz: 小心那野狗！
sx: The hunters captured the wild animal with a strong rope net.
猎人们用坚韧的绳网把野生动物捉住了。
He went to Africa to see wild animals.
为了看野生动物，他去了非洲。

v.t: n. 窗户, 窗子, 窗口 / vt. 给...开窗
v.s: I left the window open all through the night.
v.sz: 我整晚都开着窗户。
sx: Would you mind if I shut the window? I have a slight cold.
你不介意我关窗吧？我有点着凉了。
I want you to open the window.
我要你把窗户打开。

v.t: n. 胜利者, 优胜者
v.s: It is good to be a winner.
v.sz: 做个赢家很好。
sx: The winner of this quarter-final match will advance to the semi-final stage.
这场四分之一决赛的胜者将晋级半决赛。
Winners don't use drugs.
优胜者不使用药物。

v.t: n. 袋子, 袋状物 / vt. 使膨大, 装袋, 猎获
v.s: It was a bag that I lost in the room yesterday.
v.sz: 那是我昨天落在房间里的包。
sx: The bag was too heavy for me to move.
那个袋子太重了，我拿不动。
This bag is mine.
这个手袋是我的。

v.t: n. 打赌, 赌注 / v. 打赌
v.s: I bet he will get mad.
v.sz: 我打赌他会生气。
sx: I made a bet that she would win the game.
我赌她赢这比赛。
I bet Tom and Mary have never even been to Boston.
我很肯定汤姆和玛丽从来没去过波士顿。

v.t: n. 露营, 帐篷 / vi. 露营, 扎营 / vt. 使扎营
v.s: After a long argument, I finally persuaded her to go camping.
v.sz: 经过长久的争论，我终于说服了她去露营。
sx: We found it very hard going back to our base camp in the blizzard.
暴风雪使得我们难以返回营地。
A small rock was thrown into our camp.
小石头被丢到我们营地。

v.t: n. 演员阵容, 投掷, 铸件, 预测, 特性 / vt. 投, 掷, 抛, 脱落, 铸, 使弯曲, 计算 / vi. 投, 计算, 浇铸成型
v.s: He cast off the problem from his mind.
v.sz: 他把问题从脑子里排除了。
sx: We also have to cast off the evil eye from her every so often.
我们也得时不时替她驱除邪眼。
The tree cast a long shadow.
树投下长长的影子。

v.t: a. 正确的, 合适的 / vt. 改正, 订正
v.s: The sign means that the answer is correct.
v.sz: 这个符号代表答案正确。
sx: Correct the mistake and return the file to Mr Luxemburg.
请把错误改正过来，然后把文件夹还给 Luxemburg 先生。
I think your answer is correct.
我想你的答案是对的。

v.t: a. 危险的
v.s: It must be dangerous to swim in this rapid stream.
v.sz: 在这么急的急流里游泳，一定会很危险的。
sx: There is a tendency for people to think that hang gliding is dangerous.
人们普遍认为悬挂式滑翔运动是危险的。
It is dangerous to drive so fast.
车开得这么快很危险。

v.t: adv. 极端地, 非常地
v.s: Your clothes are extremely beautiful.
v.sz: 你的衣服太漂亮了。
sx: The atmosphere is always extremely lively when eating hot pot.
吃火锅的时候 ,气氛往往是非常热闹的.
I'm extremely embarrassed that it has taken so long to reply.
我过了这么久才回信，真的十分不好意思。

v.t: n. 公司, 商号 / a. 坚定的, 坚强的, 牢固的, 结实的, 坚硬的, 坚挺的, 严格的, 确定的 / vt. 使牢固, 使坚定 / vi. 变稳固, 变坚实 / adv. 稳固地
v.s: With a firm goal in mind, you will do well.
v.sz: 有了坚定的目标，你会做得很好。
sx: I feel happy in her firm.
在她的公司里，我感觉很好。
The government will provide interest-free loans to firms that participate in the program.
政府将会对参与该项计划的企业提供无息贷款。

v.t: n. 柄, 把手, 把柄, 柄状物, 手感 / vt. 触摸, 运用, 买卖, 处理, 操作 / vi. 搬运, 易于操纵 / n. 句柄
v.s: It is difficult for me to handle the case.
v.sz: 我处理这事有困难。
sx: You need to let me handle this.
你要让我来解决。
This job still has to be done by me. No one else can handle it.
这活儿还得俺来弄，别人可不行。

v.t: vt. 改良, 提高...的价值, 改善, 利用 / vi. 变得更好, 增加
v.s: I must take the opportunity to improve my language ability.
v.sz: 我要借机提升我的语言能力。
sx: I hope to improve my attitude to work.
我希望改进自己的工作态度。
This new market may improve the entire industry.
这个新的市场可能改良全部的工业。

v.t: adv. 的确, 实在, 真正地, 甚至
v.s: The design of these clothes is indeed rather nice, but they are a little expensive.
v.sz: 这件衣服样式倒是挺好，就是贵了点儿。
sx: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
患难见真情。
It may, indeed, be a mistake.
可能确实搞错了。

v.t: n. 否定, 否定语, 负数, 底片 / a. 否定的, 消极的, 负的, 阴性的 / n. 负数, 负值
v.s: Let go of your negative outlook on life.
v.sz: 请抛开你那些负面的人生观。
sx: My teacher taught me that you can take the square root of a negative number.
我的老师教我负数也可以开平方根。
Having a competitive mentality can give rise to negative emotions.
攀比心理会让人产生负面情绪。

v.t: v. 预防, 防止, 阻止, 妨碍
v.s: The surest way to prevent war is not to fear it.
v.sz: 预防战争的最佳方法，就是勇敢地去面对它。
sx: Nobody can prevent this plan from being carried out.
谁也不能阻止这个计划的实行。
A lawyer is a person who prevents someone else from getting your money.
律师是防止别人拿你的钱的人。

v.t: n. 精神, 心灵, 灵魂, 态度, 志气, 人格, 情绪, 心情, 烈酒 / vt. 诱拐, 鼓励, 鼓舞
v.s: The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.
v.sz: 心有余而力不足。
sx: I have a free spirit.
我是个自由的灵魂。
He was in good spirits.
他精神很好。

v.t: n. 电视
v.s: If you want to be free, destroy your television set.
v.sz: 你想成为自由就摧毁你的电视。
sx: Is there a television set in your bedroom?
你卧室里有电视吗？
Could you turn the television down a bit?
把电视声音关小点好吗？

v.t: prep. 直到, 在...以前, 迄 / conj. 直到...为止 / vt. 耕种 / n. 放钱的抽屉, 备用现金, 冰碛
v.s: You never know what you can do till you try.
v.sz: 在你试过之前，你不会知道你能做什么。
sx: I am afraid that I shall not be free till the examination is over.
恐怕直到考试结束前我都没空。
Will the fine weather keep up till tomorrow?
好天气能持续到明天吗？

v.t: n. 烦恼, 麻烦, 困难, 动乱, 故障 / vt. 困扰, 麻烦, 使烦恼, 折磨 / vi. 烦恼, 费心
v.s: He was involved in the trouble.
v.sz: 他被卷进了是非中。
sx: I had no idea it would put you to so much trouble.
我一点都不知道这会给你带来那么多问题。
Computers save us a lot of time and trouble.
电脑为我们节省了很多时间，解决了很多问题。

v.t: n. 优点, 便利, 好处, 优势 / vt. 有助于
v.s: It is an advantage to be able to use a computer.
v.sz: 懂得用电脑是一种优势。
sx: What is the advantage of this technology?
这种科技的优势是什么？
It is to your advantage to join us.
加入我们对你有利。

v.t: adv. 成零碎, 成距离, 分别地, 分离着 / a. 分离的
v.s: Only an expert can tell them apart.
v.sz: 只有专家能区分出它们的不同。
sx: Even though we are far apart, we still keep in touch.
尽管距离很远，我们还是保持着通信联系。
Apart from the cost, it will take long to build the bridge.
撇开费用不说，建这座桥也会耗费不少的时间。

v.t: a. 知道的, 有觉悟的
v.s: He was not aware of the danger.
v.sz: 他没有意识到自己有危险。
sx: Are you aware of how much she loves you?
你知道她有多么爱你吗?
Be more aware!
留点儿神！

v.t: n. 猫, 恶妇 / vi. 呕吐 / 计算机辅助教育, 计算机辅助测试, 计算机辅助翻译, 计算机辅助排版
v.s: Is the cat on the chair or under the chair?
v.sz: 猫在椅子上面，还是在椅子下面呢？
sx: There is a cat under the desk.
书桌下有一只猫。
I have a dog and a cat.
我有一只狗和一只猫。

v.t: v. 决定, 判决
v.s: We are finding it difficult to decide which one to buy.
v.sz: 我们发现很难决定买哪个。
sx: In conclusion, the next step is to decide what we should do for the next step.
总之，下一步是要决定我们下一步应该做什么。
He should have the right to decide for himself.
他应该有权利去自己做决定。

v.t: n. 晚餐, 正餐, 宴会
v.s: Thank you very much for the wonderful dinner last night.
v.sz: 非常感谢您昨晚美妙的晚餐。
sx: I always rest for an hour after dinner.
晚饭后，我总要休息一个小时。
I had a good dinner at his expense.
他请我吃了顿美味的晚饭。

v.t: n. 东方人, 东正教徒 / a. 东方的, 向东的, 自东的
v.s: Alcohol consumption is higher in Eastern Europe than in Western Europe.
v.sz: 东欧的酒精消耗量比西欧高。

v.t: n. 官能, 职务, 功能, 函数 / vi. 活动, 运行, 行使职责
v.s: Memory is an essential function of our brain.
v.sz: 记忆是我们大脑的一种主要功能。
sx: The function of the brake is to stop the car.
刹车的功能是使车停下。
Rats also have a function. They help to clean the pipes.
鼠类也有用处。它们能帮著清洁管道。

v.t: n. 礼物, 赠予, 天才 / vt. 赋予
v.s: My native language is the most beautiful gift from my mother.
v.sz: 我的母语是我从我母亲那里得到的最美好的礼物。
sx: Never look a gift horse in the mouth.
获人赠马，休看马口。
You can come to my party, but you have to bring me a gift.
你可以来我的派对,不过,你得带来一件礼物.

v.t: pron. 她自己, 她亲自
v.s: She was able to cook herself dinner, after a fashion.
v.sz: 她勉强能自己煮晚餐吃。
sx: She has the large house to herself.
她给自己一间大房子。
She shut herself up in her room.
她把自己关在房里。

v.t: a. 不可能的, 难以置信的, 令人无法忍受的
v.s: To live without air is impossible.
v.sz: 没有空气生活是不可能的。
sx: It is impossible for me to finish the work in an hour.
我不可能在一小时内就完成工作。
It is impossible to master English in a short time.
不可能短时间内学会英语。

v.t: n. 影响力, 权力, 势力 / vt. 影响, 改变
v.s: Do you think our climate has an influence on our character?
v.sz: 你觉得气候会不会影响人的性格呢？
sx: He has a strong influence over the business world.
他在商界有很大的影响力。
He lost consciousness under the influence of the anesthetic.
他在麻醉剂的作用下，他失去了知觉。

v.t: n. 行销, 买卖
v.s: He is the manager of the marketing department.
v.sz: 他是营销部的负责人。
sx: I plan to accept the offer from that company to become their marketing department's manager.
我打算去应聘那个公司的营销部经理职位.
For media inquiries, please contact your local communications or marketing representative.
如需媒体联络，请与当地客服中心或行销团队联系。

v.t: conj. 也不, 也没有
v.s: She is neither in the kitchen nor in the living room.
v.sz: 她不在厨房里，也不在客厅里。
sx: I can neither confirm nor deny that.
我既不能确认也不能否定。
I do not know how to read nor write.
我不知道如何读或写。

v.t: n. 生产品, 物产, 后代 / vt. 产生, 生产, 提出, 出示 / vi. 生产, 制造
v.s: Can you produce any evidence that he was not at home that night?
v.sz: 你能不能提供他那天晚上没在家的证明？
sx: The amount of paper produced by a country is closely related to its cultural standards.
一个国家纸的产量和它的文明程度密切相关。
Apples are produced in this district.
这是一个产苹果的地区。

v.t: n. 进步, 发展, 前进 / vi. 进步, 进行
v.s: Technology will make a lot of progress in the nineties.
v.sz: 科技在 1990 年代会有很大进步吧。
sx: Focus on progress.
专注于进展上。
Thirdly, each team leader please report your progress.
第三，请每个项目主管报告进度。

v.t: a. 骄傲的, 自大的, 自豪的, 辉煌的, 壮丽的
v.s: I am proud to be a part of this project.
v.sz: 我以身为这个计划的一份子为荣。
sx: She is proud of her husband being rich.
她因为丈夫是有钱人而感到自豪。
I want to make her proud of me.
我想让她以我为傲。

v.t: vt. 需要, 命令, 要求
v.s: I would like to but I have a required course tonight.
v.sz: 我不是不想听，但是今晚我有必修课。
sx: We require your help.
我们需要你的帮助。
I require an apple.
我需要一个苹果。

v.t: n. 关闭 / vt. 关上, 闭起, 幽禁, 合拢, 轧住 / vi. 关上, 停止营业
v.s: I shut the door quietly so as not to wake the baby.
v.sz: 为了不吵醒宝宝，我静静地关上了门。
sx: My computer shut down automatically.
我电脑自动关机了。
May I trouble you to shut the window?
可以麻烦你把窗关了吗？

v.t: n. 货车, 篷车, 先锋, 前驱, 前卫 / vt. 用货车搬运
v.s: That red car hit the blue van.
v.sz: 那辆红色的汽车撞到了蓝色的卡车。
sx: Tom was the last one to get in the van.
汤姆是最后一个上面包车的。

v.t: n. 木材, 木制品 / vt. 植林于, 给...添加木柴 / vi. 收集木材
v.s: Put some more wood on the fire.
v.sz: 再往火里添些木柴。
sx: In the village we still heat our homes with wood.
在村庄里，我们还是用木头给房子取暖。
We spread out and began to search through the woods.
我们分散开来并在树林中展开搜索。

v.t: n. 背景, 背景资料
v.s: There is a castle in the background of the picture.
v.sz: 图片的背景是一座城堡。
sx: Does your family background involve Chinese medicine?
您的家族史跟中医有没有关系？
Tom has a veterinary background.
Tom有兽医背景。

v.t: n. 出生, 起源
v.s: They were pleased at the birth of their first child.
v.sz: 他们第一个孩子出生了，很高兴。
sx: His claim is that there is a close relation between birth order and personality.
他主张的是出生的先后次序和个性有很密切的关系。
What is your date of birth?
你的生日是几号？

v.t: n. 桥, 舰桥, 桥梁, 桥牌 / vt. 架桥于, 跨越
v.s: The old bridge is in danger of collapse.
v.sz: 那座老桥正面临坍塌的危险。
sx: His plan is to build a bridge over that river.
他的计划是在那条河上建一座桥。
Apart from the cost, it will take long to build the bridge.
撇开费用不说，建这座桥也会耗费不少的时间。

v.t: n. 观念, 概念
v.s: I really like the concept of this website.
v.sz: 我觉得这个网站的概念非常好。
sx: I understand the concept.
我明白这概念。
The concept doesn’t make sense.
理念没有道理。

v.t: n. 副本, 摹仿, 一册 / v. 复印, 抄袭, 复制 / 将几个文件合并成一个文件, 以及将文件传至外设或在设备之间传送
v.s: I keep the master copy under lock and key.
v.sz: 我妥善保管原版拷贝。
sx: He compared the copy with the original.
他比较了复印稿和原件。
Make a copy of this report.
请你把这份报告拿去影印。

v.t: n. 亲爱的人 / a. 亲爱的, 昂贵的, 严重的, 急迫的 / interj. 啊 / adv. 深爱地, 高价地
v.s: Dog food is dear.
v.sz: 狗粮很贵。
sx: Please serve the guests some coffee, dear.
亲爱的，给客人端点咖啡吧。
I'm so glad to see you, dear.
亲爱的, 我很高兴看到你。

v.t: n. 花园, 果园, 菜园 / vi. 栽培花木 / vt. 造园 / a. 花园的, 普通的
v.s: My father put a fence around the garden.
v.sz: 我父亲在花园边上装了篱笆。
sx: What is still better is that the house has a beautiful garden.
更棒的是房子还有一个漂亮的花园。
There is a small garden in front of my house.
我家前面有个小庭院。

v.t: n. 主人, 旅馆老板, 节目主持人 / vt. 当主人招待, 作...节目主持人
v.s: A guest should not try to make himself superior to the host.
v.sz: 强宾不压主。
sx: The party host had a Portuguese accent.
派对主席说话时有葡萄牙腔
We have to cope with hosts of difficulties.
我们要面对许多的困难。

v.t: n. 遮盖, 住房供给, 居留(处), 房屋, 装饰
v.s: The government is not doing its best to solve the housing problem.
v.sz: 政府没有尽他们最大的努力去处理住房问题。

v.t: n. 领导能力, 领导阶层
v.s: Do you have leadership potential?
v.sz: 有领导潜力吗？
sx: For us, what’s most important is understanding the intention of the leadership.
对我们来说，最重要的是领会领导意图。

v.t: n. 长度, 长, 期间, 一段
v.s: Her hair grew back to its original length.
v.sz: 她的头发长回原来的长度了。
sx: The length of a marriage is inversely proportional to the cost of the wedding.
婚姻的长度与婚宴的花费负相关。

v.t: a. 幸运的, 吉祥的, 好运的, 侥幸的
v.s: This year has been a lucky one for him.
v.sz: 这年对他来说是幸运的一年。
sx: All three of you are very lucky.
你们三个很走运。
What a lucky person he is!
他是多么幸运的人啊！

v.t: adv. 皆不, 两个都不 / a. (两者)都不的 / pron. 两者都不 / conj. 既非, 既不
v.s: She is neither in the kitchen nor in the living room.
v.sz: 她不在厨房里，也不在客厅里。
sx: I can neither confirm nor deny that.
我既不能确认也不能否定。
I had neither the time to go shopping, nor to say goodbye to my mother.
我既没时间购物，又没时间跟我妈妈说再见。

v.t: prep. 在...之上
v.s: It is dangerous to jump onto a moving train.
v.sz: 跳上一列正在开的火车是很危险的。
sx: She elbowed her way onto the train.
她挤上了火车。
Don't throw anything onto the floor.
不要往地上扔任何东西。

v.t: n. 病人, 承受者 / a. 忍耐的, 容忍的, 有耐性的, 坚忍的
v.s: You have to be patient about your recovery.
v.sz: 你必须对你的康复有耐心。
sx: Send for the doctor at once, or the patient may get worse.
立刻派人去请医生来, 否则病人可能变得更糟糕。
This medicine will increase the survival rate of the patients.
这个药品会提高病人的存活率。

v.t: adv. 可能, 也许
v.s: Could you possibly suggest a way to solve the problem?
v.sz: 你能提出解决问题的方法吗？
sx: How could I possibly forget about the task that you've entrusted to me?
我怎么能忘记您交付我的任务？
It can't possibly be true.
这不可能是真的。

v.t: vt. 证明, 查验, 检验, 勘探, 显示 / vi. 证明是
v.s: The report proved true as a result of their investigation.
v.sz: 他们的调查结果显示这篇报导是真实的。
sx: Are you able to prove it?
你能证明吗？
I just wanted to prove to myself that I could do this.
我只想向自己证明我可以做到。

v.t: a. 稀罕的, 罕有的, 珍奇的, 稀薄的, 半熟的, 非常好的 / adv. 非常
v.s: All you have to do is take advantage of this rare opportunity.
v.sz: 你所要做的便是好好把握这千载难逢的机会。
sx: Medium-rare and a potato, please.
麻烦牛排三分熟和一份马铃薯。
I would like mine rare.
我的牛排要生的。

v.t: n. 环境, 背景, 布景, 镶嵌, 调整, 沉落, 一副餐具
v.s: The sun is setting.
v.sz: 太阳下山了。
sx: There are too many push notifications, so I turned them off in the settings.
推送通知太多了，我在设定里关掉了。
The promotion of a piece to a king is indicated by setting on it another piece of the same color.
在一颗棋子上放置另一颗相同颜色的棋子，可以表示这颗棋子晋升为王。

v.t: n. 软件
v.s: All of my software is open source.
v.sz: 我的软件全都是开源的。
sx: Pierre has a lot of pirated software on his computer.
Pierre电脑里有很多盗版软件。
Tatoeba is open source software.
Tatoeba是开放原始码软体。

v.t: n. 恶棍 / a. 强硬的, 艰苦的, 坚固的, 坚韧的, 粗暴的, 咬不动的
v.s: He was tired out by an awfully tough job.
v.sz: 他被一件辛苦的工作累坏了。
sx: Tom certainly has a tough job.
汤姆确实有个麻烦的工作。
Life is tough.
生活是难的。

v.t: n. 广告
v.s: The classified ad wanted female singers to form an a cappella group.
v.sz: 这则分类广告招募女歌手组成无伴奏合唱团。

v.t: a. 活着的, 活泼的, 敏感的, 热闹的
v.s: There is little, if any, hope of his being alive.
v.sz: 我们几乎不抱他还活着的希望。
sx: If she was still alive, she would be able to help me.
如果她还活着的话，现在能帮我。
Although old, he is still very much alive.
虽然上了年纪，他依旧充满活力。

v.t: n. 苹果, 家伙
v.s: The apple does not fall far from the tree.
v.sz: 苹果掉落的地方不会离树干很远。
sx: I require an apple.
我需要一个苹果。
Apple is still very secretive with regard to the release date and the price.
苹果在发售日期和价格上口风仍然很紧。

v.t: n. 平衡, 差额 / vi. 平衡, 相等 / vt. 称, 权衡, 比较, 使平衡, 结算, 抵消
v.s: It makes sense to pay off your credit card balance every month.
v.sz: 每个月还清信用卡负债很重要。
sx: Due to a lack of balance the ship turned over.
那艘船失去平衡，翻了过来。
The balance of public opinion remains in his favor.
公众意见的平衡仍是他的关切。

v.t: n. 生日
v.s: Only if you come will she come to my birthday party.
v.sz: 只有你来了，她才会来我的生日派对。
sx: I will give you a bicycle for your birthday.
我在你的生日会送给你一辆自行车。
I was unable to go to his birthday party.
我那时没法去他的生日派对。

v.t: n. 老板, 上司, 岩瘤, 浮雕, 母牛 / vt. 指挥, 控制, 浮雕
v.s: Between you and me, I think our boss is stupid.
v.sz: 我觉得我们老板很蠢，这我就只跟你说。
sx: Who is in charge of the office while the boss is away?
在主任不在的时候，办公室由谁来负责？
Who is the boss of this company?
这家公司的老板是谁？

v.t: n. 连接, 关系, 前后关系
v.s: Why is my Internet connection so slow?
v.sz: 我的网怎么会这么慢？
sx: The possibility of a lack of connection between the events can be dismissed immediately.
可以立即排除事件之间缺乏关联的可能性
We have a special connection.
我们有特殊联系。

v.t: n. 服装, 覆盖物 / vi. 穿着 / vt. 给...穿衣, 整理
v.s: Where did you get the money to buy that dress?
v.sz: 你从哪儿弄来的钱去买那件衣服？
sx: How much did you pay for the dress?
那条裙子你花多少钱买的？
She was satisfied with the new dress.
那条新裙子让她很满意。

v.t: n. 男人, 朋友, 同事 / a. 同伴的, 同事的, 同道的
v.s: He is a good fellow.
v.sz: 他是个好人。
sx: He is hardly friendly with his fellow workers.
他几乎不和他的同僚友好相处。
We're fellow countrymen.
我们是同胞。

v.t: n. 马, 骑兵, 脚架 / vi. 骑马, 取笑 / vt. 使骑马, 系马于
v.s: As well as this, the horse is also representative of human talent.
v.sz: 除此之外，马还是人才的代名词。
sx: Get on the horse immediately!
马上上马！
Can I ride this horse for a while?
可以让我骑一会儿这匹马吗？

v.t: n. 魔术, 魔法 / a. 魔术的, 有魔力的, 不可思议的
v.s: Friendship is magic.
v.sz: 友谊是魔术。
sx: The girl vanished like magic.
女孩变魔术一样地消失了。
This monster only takes magic damage.
这个怪物只吃魔法伤害。

v.t: n. 地图, 天体图, 映像 / vt. 映射, 绘制...地图, 计划
v.s: Choose a suitable satellite image as the base map.
v.sz: 选择合适的卫星图做为底图。
sx: There is a map on the desk.
办公桌上面有一张地图。
May I have a road map, please?
请给我一张路线图。

v.t: n. 网, 网状物, 罗网, 净利, 净价 / a. 净的, 最终的 / vt. 用网捕, 撒网, 净赚, 得到 / vi. 编网
v.s: He fixed the net.
v.sz: 他修好了网。
sx: The hunters captured the wild animal with a strong rope net.
猎人们用坚韧的绳网把野生动物捉住了。
He is using a fishing net to fish.
他在用渔网捕鱼。

v.t: n. 请求, 需要, 申请书 / vt. 请求, 要求, 邀请
v.s: We are sorry we are unable to accept your request.
v.sz: 很抱歉，我们不能接受你的要求。
sx: They refused to talk to me in spite of my earnest request.
尽管我恳切地要求，他们还是拒绝跟我说话。
Under the circumstances I cannot allow the request.
在这种情况之下,我不能允许这个要求。

v.t: n. 棍, 棒, 刺, 枯枝, 茎, 条状物 / vt. 插进, 刺入, 钉住, 伸出, 粘贴, 停止 / vi. 粘住, 停留, 坚持, 陷住, 伸出
v.s: I think you had better stick to your present job.
v.sz: 我觉得你应该继续做这份工作。
sx: The shadow of the stick is visible.
立竿见影。
Stick a notice on the board.
把告示贴在在布告板上。

v.t: n. 交通工具, 车辆, 传播媒介
v.s: The number of motor vehicles in the city has increased.
v.sz: 城市里的机动车数量增加了。
sx: Lightning struck the vehicle.
闪电击中了车子。
Edmundo threw Rima off the vehicle.
埃德蒙多把里玛从车上推下去了。

v.t: n. 册, 卷, 体积, 容量, 大量, 许多, 份量, 音量 / vi. 成团卷起 / vt. 把...收集成卷 / a. 大量的
v.s: Please lower the volume of the music!
v.sz: 请把音乐声调小！
sx: Turn down the volume, please.
麻烦你把音量调低一点。
Could you lower the volume?
你可以把音量调低一点吗？

v.t: vt. 叫醒, 激发 / vi. 醒来, 醒着, 觉醒, 活跃起来 / n. 守侯, 守夜, 尾迹, 痕迹
v.s: You had better not wake me up when you come in.
v.sz: 你进来的时候最好不要把我弄醒。
sx: I depend on the alarm clock to wake up on time every morning.
每天早上我都要靠闹钟来按时叫醒我。
Be quiet, or the baby will wake up.
安静，否则婴儿会醒来。

v.t: n. 帮助, 外援, 助手 / vt. 援助, 帮助, 有助于 / vi. 帮助
v.s: He put a Band-Aid on his hand.
v.sz: 他在手上贴了一块胶布。
sx: I hope that some scientist will soon discover a cure for AIDS.
真希望科学家们能早点找到艾滋病的治疗方法。
Scientists are working hard to put an end to AIDS.
科学家们正努力终结艾滋病。

v.t: n. 美, 美人
v.s: The beauty of the scene was beyond description.
v.sz: 那里的景色美得无法以笔墨形容。
sx: She has no sense of beauty.
她没有审美感。
She has an eye for beauty.
她有一双美丽的眼睛。

v.t: a. 忙碌的, 热闹的, 没空的 / vt. 使忙 / vi. 忙碌
v.s: I have been busy writing a short story.
v.sz: 我一直忙于写一部短篇小说。
sx: Sorry, the line is busy now.
不好意思，现在线路繁忙。
I have been busy this week.
我这礼拜一直很忙。

v.t: a. 关心的, 有关的, 参与的, 担心的
v.s: So far as this matter is concerned, I am completely satisfied.
v.sz: 我对这件事感到十分满意。
sx: I am not concerned with this affair.
这件事与我无关。
I am very concerned about his health.
我很关心他的健康。

v.t: n. 会话, 说话, 交谈
v.s: We had a conversation about baseball.
v.sz: 我们交谈了有关棒球的事。
sx: As their conversation was in French, I could not understand a word.
因为他们是用法语谈话的，所以我一句也听不懂。
What is your reason for soliciting a conversation with me?
你恳求与我谈话的原因是什么？

v.t: n. 角落, 转角, 窘境 / vt. 迫至一隅, 垄断, 使陷入绝境 / vi. 相交成角, 垄断
v.s: Spring is just around the corner.
v.sz: 春天快来了。
sx: Is there a quiet corner in here where I can study?
这儿有没有比较安静的地方我可以学习的？
I have a corner in my liver just for you, alcohol.
我在肝里给你留了个地方，酒精啊。

v.t: n. 罪犯, 犯人, 刑事 / a. 犯了罪的, 刑事的, 有罪的
v.s: The police were able to find the criminal.
v.sz: 警方能够找到罪犯。
sx: The criminal is still at large.
那个犯人还没被抓到。
We have investigated his criminal record.
我们调查了他的犯规记录。

v.t: a. 文化的, 教养的, 修养的
v.s: Furthermore, I still don't think this a huge cultural difference.
v.sz: 而且，我还是认为这准不是个巨大的文化区别。
sx: The amount of paper produced by a country is closely related to its cultural standards.
一个国家纸的产量和它的文明程度密切相关。
It is everyone's duty to cherish cultural relics.
爱护文物, 人人有责。

v.t: vt. 发展, 使发达, 进步, 洗印, 显影 / vi. 发展, 生长
v.s: It seems the rural area will be developed on a large scale.
v.sz: 农村好像要大规模发展了。
sx: Our country must develop its natural resources.
我们国家必须开发自然资源。
It takes time to develop political awareness.
培养政治意识要花费时间。

v.t: n. 驾驶员, 驱动器, 驱动程序
v.s: The driver does not have responsibility for the traffic accident.
v.sz: 司机不需要为这次的交通意外负责。
sx: Tom has a job as a taxi driver.
汤姆有一份出租车司机的工作。
Their father is a taxi driver.
他们的父亲是一个计程车司机。

v.t: a. 存在的, 目前的, 现存的, 现有的
v.s: He ignored the existing laws.
v.sz: 他无视现行法律。
sx: You need to consider the consequences before making any modifications to existing code.
对现有代码做出任何修改前，你需要考虑后果。

v.t: n. 农场, 农田 / vt. 耕种 / vi. 种田
v.s: All of his family work on a farm.
v.sz: 他全家都在农场工作。
sx: I live on a farm not too far from Boston.
我住在离波士顿不远的一个农场。
He has a farm.
他有一个农场。

v.t: n. 档案, 公文箱, 文件夹, 文件, 卷宗, 锉刀 / vi. 列队行进, 用锉刀做 / vt. 归档, 申请, 锉, 琢磨
v.s: Correct the mistake and return the file to Mr Luxemburg.
v.sz: 请把错误改正过来，然后把文件夹还给 Luxemburg 先生。
sx: In which folder did you save the file?
您把文件存在哪个文件夹里了呀？
I have a newspaper clipping file.
我有一本剪报夹。

v.t: vt. 使固定, 修理, 准备, 安装, 凝视, 牢记, 确定, 整理 / vi. 固定, 注视, 确定 / n. 困境, 方位, 维修, 贿赂
v.s: Can I fix you a hot drink?
v.sz: 我可以为你调杯热饮料吗？
sx: We have to fix the date for our trip quickly.
我们必须快点定下旅游日期。
I'm glad that they fixed the heating system, but now it's too hot.
我很高兴他们修复了暖气系统，但现在太热了。

v.t: n. 苍蝇, 两翼昆虫, 飞行 / vi. 飞, 飞翔, 飘扬, 逃走 / vt. 飞, 飞越, 使飘扬, 逃出 / a. 敏捷的
v.s: If I were a bird, I could fly to you.
v.sz: 如果我是一只小鸟，我就可以飞到你的身边了。
sx: An ostrich does not fly through the air.
驼鸟不会在空中飞。
When poverty comes in at the door, love flies out the window.
当贫穷降临在门口，爱从窗外飞走。

v.t: n. 引导者, 导游, 指南, 路标 / vt. 指导, 支配, 管理, 带领, 操纵 / vi. 任向导
v.s: They set out with a guide just in case they lost their way.
v.sz: 他们和一个导游一起出发，只是为了以防迷路。
sx: This book is a good guide for beginners.
这本书对新手来说是一本很好的手册。
I'll act as a guide for you.
我为你充当导游。

v.t: n. 调查, 审查
v.s: No investigation, no right to speak.
v.sz: 没有调查就没有发言权。
sx: The report proved true as a result of their investigation.
他们的调查结果显示这篇报导是真实的。
The reporter elaborated on the method of his investigation.
报告者详尽地说明了他的研究方法。

v.t: n. 上升, 高地, 增高 / vt. 升起, 举起, 唤起, 提高, 使出现, 使复活, 提出, 筹集, 饲养
v.s: If you have a question, please raise your right hand.
v.sz: 如果有问题，请举起你的右手。
sx: Raise your hand when I call your name.
我叫你的名字的时候，请你把手举起来。
He would not raise my salary.
他不肯给我涨工资。

v.t: n. 责任, 职责, 负担, 可靠性
v.s: The driver does not have responsibility for the traffic accident.
v.sz: 司机不需要为这次的交通意外负责。
sx: He resigned from the job to take the responsibility for the loss.
为了这次的损失，他扛起责任，辞职了。
I take full responsibility for the action.
我会为这次行动负起全责。

v.t: n. 卷, 滚动, 名单, 案卷, 压路机 / vi. 滚, 滚动, 飘流, 起伏, 卷, 绕 / vt. 使滚动, 卷, 绕
v.s: Would you like to eat a roll for lunch?
v.sz: 你午饭想吃面包吗？
sx: A roll of colour film, please.
请给我一卷彩色胶片。
Roll the ball to me.
把球传给我。

v.t: adv. 些微地, 苗条地
v.s: You may be right, but we have a slightly different opinion.
v.sz: 也许你是对的，但我们的意见稍微有所不同。
sx: He drunk wine, so he is slightly drunk.
他喝了酒，略有醉意。
The schedule is only slightly affected by this delay.
日程表只受到了这次延误的轻微影响。

v.t: vt. 提议, 建议, 促成, 暗示, 启发, 使人想起
v.s: I suggest that you should write him a thank-you letter.
v.sz: 我觉得你应该给他写一封感谢信。
sx: How do you suggest we go about it?
你觉得我们应该怎么处理？
I suggest we move to a safer location.
我建议我们去个更安全的地方。

v.t: n. 惊奇, 奇袭, 诧异 / vt. 使惊奇, 撞见, 奇袭
v.s: To my surprise, there were no people in the village.
v.sz: 奇怪的是，村子里竟然一个人也没有。
sx: You must have been surprised to find me alone with her yesterday.
昨天你发现我单独跟她在一块儿应该感到很惊讶吧。
You must have been surprised to meet your teacher in such a place.
在那种地方碰到你的老师，你应该很惊讶吧。

v.t: a. 技术上的, 专门的, 工业的, 严格根据法律的
n. 宴请, 款待 / vt. 视为, 对待, 论述, 治疗, 款待 / vi. 讨论, 谈判, 作东
v.s: I treat you to a cup of coffee.
v.sz: 我请你喝杯咖啡。
sx: They treat me like a child.
他们把我当小孩。
What time will you get back? I'll treat you to a meal.
你什么时候回来？请你吃一顿饭。

v.t: a. 独一无二的, 独特的, 稀罕的
v.s: Each and every person is unique.
v.sz: 每一个人都是独一无二的。
sx: You are unique.
妳很独特。
The weather here has its own unique characteristics.
这里的天气有独一无二的特点。

v.t: n. 多样, 种类, 变种, 杂耍
v.s: There was a great variety of dishes on the menu.
v.sz: 菜单上有各种各样的菜色。
sx: We talked about a variety of topics.
我们谈了各种话题。
A variety of books are displayed there.
那里展示着各种各样的书。

v.t: n. 猛烈, 暴力, 暴虐, 暴行
v.s: Violence is the cancer of our society.
v.sz: 暴力是社会的癌症。
sx: A revolution is an insurrection, an act of violence by which one class overthrows another.
革命就是一场暴动，一场由一个阶级推翻另一个阶级的暴力行动。
Tom didn't want any violence.
汤姆不想暴力。

v.t: pron. 你的(东西), 你们的(东西)
v.s: Mine is not so good as yours.
v.sz: 我的没有你的好。
sx: Your plans are very good, but mine are better than yours.
你们的计划很好，可是我的更好。
I need a pencil. Can I use one of yours?
我需要一支铅笔，我能用你的其中一支吗？

v.t: n. 年轻, 青年时代, 青年们, 青春
v.s: The youth of our land are not interested in politics.
v.sz: 我们国家的年轻人对政治普遍不感兴趣。
sx: Youth has its own culture.
年轻人有自己的文化。
In her youth, my mother was very beautiful.
我母亲年轻的时候十分漂亮。

v.t: vt. 赏识, 鉴别, 为...而感激, 领会, 欣赏 / vi. 增值, 涨价
v.s: We really appreciate their effort.
v.sz: 我们真的感激他们的努力。
sx: I deeply appreciate your advice and kindness.
我深深地感激你的建议和好心。
Appreciate the little things in life - they will bring you to a bigger end target.
欣赏生活中的小事，它们的总合很是宏大。

v.t: a. 干的, 无酒的, 枯燥无味的, 干燥的 / vt. 把...弄干 / vi. 变干 / n. 干, 干涸
v.s: Wipe the pan dry with a paper towel.
v.sz: 用纸巾把那口锅擦干。
sx: Hang your clothes out to dry!
你把衣服晾出来！
Bring me a dry towel.
给我一条干毛巾。

v.t: n. 边缘, 尖锐, 刀刃, 优势 / vt. 使锐利, 挤进, 镶边 / vi. 缓缓移动
v.s: Will you please hold this edge?
v.sz: 能不能请你拿着这端？
sx: The sidebar is displayed on the edge of the page below the site logo.
侧边栏显示在网站标志下方的页面边缘。
A great Empire, like a great Cake, is most easily diminished at the Edges.
一个伟大的帝国, 就像是一个大蛋糕, 最容易消失的地方就在边缘。

v.t: n. 邪恶, 不幸, 罪恶 / a. 邪恶的, 不幸的, 有害的, 讨厌的
v.s: The lack of money is the root of all evil.
v.sz: 所有的罪恶源于金钱的不足
sx: We also have to cast off the evil eye from her every so often.
我们也得时不时替她驱除邪眼。
Knowledge is power, but it is power for evil just as much as for good.
知识就是力量，但这力量可以用来做好事，也可以用来做坏事。

v.t: adv. 永远
v.s: It would take forever for me to explain everything.
v.sz: 我就算说上三天三夜，恐怕也不能把一切解释清楚。
sx: I want to be with you forever.
我想永远跟你在一起。
I will love you forever.
我会永远爱你。

v.t: n. 伤害, 侮辱
v.s: How did you get this injury on your foot?
v.sz: 脚上的伤是怎么回事？
sx: I got hurt during an experiment, and the injury was pretty serious.
我做实验的时候弄伤了，而且还伤得十分严重。
The doctor treated her injury.
医生把她的伤治好了。

v.t: n. 铁, 熨斗, 铁器, 坚强, 烙铁, 镣铐 / vt. 烫平, 熨, 用铁包 / vi. 烫平
v.s: Strike while the iron is hot.
v.sz: 打铁趁热。
sx: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
先熨烫领子的里面，然后是外面。
Iron is a metal.
铁是一种金属。

v.t: a. 可爱的, 有趣的
v.s: It was a lovely autumn evening.
v.sz: 那是个迷人的秋夜。
sx: There are four lovely children in this photo.
这张照片上有四个可爱的孩子。
My wife's 34 and she's a lovely person.
我妻子34岁了，她是个可爱的人。

v.t: a. 疯狂的, 发疯的, 生气的, 愚蠢的, 狂欢的 / n. 狂怒
v.s: Your wife is mad at you.
v.sz: 你太太在生你的气。
sx: For a moment there, I thought he had gone mad.
一时间我还以为他疯了。
My cat is mad.
我的猫很疯狂。

v.t: n. 杂志, 仓库, 弹盒, 胶卷盒
v.s: A magazine can tell more about a story than a newspaper.
v.sz: 杂志比报纸报导得更深入。
sx: Can I have a look at the magazine?
我能看一眼那本杂志吗？
She put the magazine on the table.
她把杂志放在桌上。

v.t: n. 国会, 议会
v.s: The meetings of the parliament are public.
v.sz: 国会的会议是公开的。

v.t: a. 准备好的, 特制的
v.s: Do not fear the unexpected, but be prepared for it.
v.sz: 不要害怕意外，但要有准备。
sx: Tomorrow is the exam. Are you all prepared?
明天就要考试啦，大家准备好了没呀？
In order to give him a surprise on his birthday, I prepared a fantastic cake.
为了给他生日惊喜，我准备了一个非常棒的蛋糕。

v.t: n. 参考, 索引, 参照 / vt. 给...加上参考资料 / vt. 引用 / vi. 引用
v.s: I'll keep this information handy for future reference.
v.sz: 我会将这则资讯记下来，以便未来参考。
sx: Pei-rong, can I take a look at your report for reference?
佩蓉，你那份报告可以借我参考一下吗？
I don't like Google Translate either, but I always use it for reference.
我也不喜欢谷歌翻译，但是我经常会使用它作为参考。

v.t: n. 宗教, 信仰
v.s: Is Buddhism a religion or a philosophy?
v.sz: 佛教是宗教还是哲学？
sx: In your view, can we judge other people's religion or not?
对你来说，我们可不可以评判别人的宗教？
Keep religion out of government.
别让宗教影响政府。

v.t: adv. 到某处, 在某处
v.s: Would you like to go out to have a drink somewhere?
v.sz: 一起出去喝杯怎么样？
sx: I lost my key somewhere around here.
我的钥匙就是在这附近丢失的。
I remember hearing that music somewhere.
我记得在哪儿听到过那首音乐。

v.t: n. 战略, 策略
v.s: Hope is not a strategy.
v.sz: 希望不是一种策略。
sx: Real-time strategy games usually include arcade elements.
即时策略游戏通常会融入街机元素。
China is incorporating Algeria into its Belt and Road strategy.
中国正将阿尔及利亚纳入「一带一路」战略。

v.t: n. 网, 蛛丝, 蹼, 织物, 圈套, 卷筒纸 / vi. 结网, 形成网 / vt. 织蜘蛛网于, 使落入圈套
v.s: More than 90 percent of visits to a web page are from search engines.
v.sz: 一个网页超过百分之九十的访问量是来自于搜索引擎的。
sx: He studies French and web design.
他又学法语，又学怎么做网站。
What web browser do you like the most?
你最喜欢哪一个网络浏览器？

v.t: n. 葡萄酒, 果酒, 暗红色 / v. (请)喝酒
v.s: Some people like red wine and some people like white wine.
v.sz: 有人喜欢红酒，有人喜欢白酒。
sx: There is a bottle of wine on the table.
桌子上有一瓶葡萄酒。
If you like beer, you might like wine.
要是你喜欢啤酒，你可能喜欢葡萄酒。

v.t: n. 手臂, 袖子, 狭长港湾, 武器 / vt. 武装, 装备 / vi. 武装起来
v.s: I have a very sore arm where you hit me.
v.sz: 你打在我手臂上的地方超级痛。
sx: I lost my arm in the war.
我在战争中失去了手臂。
Please show me your injured arm.
请让我看看你受伤的手臂。

v.t: n. 听众, 观众, 读者
v.s: How large is the audience?
v.sz: 你估计听众有多少?
sx: However, some people in the audience were not pleased with the results.
尽管如此，观众中仍有些人不满意这个结果。
The Three Forks is a bar serving beer, and its target audience are travellers.
三把叉子是一家供应啤酒的酒吧，其目标客户是旅行者。

v.t: n. 核心, 果心, 要点 / vt. 挖...的核
v.s: I don't eat the core of an apple.
v.sz: 我不吃苹果核。
sx: My mum helps me remove the core of the plum.
妈妈帮我把李子去了核。
He is rotten to the core.
他坏透了。

v.t: a. 民主的
v.s: I hope for Taiwan to be a sovereign democratic country.
v.sz: 我希望台湾是主权独立的民主国家。
sx: Taiwan is a democratic country.
台湾是一个民主国家。

v.t: n. 描述, 说明, 种类
v.s: The beauty of the scene was beyond description.
v.sz: 那里的景色美得无法以笔墨形容。
sx: This description is too abstract.
这个描述太抽象了。
Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
你看过富士山吗? 它美得无法形容。

v.t: a. 优良的, 杰出的, 出色的
v.s: He was an excellent scientist, and what is more, was a great poet.
v.sz: 他是一位优秀的科学家，更是一位伟大的诗人。
sx: The weather is excellent today. Go for a walk.
今天天气不错，出去走走吧。
The service is excellent in this hotel.
这家酒店服务很好。

v.t: vi. 存在, 生存, 发生
v.s: Does objective history exist?
v.sz: 客观的历史存在吗？
sx: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.
你活着，但是却不知道为什么活着。
Note that the maximum doesn't always exist.
注意，最大值不总是存在的。

v.t: n. 守卫者, 警戒, 护卫队, 防护装置 / vt. 保卫, 看守, 当心 / vi. 防止, 警惕, 警卫, 看守
v.s: Be on your guard. He's not an easy one to fool.
v.sz: 要留神，他不容易受骗。
sx: I stand guard.
我站岗。
His bike ran into a guard-rail.
他的单车撞上了栏杆。

v.t: a. 诚实的, 坦直的, 可靠的
v.s: You are honest to admit your mistake.
v.sz: 你很诚实地承认了你的错误。
sx: So far as I know, he is an honest man.
据我所知，他是一个诚实的人。
I am sure that he is an honest man.
我确定他是个老实人。

v.t: n. 药, 医学, 内科 / vt. 给...用药
v.s: Write down the medicine you need on this piece of paper.
v.sz: 将你需要的药物写在这张纸上。
sx: Take this medicine in case you get sick.
万一你生病了，吃这个药。
I think this medicine will do you good.
我想这药会对您有好处的。

v.t: n. 提到, 言及, 陈述 / vt. 提到, 提及
v.s: Nuclear power plants are dangerous, not to mention nuclear weapons.
v.sz: 核电厂具危险性，更不用说核武器了。
sx: The radio didn't mention the incident.
电台没有提到这个事故。
That writer I mentioned a lot in the past passed away yesterday.
我以前多次向你谈起的那个作家昨天去世了。

v.t: n. 山, 山脉, 大堆
v.s: There is an old castle at the foot of the mountain.
v.sz: 山脚下有一座古老的城堡。
sx: Her house is at the foot of a mountain.
她家在一座山的山脚下。
There is a village over the mountain.
在山巅上有一个村庄。

v.t: a. 核子的, 原子能的, 核的, 中心的
v.s: This time, the nuclear test was a success.
v.sz: 这次核试验成功了。
sx: All of us would like to get rid of nuclear weapons.
我们所有的人都想除掉核子武器。
We can not be too careful in operating a nuclear power plant.
我们再怎么认真管理核电站也不为过。

v.t: n. 港口, 埠, 舱门, 避风港, 左舷, 炮眼, 姿势, 意义 / vt. 左转舵, 持(枪) / vi. 左转舵
v.s: Kobe is famous as a port city.
v.sz: 神户是一个著名的港口城市。
sx: The fishing boat which had been missing made a safe return to port.
消失了的渔船安全地回了港。
The fishing boat that had been missing returned to its port safely.
消失了的渔船安全地回了港。

v.t: n. 出席, 面前, 存在, 仪态, 风度
v.s: The red flag indicated the presence of danger.
v.sz: 红旗代表存在危险。
sx: I told you not to talk about the matter in her presence.
我跟你说过她在的时候不要说这件事。
John felt the presence of a ghost in the dark room.
约翰感觉到那黑漆漆的房间里有鬼。

v.t: n. 反应, 反作用, 反动
v.s: I love to watch people's reactions when I say who I am.
v.sz: 我喜欢观察人们在听到我说出我是谁时的反应。
sx: Let's see what the reaction is.
看看反应如何。
Reactions become faster at high temperatures.
在高温下反应会更快发生。

v.t: vt. 减少, 分解, 降低, 使衰退, 把...分解, 把...归纳 / vi. 减少, 减肥, 缩小
v.s: We must reduce energy demand.
v.sz: 我们必须降低能源需求。
sx: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
大量生产降低许多商品的价格。
I think we should reduce the price.
我觉得我们得调低价格。

v.t: n. 射击, 狩猎, 芽, 射伤, 发射, 发芽, 急流, 推力, 摄影, 急送, 滑运道, 浪费 / vt. 射击, 射中, 损毁, 拍摄, 喷出, 投射, 挥出, 飞速行进, 挥霍, 给...注射 / vi. 射出, 射击, 发出, 拍电影, 射门, 发芽
v.s: My camera can shoot high-definition video.
v.sz: 我的录像机可以拍高清视频。
sx: Don't shoot the devil in the back. You might miss.
别射撒旦的背部。你可能会射不中。
That was the only way we could defend ourselves against all this terrible shooting.
那是我们在枪林弹雨中自保的唯一方法。

v.t: n. 固体 / a. 坚硬的, 稳固的, 固体的, 实心的, 纯质的, 立体的, 立方的
v.s: Can you do me a solid?
v.sz: 可以帮我一个忙吗?
sx: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。

v.t: n. 运动, 游戏, 娱乐, 消遣, 玩笑 / a. 运动的, 户外穿戴的 / vi. 游戏, 参加体育运动, 戏弄, 产生变种 / vt. 炫耀, 使产生变种
v.s: I want to be a sport reporter.
v.sz: 我想当体育记者。
sx: A winter sport that many people enjoy is ice skating.
许多人爱好的一个冬季运动是溜冰。
He was able to put up remarkable performances at the sports competition.
他在运动会上的表现十分出色。

v.t: n. 压力, 紧迫, 强调, 重音, 重点, 应力 / vt. 加压力于, 着重, 重读
v.s: She is unable to cope with stress.
v.sz: 她无法应付压力。
sx: How do you relieve stress?
你怎么释放压力？
I exercise to relieve stress.
我通过运动来缓解压力。

v.t: n. 味道, 品味, 味觉, 感受, 体验, 爱好, 审美, 少量 / vt. 尝, 察觉...的味道, 体会 / vi. 品尝, 察觉味道, 有某种味道
v.s: The taste of wine is largely dependent upon the weather.
v.sz: 葡萄酒的味道很受天气影响。
sx: You might not like this beer at first. It's an acquired taste.
刚开始的时候你可能不会喜欢这个啤酒。这是需要多次品尝去习惯它的口味。
Do you want to have a taste?
你想尝一口吗？

v.t: n. 茶, 茶叶
v.s: You have a choice of black tea, coffee, or milk.
v.sz: 你可以选择红茶，咖啡或牛奶。
sx: I do not like tea, so I generally drink coffee for breakfast.
我不喜欢茶，所以我早餐大致上都喝咖啡。
Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?
你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？

v.t: n. 胜利, 战胜, 克服
v.s: At last, they experienced the joy of victory.
v.sz: 最后，他们感受到了胜利的喜悦。
sx: His victory at this age in an international competition is a good indication of a bright future.
他现在这个年纪，就已经在国际比赛中取胜，前途实在无可限量。
Victory and defeat aren't solely decided by the size of your army.
胜败不能单靠兵力多少。

v.t: n. 午后, 下午
v.s: It was very hot this afternoon.
v.sz: 今天下午非常炎热。
sx: From the look of the sky, it may rain in the afternoon.
从天色看起来，下午可能会下雨。
The weather will change for the worse this afternoon.
今天下午天气会变差。

v.t: n. 助手, 助理, 助教 / a. 有帮助的, 辅助的, 助理的
v.s: Who is the Administrative Assistant?
v.sz: 谁是行政助理？
sx: Old people were tricked by the shop assistant.
老人被店员骗了。
I need an assistant who speaks French.
我需要一个会说法语的助理。

v.t: n. 古典作品, 杰作, 大艺术家 / a. 第一流的, 最优秀的, 古典的
v.s: Several classic, family-friendly games will also join the service next month.
v.sz: 多款经典家庭游戏也将于下个月同步上架。

v.t: n. 衣服
v.s: The design of these clothes is indeed rather nice, but they are a little expensive.
v.sz: 这件衣服样式倒是挺好，就是贵了点儿。
sx: We need food, clothes and a home in order to live.
食物、衣服和住所都是生活的必需品。
Did you take the clothes out of the washing machine?
你把衣服从洗衣机里拿出来了吗？

v.s: I usually use a credit card instead of cash.
v.sz: 我经常用信用卡，而不是钞票。

v.t: a. 电的, 导电的, 电动的
v.s: My favourite musical instrument is the electric guitar.
v.sz: 我最喜欢的乐器是电吉他。
sx: I spilled jam on the electric outlet and there was a short circuit.
我把果酱撒到电源插座上短路了。
My father is an electric engineer.
我父亲是个电子工程师。

v.t: n. 紧急状况, 紧急事件, 紧急需要
v.s: You can contact me in case of emergency.
v.sz: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。
sx: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
In case of emergency, call 119.
在紧急情况下，可拨打 119。

v.t: adv. 完全, 全然, 一概
v.s: My opinion is entirely different from yours.
v.sz: 我的意见与您大相迳庭。
sx: That is not entirely wrong.
那不全是错的。
New York's Empire State Building is now running entirely on wind power.
纽约帝国大厦现在完全依靠风力发电。

v.t: n. 失败, 失败者, 不足, 缺乏, 破产
v.s: The project was a complete failure.
v.sz: 这个计划彻底的失败了。
sx: His failure is obvious.
他的失败是显而易见的。
His failure seems to have something to do with his character.
看来他的失败和他的性格有关。

v.t: a. 节日的, 喜庆的, 快乐的 / n. 节日, 庆祝, 欢宴
v.s: He will play the leading role for the first time in the next school festival.
v.sz: 这次校庆时，他将第一次做主角。
sx: Spring Festival is also known as Chinese New Year.
春节，即农历新年。
Does the mid-autumn festival fall on Monday this year?
今年中秋节是星期一吗？

v.t: a. 平坦的, 单调的, 无力的, 浅的, 萧条的, 干脆的, 无聊的 / adv. 平直地, 断然地 / n. 扁平物, 平面, 平地, 平原, 平板车 / v. (使)变平
v.s: It used to be thought that the earth was flat.
v.sz: 以前的人以为地球是平的。
sx: I had to push my bicycle because it had a flat tyre.
我得推我的自行车，因为有个轮胎漏气了。
I live in a flat in the city.
我住在城市中的一间公寓里。

v.t: n. 燃料, 木炭 / vt. 加燃料, 供燃料 / vi. 得到燃料
v.s: The fuel tank in the car is full.
v.sz: 汽车油箱是满的。
sx: Lignite is a fossil fuel.
褐煤是一种化石燃料。
There was a shortage of fuel.
燃料短缺。

v.t: interj. 喂, 嘿
v.s: Please say hello to your family on my behalf.
v.sz: 请代我向你的家人问好。
sx: Say hello to your father for me.
代我向你父亲问好。
Hello, girl with the red dress!
你好，红衣服的女生！

v.t: n. 疾病, 坏事, 罪恶, 灾难 / a. 生病的, 邪恶的, 不吉利的, 敌意的, 不良的, 不顺利的 / adv. 有害地, 不幸地, 几乎不
v.s: That she is ill is obvious.
v.sz: 显然地她生病了。
sx: Before you speak ill of people, look at yourself in the mirror.
在你说别人坏话之前，自己先照照镜子吧。
When I was a kid, I was often ill.
我小时候经常生病。

v.t: n. 字首, 首字母 / a. 开始的, 最初的, 字首的 / vt. 用姓名的首字母签名
v.s: What do the initials NTT stand for?
v.sz: NTT这个缩写是什么意思？

v.t: n. 踢, 反冲, 后座力, 凹底 / vi. 踢, 反抗, 反冲 / vt. 踢, 反冲
v.s: A punch is just a punch. A kick is just a kick.
v.sz: 出拳就是出拳。出脚就是出脚。
sx: Best case scenario, you get kicked out of the house.
即使最乐观而言，你也会被赶出这间房子。
I get a kick out of life.
我为人生感到很开心。

v.t: n. 邮件, 邮政, 邮递, 盔甲 / vt. 邮寄, 给...穿盔甲
v.s: Do you like to send it by air mail or by surface mail?
v.sz: 您寄航空还是海运？
sx: The mail train lost most of its mail in the fire.
那场火灾把邮车上的邮件烧掉了一大半。
Please mail this form to your insurance company.
请把这份表格寄给您的保险公司。

v.t: a. 大而重的, 宽大的, 宏伟的
v.s: This is the most massive structure I have ever seen.
v.sz: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。
sx: Hey, look! Look! There's a massive rainbow!
喏，快看快看！那有一道巨大的彩虹！

v.t: 移动电话
v.s: I need to charge my mobile phone.
v.sz: 我需要给手机充电。

v.t: n. 一双, 一对, 一副 / v. (使)成对
v.s: I want to buy a pair of pants.
v.sz: 我想买条裤子。
sx: I don't need anything... just a new pair of pants.
我什么都不需要……只要一条新裤子。
There is a pair of worn red stockings in the drawer.
抽屉里有一双穿过的红色丝袜。

v.t: n. 平面, 扁平物, 机翼, 飞机, 水准, 地位 / a. 平的, 平面的 / vt. 将...刨平, 刨平, 掠过水面 / vi. 翱翔, 乘飞机旅行, 刨掉
v.s: The plane was unable to take off due to the storm.
v.sz: 由于暴风雨的关系，飞机没能起飞。
sx: It will cost you more to go by plane.
搭飞机将花你比较多的钱。
How do people manage to sleep on the plane?
人们怎么能在飞机上睡觉？

v.t: n. 充分, 很多, 丰富 / a. 很多的, 足够的, 丰富的
v.s: Actually, the present method has plenty of room for improvement.
v.sz: 其实现时的方法还有很大的改善空间。
sx: He had plenty of fight left in him.
他的胸中还有足够的斗志。
He has plenty of money in the bank.
他在银行里有大量钱财。

v.t: n. 王子, 亲王, 国君, 贵族, 诸侯, 有权势的大人物
v.s: Prince William is second in line to the English throne.
v.sz: 威廉王子是英国王位第二顺位继承人。
sx: The prince was lost in the woods.
王子在森林中迷了路。
Prince Charles will be the next British king.
查尔斯王子将会是下一任英国国王。

v.t: a. 适当的, 固有的, 高尚的, 专属的 / adv. 完全地, 彻底地
v.s: A proper test does not allow the use of correction fluid.
v.sz: 正规的考试不允许使用涂改液。
sx: Bicycles wear out, of course, but with proper care they may be made to last a long time.
自行车当然会磨损，但只要你保养得好，就能骑很长一段时间。

v.t: conj. 以...为条件, 假如
v.s: Carlos is an employee who is committed to providing excellent customer service.
v.sz: 卡洛斯是一位致力于提供优质客服业务的员工。
sx: Of course you're the one providing, go!
当然是你提供，快去！

v.t: n. 四分之一, 一刻钟, 季度, 地区 / vt. 四等分, 肢解 / vi. 驻扎, 住宿
v.s: The winner of this quarter-final match will advance to the semi-final stage.
v.sz: 这场四分之一决赛的胜者将晋级半决赛。
sx: They advanced to the quarter-finals.
他们挺进了八强。
I have my supper at a quarter past seven.
我在七时十五分吃晚饭。

v.t: a. 地方的, 地域性的
v.s: Zeelandic is a regional language.
v.sz: 泽兰语是种地区语言。
sx: Drents is a group of variants of the Low Saxon regional language.
德伦特方言是低地撒克逊地区的一个方言群。

v.t: n. 期间, 开庭期, 会议, 学期
v.s: I'll keep the meeting notes to review them before the next session.
v.sz: 我会记会议笔记，下次会议前可以回顾一下。
sx: Are you taking tests on the next session?
下学期你要参加考试吗？

v.t: n. 形状, 形态, 外形, 形式, 身材 / vt. 定形, 使成形, 塑造, 计划, 使符合 / vi. 成形, 形成, 成长
v.s: The earth is similar to an orange in shape.
v.sz: 地球的外形和橙子相似。
sx: The fire spread out in a fan-shape.
火势以扇形迅速蔓延。
The mountain has a beautiful shape.
这座山有一个美丽的外形。

v.t: n. 天空, 天色, 天堂 / vt. 击向空中, 挂在高处 / vi. 高涨
v.s: From the look of the sky, it may rain in the afternoon.
v.sz: 从天色看起来，下午可能会下雨。
sx: There is a mass of dark clouds in the sky.
空中有一大片乌云。
