The sky will probably turn clear in the afternoon.
下午大概天转晴。

v.t: n. 教学, 学说, 教导
v.s: He has a lot of teaching experience.
v.sz: 他在教学上拥有丰富的经验。
sx: I don't think that Tom has any teaching experience.
我认为汤姆一点教学经验都没有。
I'd like to teach you Chinese in exchange for your teaching me another language.
我想用汉语交换另一种语言.

v.t: n. 迁移, 移动, 传递, 转让, 转移, 过户, 汇兑, 换车 / vt. 使转移, 调转, 调任, 改变, 传递, 转让 / vi. 转移, 转学, 转职, 换车
v.s: We will make the payment by bank transfer.
v.sz: 我们会用银行转帐付款。
sx: Do I need to transfer?
我需要换乘吗?
Is it convenient to transfer between the subway and the light rail here?
这儿要换地铁和轻轨方便吗？

v.t: a. 上面的, 较高的, 上级的, 上院的, 穿在外面的, 北部的, 地表的, 后期的 / n. 鞋帮, 上齿
v.s: The upper reaches of the river are very beautiful.
v.sz: 河的上游很美。
sx: Stiff upper lip!
坚持到底！
He thought he had the upper hand, but I turned the tables on him.
他觉得自己占了上风，但我反过来扭转了局面。

v.t: a. 有用的, 有益的
v.s: This is a useful book and, what is more, it is not expensive.
v.sz: 这本书很实用，而且价钱也很相宜。
sx: An uncle of mine gave me some useful advice.
我的一个叔叔给我了一些有用的建议。
This book may well be useful to you.
这本书对你有用。

v.t: n. 山谷, 溪谷, 流域, 凹地
v.s: It's time for the Tuaregs to transfer their herds to the valley.
v.sz: 图阿雷格人该把他们的牲畜转移到山谷去了。
sx: We went down to the valley where the village is.
我们下到山谷里，那里有个村庄。
Without music, the world is a valley of tears.
没有音乐，世界将变成一片泪谷。

v.t: a. 乐意的, 自愿的, 甘愿的
v.s: Would you be willing to show me how to do that?
v.sz: 你愿意告诉我怎么做吗？
sx: The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.
心有余而力不足。
Are you willing to go to the beach?
海滩上你到底愿意去吗？

v.t: n. 地带, 带, 地区 / vt. 环绕, 使分成地带 / vi. 分成区
v.s: You need to get out of your comfort zone.
v.sz: 你需要离开你的舒适区。
sx: It's like a war zone there.
那里就像战场一样。
That's a no-entry zone.
那一带是禁区。

v.t: n. 意外事件, 机遇, 事故, 次要方面
v.s: We have to make a close analysis of the accident.
v.sz: 我们要详细的分析一下意外发生的前因后果。
sx: You have only to read this article to see how serious the accident was.
你只要读读这篇文章，就能知道那意外有多严重。
He had an accident on his way home.
他在回家途中出了意外。

v.t: a. 在前的, 高级的, 先进的, 年老的
v.s: The military power of this country is very advanced.
v.sz: 这个国家的军事力量很先进。
sx: They advanced to the quarter-finals.
他们挺进了八强。
The squirrel advanced against the strong wind.
松鼠在前面顶著强风。

v.t: n. 两者择一, 供替代的选择 / a. 两者择一的, 供选择的
v.s: They had no alternative but to retreat.
v.sz: 他们不得不后撤。
sx: Don't include multiple alternative words inside the same sentence.
在同一句中不要包含多个可选单词。

v.t: adv. 无论何处
v.s: Did you go anywhere during the summer vacation?
v.sz: 这个暑假你有去哪儿玩吗?
sx: A GPS device can pinpoint your location anywhere in the world.
无论你在世界的哪一个角落，你都可以使用全球定位仪来找出你的所在。
You may go anywhere you like.
你喜欢去哪儿就可以去哪儿。

v.t: n. 熊 / vt. 忍受, 支承, 产生, 怀有, 通过卖空使跌价 / vi. 忍受, 结果实, 压挤, 行进, 转向
v.s: The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.
v.sz: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。
sx: They found the track of a bear in the snow.
他们在雪地里找到了熊的脚印。
Please bear with me until I finish the story.
请容许我把故事讲完。

v.t: n. 船 / vi. 乘船 / vt. 以船运
v.s: I want a boat that will take me far away from here.
v.sz: 我想要一艘船带我远离这里。
sx: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.
为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。
You can go there in a boat.
你可以坐船去那。

v.t: n. 容量, 能力, 才能, 资格
v.s: The room has a seating capacity of 200.
v.sz: 这个房间能容纳200人。
sx: The bus was filled to capacity.
这辆公车客满了。
Man has a great capacity to adapt to environmental changes.
人类适应环境变化的能力很强。

v.t: a. 便宜的, 不值钱的, 可鄙的 / adv. 便宜地
v.s: Do you know of a cheap hotel in the area?
v.sz: 您知道这附近有便宜的旅馆吗？
sx: It is strange that he should be put up at such a cheap hotel.
真奇怪，他竟然被安排入住这种廉价酒店。
This plastic chair is very cheap.
这把塑料椅子很便宜。

v.t: n. 气候, 社会趋势, 气候区
v.s: Do you think our climate has an influence on our character?
v.sz: 你觉得气候会不会影响人的性格呢？
sx: What is the climate on the island like?
岛上气候怎么样？
I can't adjust myself to the climate here.
我不能适应这里的气候。

v.t: n. 讨论
v.s: The focus of the discussion was unemployment.
v.sz: 讨论的重点是失业问题。
sx: Androgynous-looking people are often the subject of discussion and discrimination.
看起来不男不女的人常常受到议论和歧视。
They came up with a plan after a long discussion.
他们终于在漫长的讨论之后得出了一个计划。

v.t: n. 责任, 关税, 职务, 尊敬
v.s: You had better not smoke while on duty.
v.sz: 当你值勤时最好不要抽烟。
sx: Is this a duty-free shop?
这是一间免税商店吗？
As I am off duty today, let's go to the beach.
我今天不用当值，不如一起去海滩玩吧。

v.t: a. 奇妙的, 稀奇的, 空想的
v.s: In order to give him a surprise on his birthday, I prepared a fantastic cake.
v.sz: 为了给他生日惊喜，我准备了一个非常棒的蛋糕。
sx: Although he is not a singer, his singing voice is fantastic.
他虽然不是歌手，但他唱的非常优美。
You are fantastic.
你真是不可思议。

v.t: n. (美)州长, (英)总督, 统治者, 管理者, 理事
v.s: Everybody wished he had been elected governor.
v.sz: 每个人都希望他当选州长。

v.t: a. 工业的, 供工业用的, 工业高度发展的, 产业的 / n. 工业工人, 工业股票
v.s: She is an industrial designer.
v.sz: 她是工业设计师。
sx: It occurred to me that he might be an industrial spy.
我突然想到他可能是个商业间谍。
In China's agricultural and industrial areas, some people are still very poor.
在中国乡村和工业区，有的人还是很穷的。

v.t: n. 连接处, 接合, 关节 / a. 共同的, 联合的, 连接的, 合办的 / vt. 连接, 接合, 使有接头 / vi. 贴合, 长节
v.s: My joints ache when it gets cold.
v.sz: 当天气变冷的时候，我的关节疼痛。

v.t: n. 混合物, 混乱, 糊涂 / vt. 使混合, 弄混, 使结合, 混淆 / vi. 相混合, 交往, 参与
v.s: Oil does not mix with water.
v.sz: 油和水不能混在一起。
sx: I think you are mixed race, because you look a bit Chinese.
我以为你是混血，因为有点像中国人。
If you mix blue and red, you'll get purple.
如果将蓝色和红色混合，就会得到紫色。

v.t: n. 博物馆
v.s: Where is the entrance to the museum?
v.sz: 博物馆的入口在哪？
sx: You have to get on that bus to go to the museum.
要去博物馆，你就得乘那辆车。
How far is it from here to the museum?
这里离博物馆多远？

v.t: n. 路径, 小路, 道路, 途径, 路线, 轨道
v.s: Follow your own path and let people talk.
v.sz: 走自己的路，让别人去说吧。
sx: The path through the forest was completely covered in snow.
山林小道被雪完全覆盖住了。
Follow his path.
跟随他的道路。

v.t: n. 诺言, 约定的事情, 有指望 / vt. 允诺, 约定, 预示 / vi. 允诺, 有前途, 有指望
v.s: I promise you, we as a people will get there.
v.sz: 我向你们承诺——我们作为一个整体将会达成目标。
sx: When did she promise to meet him?
她答应几时见他？
I promise that I will do it.
我保证我会做的。

v.t: a. 被提议的；所推荐的
v.s: He proposed a reform in the educational system.
v.sz: 他提议对教育系统进行改革。
sx: She had been proposed to five times by the time she was twenty.
她二十岁的时候，就已经有五个人向她求过婚了。

v.t: n. 购买, 购买品, 紧握, 绞辘 / vt. 购买, 赢得, 努力取得, 用滑轮起(锚等)
v.s: They are saving their money for the purchase of a house.
v.sz: 他们在储钱买房子。
sx: Your plan to purchase another PC will not be a problem at all.
您购买另一台电脑的计划完全不会有问题。
I would like to purchase some boots.
我想买些靴子。

v.t: n. 雨, 下雨, 雨天 / vi. 下雨 / vt. 使大量落下
v.s: In spite of the heavy rain, he decided to go out.
v.sz: 虽然下着大雨，但是他还是决定了要出外。
sx: He closed the window for fear of rain.
他怕会下雨，所以就把窗关上了。
They started in spite of the heavy rain.
他们冒着倾盆大雨出发了。

v.t: vt. 移动, 调动, 除去, 迁移, 开除, 移交 / vi. 迁移, 移动, 搬家 / n. 班级, 升级, 移动, 搬家, 间距
v.s: Please remove that chair because it is in the way.
v.sz: 请把椅子拿走，它挡著道儿了。
sx: Remove the battery.
卸下电池。
Do you have anything to remove stains?
你有除锈的东西吗？

v.t: n. 钢, 钢制品, 钢铁, 坚硬, 坚固 / a. 钢的, 钢制的, 钢铁业的, 坚强的 / vt. 使坚强, 钢化, 使冷酷
v.s: According to an estimate, steel production will reach 100 million tons this year.
v.sz: 一项估计显示，今年的钢鉄产量将会达到一亿吨。
sx: Steel is a key industry.
钢铁是重点产业。
There are daisies next to the steel building.
在钢铁大厦的旁边有许多的雏菊。

v.t: a. 可怕的, 令人恐惧的, 极坏的
v.s: I had a terrible dream last night.
v.sz: 昨晚我作了一个可怕的梦。
sx: It is terrible weather today.
今天天气很差。
The heat is terrible today.
今天非常酷热。

v.t: a. 疲累的, 疲乏的, 厌倦的
v.s: I was too tired to care for anything but bed.
v.sz: 我累得只想躺在床上。
sx: Though I am tired, I will work hard.
虽然我很累，但我也会努力工作的。
As you are tired, you had better rest.
你累了，最好休息一下。

v.t: a. 暖和的, 暖的, 温暖的, 热烈的, 兴奋的, 激烈的, 多情的, 色情的 / vt. 使温暖, 弄热, 使兴奋, 使充满仇恨 / vi. 变暖和, 变温暖, 取暖, 激动, 同情, 爱好 / n. 暖, 保暖物
v.s: The air was warm.
v.sz: 空气暖暖的。
sx: When they were in Leicester, it was obvious that they had a very warm relationship.
在莱斯特的时候很明显她们有很热烈的关系。
I want to eat warm soup.
我想喝点儿热汤。

v.t: a. 害怕的, 恐怕的, 遗憾的
v.s: The girl was afraid to jump down from the roof.
v.sz: 小女孩害怕从屋顶上跳下来。
sx: I am afraid that I shall not be free till the examination is over.
恐怕直到考试结束前我都没空。
I was afraid I might be late.
我怕我可能迟到了。

v.t: n. 啤酒
v.s: There is nothing like cold beer on a hot day.
v.sz: 炎炎夏日来杯冰凉的啤酒，人生一乐也！
sx: If you like beer, you might like wine.
要是你喜欢啤酒，你可能喜欢葡萄酒。
Would you care for another glass of beer?
再来一杯啤酒怎么样？

v.t: n. 边缘, 边境, 边界, 花坛 / vt. 在...上镶边, 接近 / vi. 接界, 近似
v.s: This is a small border town.
v.sz: 这是一座边境小城。
sx: On the border, there is a stretch of agricultural land.
边境上有一片农业区。
There are often border conflicts between these two countries.
这两个国家经常发生边境冲突。

v.t: n. 命令, 指挥, 控制, 部队, 司令部 / v. 命令, 指挥, 控制
v.s: Do you know how to use these command line tools?
v.sz: 你知道怎样使用这些命令行工具吗？
sx: He commanded me to leave the room immediately.
他命令我立刻离开这个房间。
Take control of the command post.
掌管指挥所。

v.t: n. 全体人员, 一群人, 全体队员 / crow的过去式
v.s: Modern ships only need a small crew.
v.sz: 现代船只只需要一小组的船员。

v.t: n. 群众, 一伙人 / vt. 拥挤, 挤满, 挤进
v.s: There is a crowd of people in front of the town hall.
v.sz: 市政大厅前有一群人。
sx: She lost sight of her friend in the huge crowd.
她在人群里看不到她的朋友了。
We lost sight of the man in the crowd.
在人群中，我们失去了那个男人的踪影。

v.t: n. 敌人, 仇敌, 敌军 / a. 敌人的
v.s: We need to band together to beat the enemy.
v.sz: 我们必须团结起来才能战胜敌人。
sx: I know who my enemy is.
我知道谁是我的敌人。
I think it is my enemy.
我认为它是我的敌人。

v.t: vt. 确定, 保证, 担保, 保护
v.s: I want to ensure my phone has good customer support.
v.sz: 我想要确定手机能有优秀的客户服务。
sx: Everyone can help ensure that sentences sound correct, and are correctly spelled.
每个人都可以协助确保句子念起来正确且拼写正确。
Parents often sacrifice themselves to ensure that their children receive a good education.
父母为了确保孩子受到良好的教育常常牺牲自己。

v.t: a. 周围的, 环境的
v.s: Which is more important, economic development or environmental protection?
v.sz: 发展经济和保护环境哪一个更重要?
sx: We had a lecture on environmental pollution.
我们有一节关于环境污染的讲座。
What about the environmental impact?
那环境影响呢？

v.t: a. 固定的, 不变的
v.s: He fixed himself a cup of tea.
v.sz: 他给自己泡了杯茶。
sx: I'm glad that they fixed the heating system, but now it's too hot.
我很高兴他们修复了暖气系统，但现在太热了。
I fixed my car last month, but it broke again afterwards.
我的车我上个月修好了，后来又坏了。

v.t: n. 森林, 林区 / vt. 植树于
v.s: The boy lost his way in the forest.
v.sz: 小男孩在森林中迷路了。
sx: The horse is in the forest.
马在林中。
The path through the forest was completely covered in snow.
山林小道被雪完全覆盖住了。

v.t: n. 智力, 情报, 信息
v.s: AI means Artificial Intelligence.
v.sz: AI是人工智能的略称。
sx: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.
自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。
Your intelligence is as vast as the distance between Bombay and Mumbai.
你的智慧广大的有如孟买和孟买之间的距离。

v.t: n. 劳动, 努力, 工作, 劳工, 分娩 / vi. 劳动, 努力, 苦干 / vt. 详细分析, 使厌烦
v.s: I'm unable to do manual labour.
v.sz: 我不能做体力劳动。

v.t: n. 界限, 边界, 限度, 极限, 限制 / vt. 限制, 限定
v.s: Limit the consumption of white sugar and salt.
v.sz: 限制白糖和盐的摄取量。
sx: How can a router be used to limit network speed?
怎么用路由器限制网速？
The fact that television frequently limits communication within families is already well known.
电视限制家庭成员的沟通的事实已经广为人知。

v.t: n. 月亮, 月球, 月光 / vi. 闲荡 / vt. 虚度
v.s: Without air there can be no wind or sound on the moon.
v.sz: 月球表面没有空气，所以没有风，也没有声音。
sx: Since there is no air on the moon, there is no sound at all.
月球上没有空气，也自然没有声音。
The moon is pretty in the fall.
秋天的月亮是美丽的。

v.t: n. 海洋, 广阔, 许多, 一大片
v.s: Swimming in the sea does not mean you own the ocean.
v.sz: 在海里游泳并不意味著就拥有大海。
sx: There is sand at the bottom of the ocean.
海洋底部有沙子。
The effects of the atmosphere and ocean on the environment are very important.
大气与海洋对于地球环境的影响十分重大。

v.t: n. 利润, 赢利, 利益 / vi. 有益, 获利, 赚钱 / vt. 有益于
v.s: He is making use of the collective's name for his own profit.
v.sz: 他在利用集体的名义，为自己谋利。
sx: Someone else profits from the situation.
渔人得利。
A wise man profits from his mistakes.
聪明人会从自己的错误中受益。

v.t: n. 证据, 证明, 试验, 检验, 考验 / a. 不能透入的, 证明用的, 防...的, 耐...的 / vt. 检验, 试验, 校对, 使不被穿透
v.s: Just as if that was proof that that was correct English.
v.sz: 就好像那证明了英语是正确的。
sx: This watch is shock-proof.
这手表有防震功能。
There is no video proof.
没有录像证据。

v.t: n. 套装, 诉讼, 请求, 起诉, 套, 组 / vt. 适合, 使适应 / vi. 合适, 相称
v.s: When will it suit you to start?
v.sz: 你什么时候出发最方便？
sx: Any time will suit me.
任何时间我都可以。
Your short hair suits you.
短发很适合你。

v.t: n. 出现, 露面, 外观, 外表, 出版
v.s: His sudden appearance surprised us all.
v.sz: 他的突然出现，让我们都感到惊讶。
sx: Judging from his appearance, he must be a rich man.
从他的外表来看，他应该是个有钱人。
An eclipse of the sun is a rare appearance.
日蚀只会偶尔发生。

v.t: n. 代理人, 律师
v.s: Does Tom have an attorney?
v.sz: 汤姆有请律师吗？

v.t: n. 椅子, 显要的席位, 主席 / vt. 使入座, 使就任要职
v.s: Please remove that chair because it is in the way.
v.sz: 请把椅子拿走，它挡著道儿了。
sx: Your chair is similar to mine.
你的椅子和我的很像。
Put the chair in front of the desk.
把椅子放在桌子前面。

v.t: n. 债务, 罪过
v.s: All you have to do is ask him to pay the debt.
v.sz: 你只需要喊他还债就行。
sx: I am free of debt.
我没有外债。
The family is too poor to pay back the debts.
这个家庭非常贫穷以至于无法偿还贷款。

v.t: a. 家庭的, 国内的, 驯养的
v.s: I wrote a post to my blog encouraging men to report experiences with domestic abuse.
v.sz: 我在部落格上发表了一篇文章，鼓励男性举报自己遭受家庭虐待的经历。

v.t: a. 贵的, 奢华的, 费用浩大的, 乱化钱的
v.s: Your watch is more expensive than mine.
v.sz: 你的手表比我的贵。
sx: The design of these clothes is indeed rather nice, but they are a little expensive.
这件衣服样式倒是挺好，就是贵了点儿。
The car is too expensive for me to buy.
那辆车子太贵了，我买不起。

v.t: a. 历史的, 史实的, 历史上的
v.s: This is a city of real historical value.
v.sz: 这是一个具有历史价值的城市。
sx: The story approximates to historical truth.
故事与历史真相接近。

v.t: adv. 真诚地, 公正地
v.s: It is a matter of principle with him to answer your questions honestly.
v.sz: 诚实地回答你的问题对他来说是个原则问题。
sx: Honestly, I really like you.
说实在的，我真的喜欢你。
I may look strong, but I'm honestly not.
我看上去像是很有力气的人，可实际上并非如此。

v.t: n. 跳跃, 跳动, 暴涨, 惊跳 / vt. 跳跃, 跃过, 突升, 使跳跃 / vi. 跳跃, 跳, 跳动, 暴涨
v.s: The girl was afraid to jump down from the roof.
v.sz: 小女孩害怕从屋顶上跳下来。
sx: I need to jump start my car.
我需要助推起动我的车。
Jump as high as you can.
你会跳多高，就跳多高。

v.t: n. 下水, 汽艇, 发射 / vt. 使下水, 发射, 发动 / vi. 起飞, 下水, 投入, 开始
v.s: They are going to launch an artificial satellite tomorrow.
v.sz: 明天将要发射一颗人造卫星。
sx: The investigation has been launched.
已展开调查。
An investigation was launched.
已展开调查。

v.t: a. 最小的, 最低的 / n. 最小值
v.s: What is the minimum wage in Georgia?
v.sz: 请问乔治亚洲的最低工资是多少？
sx: The minimum wage in Okinawa is 642 yen per hour.
冲绳的最低时薪是每小时642日元。

v.t: n. 本地人, 土产, 当地人 / a. 本国的, 与生俱来的, 自然的
v.s: My native language is the most beautiful gift from my mother.
v.sz: 我的母语是我从我母亲那里得到的最美好的礼物。
sx: What is your native language?
你的母语是什么？
English is not my native language.
英语不是我的母语。

v.t: adv. 本来, 原来, 最初, 就起源而论, 独创地
v.s: The room originally had no furniture.
v.sz: 本来这间房间里没有家具。
sx: I find this problem easier than I originally thought.
我发现问题比我原以为的容易。
Originally, I knew nothing about it at all!
我本来什么也不知道啊！

v.t: adv. 突然, 意外, 忽然, 迅速, 即席作成, 即刻, 急速
v.s: I don't know at all why he quit his job suddenly.
v.sz: 我完全不明白他为甚么会突然辞职。
sx: I suddenly thought of my dead mother.
我忽然想起了我死去的妈妈。
Suddenly my computer stopped working.
突然我的电脑就坏了。

v.t: n. 纵览, 视察, 测量, 俯瞰, 调查 / vt. 审视, 视察, 俯瞰, 通盘考虑 / vi. 测量土地
v.s: A recent survey shows that the number of smokers is decreasing.
v.sz: 最近的一项调查显示吸烟的人数减少了。

v.t: n. 使用者
v.s: If only I read the user manual properly.
v.sz: 要是当时有好好读说明书就好了。
sx: The service plan you choose will affect your user experience. Please be sure to compare the details carefully.
您选择的服务方案将影响您的使用体验，请务必仔细比较细节。
My friend is designing a user interface for the new operating system.
我的朋友正在为新的操作系统设计一个用户界面。

v.t: n. 作家, 撰稿者, 抄写员
v.s: I respect him as a writer and as a man.
v.sz: 我尊重他这位作家，也尊重他这个人。
sx: The writer is working on a new book.
那个作家正在写新书。
Professional writers do not have a regular income.
专职作家没有固定的收入。

v.t: n. 黄色 / a. 黄色的
v.s: These green leaves turn red or yellow in fall.
v.sz: 这些绿叶到秋天变成红色或黄色。
sx: The door of the office is yellow.
办公室的门是黄色的。
My heart is green and yellow.
我的心是绿色和黄色的。

v.t: a. 古代的, 古老的, 年老的, 旧的
v.s: I wish I could see the ancient world.
v.sz: 我真想看看古代的世界是怎样的。
sx: This is an ancient castle.
这是一座古老的城堡。
Astronomy is at the same time the most ancient and the most modern science.
天文学同时是最古老也最现代的科学。

v.t: n. 交流, 交通, 通讯
v.s: The communication of news by TV and radio is very common now.
v.sz: 这个年代用电视和收音机报道新闻已是十分平常的事了。
sx: This is a fast and effective way of communication.
这是快速且有效的交流方式。
It’s a communication medium, not a substance or specific activity.
网络是一个相通的渠道，而不是物质或具体的活动。

v.t: n. 电子信函
v.s: Write me a letter or send me an email sometimes!
v.sz: 请偶尔给我写信或传电子邮件。
sx: I will send it by email this afternoon.
我今天下午用电邮发。
Can you please copy me on that email?
那封邮件可以 CC 我吗？

v.t: n. 行使, 执行, 运动, 练习, 作业 / vt. 运用, 练习, 运动 / vi. 练习, 锻炼
v.s: People living in a big city tend to lack exercise.
v.sz: 住在大城市的人们一般都缺乏锻炼。
sx: I exercise to relieve stress.
我通过运动来缓解压力。
The best way to lose weight is to eat less and exercise more.
最好的减肥方法就是少吃多运动。

v.t: n. 快车, 快递, 专使 / a. 明确的, 丝毫不差的, 专门的, 快的 / vt. 表达, 表示, 表露
v.s: The express train will take you between major cities non-stop.
v.sz: 特快火车会带着你在主要城市穿梭，期间不停。
sx: You can express the sentence this way.
你可以用这种方式表达这句话。
Express yourself as clearly as possible.
尽可能明确地表达你自己。

v.t: n. 流程, 流动, 流量, 洋溢, 泛滥, 涨潮 / vi. 流动, 流泄, 畅流, 川流不息, 飘扬, 涌出 / vt. 使流动, 淹没, 流出
v.s: The flow of the water was strong enough to wash away the bridge.
v.sz: 水流的强力把桥给冲垮了。
sx: The immigrants entered the country in a steady flow.
移民川流不息地进入这个国家。
Though tears may flow down your face, I won't look back.
任凭眼泪在你脸上滑过，我头也不回。

v.t: n. 女朋友
v.s: Is your computer more important to you than your girlfriend?
v.sz: 电脑对你来说比女朋友还重要吗？
sx: Do you know if he has a girlfriend?
你知道他有没有女朋友吗？
I hear you have a new girlfriend.
听说你有新女朋友了。

v.t: n. 英雄, 超越常人者, 男主角
v.s: We need a hero.
v.sz: 我们需要英雄。
sx: He dreamed of being a hero.
他梦想着成为一名英雄。
We had thought that he was a hero, but he turned out to be a traitor.
我们以为他是一个英雄，原来是一个叛徒。

v.t: a. 违法的, 不合规定的
v.s: I am suspicious that this is an illegal taxi.
v.sz: 我怀疑这是辆黑车。
sx: It is illegal for bicycles to pass on the right of cars.
自行车从右侧超过汽车是不合法的。
It's illegal to park your car here.
把车停在这里是违法的。

v.t: n. 笑话, 玩笑, 笑柄 / v. 开玩笑, 取笑, 作弄
v.s: We thought his threat was only a joke.
v.sz: 我们觉得他的威胁只是一个玩笑。
sx: Why did you tell this joke?
你为什么要讲这个笑话呢？
That was a joke, of course.
当然，这只是个玩笑。

v.t: n. 贷款, 借出 / v. 借, 供应货款, 借给
v.s: You can get a loan from a bank.
v.sz: 你可以从银行贷款。
sx: The government will provide interest-free loans to firms that participate in the program.
政府将会对参与该项计划的企业提供无息贷款。
I told Tom I'd be willing to loan him some money.
我告诉汤姆我愿意借给他一些钱。

v.t: n. 行星, 命运星辰, 杰出的人, 重大影响的事
v.s: The Moon is not a planet, but a satellite of the Earth.
v.sz: 月球不是一颗行星，而是地球的一颗卫星。
sx: Every girl on the planet is different.
世界上的女孩都不同。
So you come from another planet?
所以你来自另外一个星球？

v.t: n. 餐馆, 饭店
v.s: The small restaurant of today may be a big hotel tomorrow.
v.sz: 今天的小饭馆明天就可以变成大饭店了。
sx: The service in this restaurant is none too fast.
这餐厅的服务一点效率也没有。
Do you know of any good restaurant near here?
你知道这儿附近有什么好餐馆吗?

v.t: n. 买东西, 购物
v.s: Did you check all the items on the shopping list?
v.sz: 你把购物单上的全都检查过了吗？
sx: I will do the shopping for her birthday.
我要去给她生日买点东西。
Would you like to go shopping with me?
你想和我一起去逛街吗？

v.t: a. 软的, 温和的, 柔和的, 柔滑的, 温柔的, 软弱的, 坡度小的, 笨的, 纸币的 / n. 柔软的东西, 笨人, 纸币 / adv. 柔软地, 温和地
v.s: She was a tall, thin girl with long, soft brown hair.
v.sz: 她是个又高又瘦, 留著一头又长又软的褐色头发的女孩。
sx: I only buy super soft toilet paper.
我只买超柔软的卫生纸。
After taking a bath, I drank some soft drink.
我洗完澡之后喝了点汽水。

v.t: n. 糖, 糖块, 甜言蜜语 / vt. 加糖于, 使甜蜜, 粉饰, 美化 / vi. 制成糖
v.s: Limit the consumption of white sugar and salt.
v.sz: 限制白糖和盐的摄取量。
sx: To make a cake, you need egg, butter and sugar.
要做蛋糕，你要用到鸡蛋，黄油和糖。
Put in a little more sugar.
多放一点糖。

v.t: a. 感到惊讶的
v.s: To be surprised, to wonder, is to begin to understand.
v.sz: 感到惊讶、感到惊奇就是明白的开始。
sx: You must have been surprised to find me alone with her yesterday.
昨天你发现我单独跟她在一块儿应该感到很惊讶吧。
You must have been surprised to meet your teacher in such a place.
在那种地方碰到你的老师，你应该很惊讶吧。

v.t: n. 运输, 运输工具, 激动, 狂喜, 流放犯 / vt. 传送, 运输, 流放
v.s: Many goods are now transported by air.
v.sz: 如今很多的货物都由飞机运送。
sx: The government transported goods to the island by helicopter.
政府用直升机把物资送到了那个小岛。
This truck transports fresh food from Aomori to Tokyo.
这辆卡车从青森运输新鲜食品到东京。

v.t: n. 恳求, 诉请, 上诉, 吸引力 / vi. 呼吁, 诉请, 要求, 上诉, 有吸引力 / vt. 将...上诉
v.s: His music and words appeal to young people.
v.sz: 他的曲和词都很受年轻人欢迎。
sx: Between you and me, Tom's idea doesn't appeal to me very much.
汤姆的主意我不太感兴趣，这个我们之间说说就好。
Tom appealed to his mother to buy a new toy for him.
汤姆请求妈妈给他买新玩具。

v.t: a. 适当的
v.s: Local people can give appropriate advice.
v.sz: 当地人可以给予适切的建议。
sx: Do you think it's appropriate to talk like that?
你觉得说这种话合适吗？
I need to configure this server with an appropriate firewall system.
我该在这个服务器上设置一个防火墙。

v.t: n. 装置, 设计, 策略, 发明物, 设备
v.s: This is an old device.
v.sz: 这是台旧设备。
sx: This device made it possible to turn sea-water into fresh water easily.
有了这个装置，把海水净化成淡水就不是难事了。
This electrical device must have been damaged during delivery.
这个电子仪器肯定在运输途中损坏了。

v.t: n. 戏剧, 戏剧艺术
v.s: The new TV drama is quite interesting.
v.sz: 这部新电视剧挺有意思的。
sx: I'm studying English drama.
我正在学习英文戏剧。
Do you watch Korean dramas?
你看韩国剧吗？

v.t: n. 登录, 条目, 进入, 入口, 报关
v.s: Entry of pool is prohibited.
v.sz: 禁止入池。
sx: I gave my daughter an entry ticket to the concert for her birthday.
我送了我女儿一张音乐会门票作为生日礼物。
Her smooth entry into the ranks of the royal family will help to dispel these fears.
证实她顺利地过渡入皇室组织，有帮于消除这些焦虑。

v.t: n. 时代, 纪元, 时期
v.s: We are in the era of atomic energy.
v.sz: 我们身在原子能时代。
sx: We're delighted to bring this game back for the start of a new era for the series.
我们很高兴能再次推出这款游戏，并为系列作品开启全新的阶段。
In the era of email, I'm so happy when a friend sends me a real letter.
在这个电邮的年代里，我一收到朋友寄给我的信，就会高兴得不得了。

v.t: n. 因素, 因数, 系数, 基因, 代理人
v.s: Honesty was the most important factor in his success.
v.sz: 诚实是他成功最重要的因素。
sx: Capital, land and labor are the three key factors of production.
资本、土地和劳动是生产的三大要素。
Another factor to be taken into consideration is that the present situation is favourable to us.
将要考虑的另一个重要因素是，目前的情况对我们有利。

v.t: n. 饲料, 一餐, 饲养 / vt. 喂, 饲养, 放牧, 靠...为生 / vi. 吃东西, 用餐, 流入
v.s: I feed my cat every morning and every evening.
v.sz: 每天早晚，我给我的猫喂食。
sx: Did you feed the dog this morning?
你今天早上喂过狗了吗？
I feed my dog once a day.
我每天喂一次狗。

v.t: a. 金的, 含金的, 金色的, 贵重的, 繁盛的
v.s: Speech is silver, but silence is golden.
v.sz: 雄辩如银，沉默如金。
sx: The Golden Age of the Romans is in the past.
罗马人的黄金时代已过去了。
Silence is golden.
沉默是金。

v.t: n. 授予, 授予物, 允许 / vt. 允许, 承认, 授与
v.s: Even if I grant that what you say is true, it is no excuse.
v.sz: 即使我承认你说的是真的，但这并不是借口。
sx: We take it for granted that he will succeed in his business.
我们认为他的生意理所当然会获得成功。
The teacher granted me permission to go home early.
老师允许我提前回家。

v.t: n. 律师
v.s: I intend to become a lawyer.
v.sz: 我有志成为一名律师。
sx: I know a good lawyer who can help you.
我认识一个不错的律师，他可以帮你。
Lawyers will urge the parents to take further legal action.
律师们会力劝家长们采取进一步的法律行动。

v.t: n. 错误, 误会 / vi. 犯错, 误认 / vt. 误解, 弄错
v.s: I could not convince him of his mistake.
v.sz: 我没能让他认识到错误。
sx: The source of many of our mistakes is a lack of patience.
许多错误源自于我们缺乏耐心。
Correct the mistake and return the file to Mr Luxemburg.
请把错误改正过来，然后把文件夹还给 Luxemburg 先生。

v.t: n. 站台, 月台, 讲台, 论坛, 平台
v.s: Please mind the gap between the train and the platform.
v.sz: 请小心月台与车厢之间的空隙。
sx: Take the express train from platform 9.
在9号站台乘坐快车。
He walked back and forth on the platform while waiting for the train.
他一边等火车，一边在月台上走来走去。

v.t: n. 池, 水塘, 石油层, 联营 / vt. 合伙经营, 共享, 采掘, 汇聚成 / vi. 汇合成塘, 淤积, 联营
v.s: In the summer I go to the pool every day.
v.sz: 夏天的时候，我每天都去游泳池。
sx: If you stay at a big hotel, you can use their swimming pool.
若你住到的是大的旅馆，就能使用他们的游泳池。
The swimming pool is open to the public.
泳池是对公众开放的。

v.t: n. 路径, 途径, 路线 / vt. 确定路线, 按规定路线发送
v.s: What is the most convenient route to your place?
v.sz: 去您那儿怎么走最方便？
sx: Luckily, we found an escape route.
幸运的是，我们找到了逃生通道。

v.t: n. 时间表, 一览表, 计划表, 议事日程 / vt. 预定, 编制目录, 制...表, 安排
v.s: Please let me know the schedule beforehand.
v.sz: 请你事先把计划告诉我。
sx: The bus was behind schedule.
公交车迟到了。
Please show me the schedule.
请让我看一下日程安排！

v.t: a. 科学的, 系统的, 符合科学规律的
v.s: Your theory has no scientific basis.
v.sz: 你的理论并没有科学根据。
sx: Most scientific breakthroughs are nothing else than the discovery of the obvious.
多数科学突破只不过是发现了显而易见的事。
The book is full of far-flung theories without any basis in scientific fact.
书中满是遥不可及、没有科学根据的理论。

v.t: n. 烟, 雾气, 烟熏剂, 抽烟, 烟色 / vi. 吸烟, 冒烟, 弥漫 / vt. 以烟熏, 抽烟而导致...
v.s: It has been found that smoking is bad for your health.
v.sz: 查出了抽烟对身体不好。
sx: I wish I could break the habit of smoking.
真希望自己能把烟瘾戒掉。
Smoking one cigarette a day is a good habit.
每天吸一根香烟是个好习惯。

v.t: n. 班, 小队, 小集团 / vt. 编成班
vt. 教, 讲授, 教导, 教育 / vi. 教书, 教学, 可以教
v.s: To know a language is one thing, and to teach it is another.
v.sz: 知道一门语言是一回事，教这门语言又是另一回事。
sx: He has a lot of teaching experience.
他在教学上拥有丰富的经验。
He has little experience in teaching.
他没有甚么教学经验。

v.t: n. 滥用, 虐待, 恶习, 辱骂 / vt. 滥用, 辱骂, 虐待
v.s: We can only abuse of things that are good.
v.sz: 我们只能滥用善良的。
sx: When it comes to drugs, there's a very fine line between use and abuse.
用药和滥药只差一线。
He was arrested for abusing public funds.
他因滥用公共基金而被捕。

v.t: a. 生气的, 愤怒的
v.s: He must be very angry to say such a thing.
v.sz: 他一定是十分生气了，不然他不会说出这样的话来的。
sx: Would you rather lie than make him angry?
你宁愿说谎也不愿让他生气吗？
You have good reason to be angry.
你有充分的理由生气。

v.t: n. 候选人, 投考者
v.s: Strange to say, no one voted for the candidate.
v.sz: 奇怪的是，谁也没有投那候选人一票。
sx: Ideally, a candidate for this job should have four years' work experience.
我们希望应聘者能有4年工作经验。

v.t: a. 舒服的, 轻松的 / n. 盖被
v.s: My room is comfortable, if it is a little small.
v.sz: 我的房间很舒适, 即使它小了一点。
sx: This chair is really comfortable to sit on.
这个椅子坐着真舒服。
I am quite comfortable in this room.
在这个房间里我很舒服。

v.t: n. 关心, 忧虑 / vt. 与...有关, 使担心, 使挂念
v.s: Concerning this word, each expert has a different point of view.
v.sz: 对这个词，专家们各有不同的看法。
sx: My primary concern is your safety.
我最关心的是你的安全。
Concerning this matter... I really don’t know.
关于这件事......我真的不知道。

v.t: vt. 讨论, 论述
v.s: I am not in a situation to discuss this problem.
v.sz: 我不在讨论这个问题的状态。
sx: I want to discuss the price with you.
我想和你谈谈价钱。
In the previous meeting, we already discussed the organizational problem within our company.
在上次会议中我们已经讨论了我们集团的组织问题。

v.t: a. 情绪的, 情感的
v.s: It is not good for a scientist to get emotional.
v.sz: 对一个科学家来说，多愁善感是不好的。
sx: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.
我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。
I didn't mean to get emotional.
我没想要情绪化。

v.t: adv. 各处, 到处
v.s: They talk about it everywhere.
v.sz: 他们到处谈论它。
sx: If I were rich, I would go travelling everywhere.
要是我很有钱的话，我就会到处去旅游。
God is everywhere.
神无处不在。

v.t: n. 孔, 洞, 穴, 漏洞 / vt. 挖洞, 掘坑 / vi. 进洞, 凿洞
v.s: There is a hole in your sock.
v.sz: 你的袜子上有个洞。
sx: How deep is the hole?
这个洞多深?
The child has picked a hole in his new jumper.
孩子的新毛衣上勾了一个洞。

v.t: n. 假日, 假期, 节日 / vi. 度假
v.s: She was happy to come, but she was on holiday.
v.sz: 她很乐意前来，但是她在休假。
sx: Why is the summer holiday not here already!
暑假怎么还不快点来啊。
Certainly they will go on holiday next month.
他们下个月一定会去度假。

v.t: a. 内在的, 国内的
v.s: The button battery in the PC's internal timer has gone flat.
v.sz: 电脑内部计时器内的纽扣电池没电了。

v.t: n. 笑, 笑声 / vi. 笑, 大笑 / vt. 以笑表示
v.s: First they laugh at you, then they fight you, and then you win.
v.sz: 首先他们嘲笑你，其次他们和你争执，然后你赢了。
sx: We must not laugh at the poor.
我们不能嘲笑穷人。
The president laughed in spite of himself.
总统不由自主地笑了起来。

v.t: n. 腿, 假腿, 路程 / vi. 走, 跑
v.s: Raise your leg.
v.sz: 把你的腿抬起来
sx: My leg was broken in a traffic accident.
我在一场交通意外中折断了腿。
His leg was put in a cast.
他的腿打了石膏。

v.t: n. 自由主义者 / a. 慷慨的, 不拘泥的, 宽大的, 自由主义的
n. 午餐
v.s: Will you have time to have lunch with me?
v.sz: 你有时间跟我吃午饭吗？
sx: We had an early lunch at school.
我们在学校有一个早午餐。
What will you have for lunch today?
你今天午餐吃什么？

v.t: n. 奶, 乳状物 / vt. 挤乳, 榨取 / vi. 产乳
v.s: Is the milk cold, or still hot?
v.sz: 这牛奶是冷的还是热的？
sx: You have a choice of black tea, coffee, or milk.
你可以选择红茶，咖啡或牛奶。
There was only a little milk left in the bottle.
瓶子里只剩下一丁点牛奶。

v.t: n. 包裹, 一伙, 一副, 背包, 包装 / vt. 包装, 捆扎, 塞满, 压紧, 挑选 / vi. 包装货物, 挤, 群集, 被包装
v.s: The room was jam-packed with reporters waiting for the press conference to begin.
v.sz: 房间挤满了等待发布会开始的记者。
sx: My father smokes a pack of cigarettes a day.
我爸爸每天抽一包烟。
Kyoto is packed with people during the holiday season.
佳节时期，京都人山人海。

v.t: n. 付款, 支付的款项(或实物), 偿还, 报应, 惩罚
v.s: We will make the payment by bank transfer.
v.sz: 我们会用银行转帐付款。
sx: Not being able to carry out payments on time can cause very large losses for the consumer.
不能按时交付货款的话会给客户带来很大损失。

v.t: vt. 进行, 履行, 完成, 执行, 表演 / vi. 行动, 工作, 执行, 演出
v.s: Most teams perform better when they have a home game.
v.sz: 很多球队在主场都会踢得更好。
sx: Sami had Layla perform oral sex on him.
萨米让莱拉帮他口交。
Mark performed in front of people.
马克在众人面前表演。

v.t: adv. 相对地, 比较地, 相当地, 相关地
v.s: The exam was relatively easy.
v.sz: 这次考试比较容易。

v.t: n. 扇形, 部门, 部分, 函数尺, 象限仪, 段, 区段 / vt. 把...分成扇形
v.s: Algeria needs to train its public sector employees on new technologies, communication skills, and customer service.
v.sz: 阿尔及利亚需要对其公共部门员工进行新技术、沟通技巧和客服方面的培训。

v.t: n. 雪, 积雪, 下雪, 雪花形干扰 / vi. 下雪, 似雪般落下 / vt. 使雪白, 用雪覆盖, 使像雪般落下
v.s: I wonder if it will snow in our town this winter.
v.sz: 我想知道这个冬天在我们的城市会不会下雪。
sx: There is a lot of snow on the roof.
房顶上有很多雪。
We had a lot of snow last year.
去年下了很多雪。

v.t: n. 暴风雨, 骚动, 风波, 风暴, 猛攻 / vi. 起风, 猛冲, 怒吼 / vt. 猛攻
v.s: The plane was unable to take off due to the storm.
v.sz: 由于暴风雨的关系，飞机没能起飞。
sx: We had to stay home because of the storm.
因为暴风雨的关系，所以我们必须待在家里。
After the storm, the sea was quiet again.
暴风雨后，大海恢复了平静。

v.t: n. 罢工, 打击, 殴打 / vt. 打, 撞击, 冲击, 侵袭, 取消, 结算, 打掉, 罢工, 刺透, 使生根, 遇见 / vi. 打, 打击, 抓, 罢工, 搏动, 触礁, 敲, 响, 穿透, 打动
v.s: Strike while the iron is hot.
v.sz: 打铁趁热。
sx: There is a strike.
有罢工。
We are on strike.
我们在罢工。

v.t: n. 工作室, 画室, 演播室, 电影制片厂
a. 不牢固的, 弱的, 虚弱的, 软弱的, 无力的, 无权力的, (论据等)不充分的
v.s: The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.
v.sz: 心有余而力不足。
sx: The weak are food for the strong.
弱肉强食。
She is weak by nature.
她天生体弱。

v.t: n. 男演员, 行动者
v.s: Do you want to be an actor in a movie?
v.sz: 你想成为一名电影演员吗？
sx: To tell the truth, that actor is married.
其实那个演员已经结婚了。
He is not a singer, but an actor.
他不是歌手，但是个演员。

v.t: n. 前进, 进展, 行过的路程 / vi. 前进, 进展, 提高, 上涨 / vt. 使前进, 促进, 提出, 提高, 使提前, 预付 / a. 前面的, 预先的
v.s: The military power of this country is very advanced.
v.sz: 这个国家的军事力量很先进。
sx: Thank you in advance for your cooperation.
提前感谢你们的合作。
You should pay your rent in advance.
你应该提前付租金。

v.t: n. 房间, 公寓
v.s: I live in an apartment in the city.
v.sz: 我住在城市中的一间公寓里。
sx: My apartment is located within five minutes' walk of the station.
我住的公寓距离车站步行不到五分钟。
Does the apartment have a garden?
公寓有花园吗？

v.t: n. 链, 枷锁, 束缚 / vt. 用铁练锁住, 束缚, 囚禁
v.s: The proletarians lose nothing in this revolution but their chains.
v.sz: 无产者在这个革命中失去的只是锁链。
sx: We want to develop a new supply chain with a supplier from Algeria.
我们想和一个阿尔及利亚的供应商一起打造一条新的供应链。
For example, if a chain-smoking teacher cautions a pupil for smoking, that warning is self-contradictory.
举例说，如果一个老师警告学生不要吸烟，但自己却每天吸个不停，那么这个警告就是自相矛盾的了。

v.t: n. 章, 篇, 重要章节
v.s: We will deal with this problem in Chapter Three.
v.sz: 我们在第三章讨论这个问题。
sx: Let's begin with the first chapter.
从第一章开始吧。
Read chapter five.
请读第五章。

v.t: n. 信心
v.s: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.
v.sz: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。
sx: Where did all that self-confidence come from?
哪来那么大的自信啊？
He has little confidence in himself.
他对自己没有多少信心。

v.t: n. 厨子, 厨师 / vt. 烹调, 煮饭, 加热 / vi. 在煮着
v.s: Because my mother is sick, my father will cook today.
v.sz: 母亲病了，所以今天由父亲下厨。
sx: Before now I had no idea that you could cook so well.
我以前还真不知道你做饭这么好。
Could you cook this meat a little more?
你能多烧一点这个肉吗?

v.t: a. 可爱的, 聪明的, 伶俐的
v.s: Did any cute girl try to chat you up at the bar?
v.sz: 在酒吧有没有美女找你搭讪？
sx: I remember him as a cute, bright little boy.
我印象中的他是个可爱聪明的小男孩。
Do you think this thing is cute?
你觉得这个东西萌吗？

v.t: n. 对手, 匹敌, 同辈 / a. 相等的, 平等的, 胜任的, 合适的, 平静的, 不相上下的 / vt. 等于, 比得上
v.s: Do you think that he is equal to the task?
v.sz: 你认为他能够胜任这个任务吗?
sx: He was equal to the job.
他胜任这份工作。
Is she equal to a long journey?
她受得了长途旅行吗？

v.t: n. 财政, 财务 / vt. 供给...经费, 负担经费 / vi. 筹措资金
v.s: He claimed to be an expert in finance.
v.sz: 他自称为金融专家。
sx: The museum had to close due to lack of finances.
博物馆资金不足，只好关门。

v.t: n. 身份, 相同, 一致, 特性, 恒等式
v.s: A student should not lose sight of his own identity.
v.sz: 学生不该忽略自己的身份。
sx: Sir, please present your passport or identity card, so I can register it.
先生，请出示护照或者身份证，让我登记一下。
Is a common European identity possible?
欧洲人统一有可能吗？

v.t: n. 旅程, 旅行, 行程 / vi. 旅行 / vt. 游历
v.s: I want to go on a journey around the world if possible.
v.sz: 如果可能的话我想去世界各地旅行。
sx: Is she equal to a long journey?
她受得了长途旅行吗？
After a long journey we finally arrived.
经过漫长的旅程,我们终于到了.

v.t: n. 厨房, 全套炊具
v.s: She is neither in the kitchen nor in the living room.
v.sz: 她不在厨房里，也不在客厅里。
sx: Is there any coffee in the kitchen?
厨房里有咖啡吗？
My mother is busy in the kitchen.
我的母亲在厨房里正忙著。

v.t: vt. 维持, 维修, 保持, 坚持, 供养, 主张
v.s: She maintains that her analysis is correct.
v.sz: 她坚持自己的分析是正确的。
sx: Maintain rational thought.
保持理性的思维。
Tom maintained his innocence.
汤姆童心未泯。

v.t: n. 尺寸, 量度器, 量度标准, 测量, 量具, 程度, 范围, 限度, 分寸, 措施, 方法 / vt. 测量, 测度, 估量, 权衡, 调节, 拿(自己或自己的力量等)作较量 / vi. 度量
v.s: This measure is in accord with our policy.
v.sz: 这个议案合符我们的政策内容。
sx: The government will adopt enforcement measures to solve this problem.
政府将采取强制措施来解决这一问题。
Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。

v.t: a. 很多的, 数目众多的, 多数的
v.s: Richard Roberts is the author of numerous books.
v.sz: 理察·罗伯茨是很多本书的作者。
sx: They are too numerous to enumerate.
他们人太多了，数不过来。
Tom had numerous girlfriends.
Tom有很多女友。

v.t: n. 安静, 闲适, 平静 / a. 安静的, 静止的, 寂静的, 朴素的, 从容的, 暗中的 / vi. 平静下来 / vt. 使平静, 使平息, 使安心, 安慰
v.s: I want to live in a quiet city where the air is clean.
v.sz: 我想在一个宁静、没有空气污染的城镇里生活。
sx: Is there a quiet corner in here where I can study?
这儿有没有比较安静的地方我可以学习的？
As long as you keep quiet, you can stay here.
只要你保持安静, 你可以留在这里。

v.t: adv. 特定地, 明确地, 按特性
v.s: The first time he came to Taipei, he specifically wanted to go shopping in Ximending.
v.sz: 他第一次来台北，就指名要去西门町逛街。

v.t: n. 劈开, 裂片, 裂缝, 分裂, 派系, 派别, 柳条 / a. 劈开的 / vi. 分离, 分开, 裂开, 被劈开 / vt. 劈开, 切开, 使分裂, 使分离
v.s: Your turn to split!
v.sz: 到你切了!
sx: A sharp crack of thunder split the sky.
一道闪电划破天空。

v.t: n. 工作, 任务, 作业, 困难的工作 / vt. 派给...工作, 使辛劳
v.s: We will all work together to finish this task on time.
v.sz: 我们大家会一起努力地把这项任务按时完成的。
sx: I must go through the task by tomorrow.
我必须在明天之前完成任务。
To rule a country is no easy task.
统治一个国家不是一件简单的工作。

v.t: a. 都市的, 住在都市的, 习惯于都市的
v.s: What are the characteristics of this new type of urban life?
v.sz: 这种新型的城市生活有什么特点？
sx: Traffic is a major urban problem.
交通是都市的一个主要问题。
More and more people are moving to urban areas.
越来越多的人迁往市区。

v.t: n. 航空器, 飞机
v.s: China has the means to destroy your aircraft carriers.
v.sz: 中国有能力摧毁你们的航空母舰。

v.t: n. 争论, 论证, 论据, 自变量
v.s: It was an argument of little substance.
v.sz: 这是一场没有实质内容的争论。
sx: My comment sparked off an argument in the group.
我的评论引起了小组内的争论。
After a long argument, I finally persuaded her to go camping.
经过长久的争论，我终于说服了她去露营。

v.t: n. 战斗, 冲突, 矛盾, 争执 / vi. 争执, 战斗, 冲突, 抵触
v.s: He seems not to be aware of the conflict between my father and me.
v.sz: 他似乎不知道我父亲和我之间的纠葛。
sx: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.
在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。
I've never believed that conflict is good.
我从来没有相信过战争是好的。

v.t: n. 辩论, 讨论 / v. 争论, 辩论
v.s: It was an interesting debate.
v.sz: 这是场有趣的辩论。
sx: I believe that the debate should be carried on.
我认为辩论该继续进行。
He organized a classroom debate on current events.
他组织了一场关于时事的课堂辩论。

v.t: a. 坚决的, 已下决心的
v.s: The meaning of a word is determined by the context where it is used.
v.sz: 一个字的意思是由上文下理决定的。
sx: I am determined to carry out this plan.
我决心要推行这个计划。
He is determined to succeed at any price.
他执意不惜一切代价获得成功。

v.t: n. 分配
v.s: Ubuntu is a popular Linux distribution.
v.sz: Ubuntu是一个流行的Linux发行版。

v.t: n. 逃亡, 避难设备, 逃跑 / vi. 逃脱, 避开, 溜走 / vt. 逃避, 避免, 被...忘掉
v.s: To escape the storm, we took shelter in a nearby barn.
v.sz: 为躲避风暴，我们躲到了附近的一个谷仓内。
sx: Each time he escaped, he returned to this region.
他每次逃跑都回到这个地区。
His attempt to escape was successful.
他尝试逃走而成功了。

v.t: n. 过错, 故障, 毛病 / vt. 挑剔 / vi. 产生断层, 弄错
v.s: He is constantly finding fault with other people.
v.sz: 他总是挑别人的毛病。
sx: No matter how many faults there are, our achievements are the main thing.
不管缺点怎么多，成绩还是最主要的。
I cannot help loving her in spite of her many faults.
虽然她有许多缺点，但我却情不自禁地爱著她。

v.t: vt. 装满, 填充, 弥漫, 供给, 满足, 供应 / vi. 充满, 变得沉重 / n. 满足, 装满, 充分, 填方 / vt. 填充 / vi. 填充
v.s: Be sure to fill out the registration form in person.
v.sz: 确保亲自填写注册表格。
sx: Please help me fill out this form.
请帮我填这张表格。
Please fill in this application form.
请填好这张申请表。

v.t: a. 友好的, 亲切的, 互助的 / adv. 友善地, 温和地
v.s: Several classic, family-friendly games will also join the service next month.
v.sz: 多款经典家庭游戏也将于下个月同步上架。
sx: That man, the child of whom is very friendly.
那个男人，就是他的孩子很友好的那个.
People like him because he is friendly.
人们喜欢他，因为他很友善。

v.t: vt. 放置, 产, 铺设, 布置, 提出, 平息 / vi. 下蛋, 打赌 / n. 位置, 层, 隐藏处 / a. 世俗的, 外行的 / lie的过去式
v.s: A brilliant future lay before him.
v.sz: 大好的前途摆在他面前。
sx: A beautiful lake lay just beyond the forest.
森林外有一个美丽的湖泊。
She will lay the doll on her bed.
她会把娃娃放到她的床上。

v.t: a. 混合的, 形形色色的, 弄糊涂的
v.s: I mixed them up again!
v.sz: 我又把它们混淆了！
sx: I think you are mixed race, because you look a bit Chinese.
我以为你是混血，因为有点像中国人。
He spoke with a Taiwanese accent mixed in.
他说话夹杂著台湾口音。

v.t: n. 时期, 局面, 方面, 位相, 相, 阶段 / vt. 使调整相位, 使定相, 使一致, 逐步执行, 实行
v.s: The first phase of construction has been completed.
v.sz: 工程的第一阶段已经完成了。
sx: Cancer can be cured easily if it is found in its first phase.
癌症如果在第一阶段被发现的话是很容易治愈的。
In an almanac you can find information about the phases of the moon.
你可以在年鉴中找到月相的资讯。

v.t: adv. 适当地, 相当地
v.s: Can you please properly study a foreign language?
v.sz: 你能不能好好读外语？
sx: The door is not closed properly.
门没有关好。
If you feed your dog properly, you can increase his lifespan.
合理地喂狗可以延长宠物寿命。

v.t: a. 纯的, 纯净的, 纯洁的, 清白的, 完美的, 无瑕的, 抽象的
v.s: The sample is not pure enough.
v.sz: 样本不够纯净。
sx: Is that pure gold?
那是纯金吗？
Europeans drink, on average, 12.5 liters of pure alcohol per year.
欧洲人每年平均饮用十二点五公升的纯酒精。

v.t: n. 收入, 岁入, 税收, 税务局
v.s: Many websites are supported by revenue from advertising.
v.sz: 许多网站都是靠广告收入来维持的。

v.t: a. 无虑的, 安心的, 安全的, 可靠的, 保险的 / vt. 固定, 获得, 保证, 使安全, 掩护, 招致 / vi. 停止操作, 船抛锚
v.s: I feel secure with him.
v.sz: 我和他在一起时很有安全感。
sx: The bank secured the city from a flood.
堤坝保护了城市免受洪灾。

v.t: n. 微笑, 喜色, 笑容 / vi. 微笑, 觉得好笑 / vt. 微笑着表示
v.s: Whenever I hear this song, I think of his smile.
v.sz: 只要听到这首歌，我就会想起他们的笑容。
sx: I would swim through the ocean just to see your smile again.
我愿穿洋过海只为再看到你的笑容。
He had a smile on his face.
他面带笑容。

v.t: a. 奇怪的, 陌生的, 生疏的, 不熟悉的, 不可思议的, 外行的, 外地的, 异乡的
v.s: Did you pick up on that strange tone in his voice?
v.sz: 你有没有发现他说话的语气有点古怪？
sx: The orange left a strange taste in my mouth.
橙子在我嘴里留下了一种奇怪的味道。
Strange to say, no one voted for the candidate.
奇怪的是，谁也没有投那候选人一票。

v.t: n. 天才, 才能, 有才干的人, 天资
v.s: As well as this, the horse is also representative of human talent.
v.sz: 除此之外，马还是人才的代名词。
sx: We believe he will succeed, for he has talent.
他是个有才能的人，我们相信他会成功。
She is very proud of her talent.
她对自己的才能很自豪。

v.t: n. 温度, 发烧, 热度
v.s: There is a large temperature difference between day and night during this period of time.
v.sz: 这段时间昼夜温差很大。
sx: There was a sudden drop in the temperature last night.
昨天晚上气温突然下降
The temperature at the North Pole is different from at the South Pole.
北极与南极的温度不一样。

v.t: n. 卡车, 货车, 对...进行交易, 来往, 实物工资, (供应市场的)蔬菜, 废物, 废话 / vt. 对...进行交易, 交往, 以卡车运输 / vi. 驾驶卡车, 以物易物
v.s: A dog was run over by a truck.
v.sz: 一条狗被卡车碾过。
sx: The truck almost hit me.
卡车差一点撞到我。
A truck was standing in the middle of the road.
路中间有一辆卡车。

v.t: adv. 基本上, 主要地
v.s: Basically, I agree with your opinion.
v.sz: 基本上我赞同你的意见。
sx: Sometimes I find that I basically have no time to pay attention to irrelevant trivia.
有时候发现自己基本上没有时间顾及一些无关紧要的琐事。
From what I understand, those who watch Korean soap operas basically are women with nothing to do.
我了解的情况是看韩剧者基本上是一些无所事事的女人。

v.t: n. 鸟, 羽毛球 / vi. 打鸟
v.s: If I were a bird, I could fly to you.
v.sz: 如果我是一只小鸟，我就可以飞到你的身边了。
sx: A bird is known by its note, and a man by his talk.
听其声而知其鸟，闻其声而知其人。
A real friend is like a rare bird.
知己难求。

v.t: n. 过失, 责备 / vt. 责备, 归咎于
v.s: None of us thought he was to blame for the accident.
v.sz: 我们都不认为他是事故的罪魁祸首。
sx: It is you that are to blame for it.
责任应该由你来负。
Don’t you try and blame this on him.
你少把一切都推到他头上。

v.t: n. 碗, 木球, 大酒杯 / v. 滚木球, 快而稳地行驶
v.s: Do you have a soup bowl?
v.sz: 你有碗盛汤吗？
sx: Don't fill up your bowl with too much food.
饭勿要盛得满得很。
A wooden bowl.
一个木头碗。

v.t: n. 小鸡, 鸡肉
v.s: We had some chicken soup.
v.sz: 我们喝了些鸡汤。
sx: I had chicken pox when I was a kid.
我小时候发水痘。
The child has a case of chicken pox.
这孩子有水痘的症状。

v.t: n. 上下文, 背景, 来龙去脉 / n. 上下文
v.s: Get the meaning of a word from its context.
v.sz: 从前文后理来推断一个字的意思。
sx: The meaning of a word is determined by the context where it is used.
一个字的意思是由上文下理决定的。
No context, no text.
没有上下文就没有词义。

v.t: v. 决定, 决心
v.s: The meaning of a word is determined by the context where it is used.
v.sz: 一个字的意思是由上文下理决定的。
sx: I am determined to carry out this plan.
我决心要推行这个计划。
He is determined to succeed at any price.
他执意不惜一切代价获得成功。

v.t: n. 显示, 陈列, 炫耀, 显示器 / vt. 陈列, 显示, 表现, 夸示
v.s: A variety of books are displayed there.
v.sz: 那里展示着各种各样的书。
sx: What's wrong with this projector? It won't display anything.
这个投影仪怎么了？什么都放不出来。
The sidebar is displayed on the edge of the page below the site logo.
侧边栏显示在网站标志下方的页面边缘。

v.t: a. 富有经验的, 老练的, 熟练的
v.s: We have experienced many changes over the last decade.
v.sz: 我们最近十年经历了很多变化。
sx: Have you experienced the night life here?
你过过这里的夜生活吗？
He was experienced in business.
他有做生意的经验。

v.t: a. 错误的, 虚伪的, 假的, 不老实的 / adv. 不准确地, 欺诈地
v.s: The truth is that nothing is totally true or false.
v.sz: 真相是没有甚么完全正确或错误。
sx: Health is more important than wealth. Is this statement true? Or is it false?
健康比财富重要。这句话是对呢 ? 或是错呢 ?
Do you think her story is false?
你觉得她在说谎吗？

v.t: a. 难以置信的
v.s: This matter is of incredible urgency!
v.sz: 这件事十万火急！
sx: Friday evening was incredible.
周五晚上真是太棒了。

v.t: n. 肉, 餐, 食物
v.s: If you want to keep meat for long, freeze it.
v.sz: 如果你想把肉类保存久一点，就要把它们放进冰箱里冷藏。
sx: There is only one can of meat left.
只剩下一罐肉了。
Could you cook this meat a little more?
你能多烧一点这个肉吗?

v.t: n. 部, 内阁, 服务
n. 模态, 调式, 样式, 文体, 状态, 方式, 风尚
v.s: This program cannot be run in DOS mode.
v.sz: 这个程式无法在DOS模式下执行。

v.t: n. 脖子, 衣领, 颈 / vi. 拥抱, 拥吻, 收缩 / vt. 割颈
v.s: He has a long neck.
v.sz: 他的脖子很长。
sx: I got up today with a pain in my neck.
我今天起床的时候脖子很痛。
The girl had a long scarf around her neck.
女孩的脖子上围著一条长长的围巾。

v.t: n. 小说, 长篇故事 / a. 新奇的, 异常的
v.s: This chapter is the heart of the novel.
v.sz: 这个章节是这部小说的核心。
sx: That was the most interesting novel that I had ever read.
这是我所读过的最有趣的小说。
This novel is more interesting than the one I read last week.
这本小说比我上周看的那本有意思。

v.t: a. 明显的, 明白的, 显然的, 平淡无奇的
v.s: That she is ill is obvious.
v.sz: 显然地她生病了。
sx: Most scientific breakthroughs are nothing else than the discovery of the obvious.
多数科学突破只不过是发现了显而易见的事。
His failure is obvious.
他的失败是显而易见的。

v.s: There were few students remaining in the classroom.
v.sz: 教室里没剩下几个学生了。

v.t: n. 衬衫, 内衣, 汗衫
v.s: I want a new shirt. What do you want?
v.sz: 我要一件新衬衫。你想要什么？
sx: This T-shirt is too small for me.
这件T恤太小了。
He had his shirt on inside out.
他把他的衬衫穿反了。

v.t: adv. 慢慢地, 迟缓地
v.s: Could you please speak a little bit more slowly?
v.sz: 能否请你说慢一点?
sx: Would you speak more slowly, please?
你可以说慢一点吗？
Please drive the car more slowly.
请开车开慢一点。

v.t: n. 外科, 手术, 手术室, 换球术
v.s: I developed a tumor in my stomach, which required surgery.
v.sz: 我得了胃肿瘤，必须动手术切除。
sx: Surgery is the best solution.
手术是最佳解决方案。
Do I need surgery?
我需要做手术吗？

v.t: n. 视觉, 眼光, 视力, 幻想 / vt. 梦见, 想象, 显示
v.s: Please check my vision.
v.sz: 请验验我的视力。
sx: Possible side effects include blurred vision and shortness of breath.
可能会引起视力模糊、呼吸急促等副作用。
My vision is getting worse these days.
这些天我的视力正在变差。

v.t: conj. 每当 / adv. 不论何时, 每逢
v.s: Dinner is ready, so we can eat whenever we want.
v.sz: 晚餐已经准备好了，我们可以随时开始吃。
sx: You will find him home whenever you call.
你甚么时候去，他也会在家。
So annoying... Now I get a headache whenever I use the computer!
好烦……现在我只要一用电脑就会头痛！

v.t: a. 担心的, 闷闷不乐的
v.s: She was worried that she might be late for the train.
v.sz: 她担心她赶不上火车。
sx: I am not the least bit worried.
我一点也不担心。
We are worried about grandpa and grandma.
我们担心着外公和外婆。

v.t: n. 冠军, 拥护者, 战士 / vt. 保卫, 拥护 / a. 优胜的
v.s: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
v.sz: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。

v.t: n. 危机, 危险期, 紧要关头
v.s: In a crisis, you must get in touch with your teacher.
v.sz: 在危险的时候你必须跟你的老师联系。
sx: Algeria is in the midst of a political crisis.
阿尔及利亚正处于政治危机中。
Our current crisis is no mere economic crisis.
我们当前的危机绝非单纯的经济危机。

v.t: n. 编者, 编辑, 主笔, 编辑器, 编辑装置
v.s: You don't want to be an editor?
v.sz: 你不想做编辑？

v.t: n. 巨人, 大力士, 巨大怪物 / a. 庞大的, 巨大的
v.s: The giant panda is a surviving ancient animal species.
v.sz: 大熊猫是一种残存的古动物。
sx: The giant creature pushed the tree over.
巨大的生物把树推倒了。`
Seen from the sky, this river looks like a giant snake.
从天上看下来，这条河像一条巨蛇。

v.t: n. 文学, 文艺, 著作
v.s: Give a lecture on literature.
v.sz: 做一次文学讲座。
sx: You should memorize a piece of classical literature every day.
你必须每天背一篇古典文献。
He is already skilled in both math and literature.
他既精于数学又精于文学。

v.t: n. 未成年人, 副修科目 / a. 较小的, 二流的, 未成年的 / vi. 副修
v.s: Can you play the key of C minor?
v.sz: 你能用C小调演奏吗？
sx: A couple of flights were delayed on account of a minor accident.
因为一些小事故，两、三班机被延迟了。
She's still a minor.
她还未成年。

v.t: a. 相对的, 相反的, 对面的 / prep. 对面 / n. 对立面
v.s: The original sentence means the opposite.
v.sz: 意义的原句是相反。
sx: You say one thing and then act just the opposite.
你说一套做一套。
He is honest and hard-working, but his brother is the exact opposite.
他既诚实又勤劳，而他的弟弟正好相反。

v.t: n. 柑橘, 桔子, 橘色 / a. 橘色的
v.s: The earth is similar to an orange in shape.
v.sz: 地球的外形和橙子相似。
sx: Paint our house. Use the orange paint.
油漆我们的房子。使用橙色的油漆。
There is an orange on the table.
桌上有一只橙子。

v.t: pron. 我们自己
v.s: Hence, we have to take care of ourselves.
v.sz: 因此，我们必须自己照顾自己。
sx: How will we protect ourselves?
我们怎么保护自己？
Our biggest enemy may not be someone else, but ourselves.
我们最大的敌人不是别人，可能是自己。

v.t: n. 选择, 选文, 精选品
v.s: My mother prefers the arbitrary selection of the lottery machines over my lucky numbers.
v.sz: 我母亲宁愿选彩票机上的任意数字，也不选我的幸运数字。

v.t: n. 信号, 暗号, 近因, 导火线 / vt. 向...作信号, 标志, 用信号通知 / vi. 发信号 / a. 作为信号的, 显著的
v.s: An increase in customer complaints could signal a decline in business.
v.sz: 顾客投诉量增加，可能代表生意正在走下坡。
sx: The signal was red.
信号是红色的。
Catch a signal.
收到一个信号。

v.t: n. 水流, 小河, 流出, 趋势, 人潮 / vt. 流出, 流动, 展开 / vi. 流, 涌, 飘扬
v.s: It must be dangerous to swim in this rapid stream.
v.sz: 在这么急的急流里游泳，一定会很危险的。
sx: I just had an unexpected stream of consciousness.
我刚刚脑中突然迸发一股意识流。
Behind his house is a stream so clear that you can see the bottom of it.
他家后面有小溪，清可见底。

v.t: n. 斗争, 努力, 奋斗 / vi. 努力, 奋斗, 挣扎
v.s: The injured bird struggled with all its might on the grass.
v.sz: 那只受伤的小鸟在草地上尽力挣扎。
sx: I struggle for my family.
我为我家人奋斗。
In a struggle of power, if you aren't with us, you're against us.
在权利斗争中，非友即敌。

v.t: n. 主题, 话题, 题目
v.s: What is the theme of his latest novel?
v.sz: 他最后一本小说的主题是什么？
sx: Is this an anime theme song?
这首曲子，是动漫主题曲吗？
The principal theme of the book is the American Revolution.
这本书的主题是美国革命。

v.t: a. 很少的, 微小的
v.s: Tiny particles in the air can cause cancer.
v.sz: 空气中的微粒可以引发癌症。
sx: It's a tiny country that most people have never heard of.
那是一个许多人连听也没有听过的小国。
That tiny star there is the brightest out of all the stars.
那儿的小星星是所有星星里最亮的。

v.t: adv. 恐怕, 不幸的是
v.s: Unfortunately I was not in time for his speech.
v.sz: 很不幸，我没来得及听他的演讲。
sx: Unfortunately, the telephone was out of order.
不幸的是电话坏了。
Unfortunately, these beautiful words are not mine.
不幸的是，这些美丽的词不是我写的。

v.t: a. 平常的, 通常的
v.s: He put the key on the desk as usual.
v.sz: 他跟平时一样把钥匙放在书桌上。
sx: Bill was late for school as usual.
比尔一如往常上学迟到。
At lunchtime today, our usual restaurant was closed because of a funeral in the family.
今天午餐时间，我们常去的饭馆关门了，因为他们家在办丧事。

v.t: n. 波, 波浪, 波动, 起伏, 高潮, 潮涌, 挥手致意, (气压)突变 / vi. 波动, 飘动, 挥手示意, 起伏 / vt. 使波动, 使飘扬, 挥舞, 使成波浪形
v.s: A cold wave of fear hit me like a brick.
v.sz: 一阵寒意像砖头一样击中了我。
sx: Who is that girl waving to you?
那个向你招手的女孩是谁？
There are no waves without wind.
无风不起浪。

v.t: n. 酒精, 酒
v.s: What kind of alcohol do you like to drink?
v.sz: 你为什么不喜欢喝酒？
sx: Alcohol consumption is higher in Eastern Europe than in Western Europe.
东欧的酒精消耗量比西欧高。
Do you drink alcohol every day?
你每天都喝酒吗？

v.t: n. 早餐
v.s: I do not like tea, so I generally drink coffee for breakfast.
v.sz: 我不喜欢茶，所以我早餐大致上都喝咖啡。
sx: I am hungry because I did not eat breakfast.
我没吃早餐，所以肚子很饿。
We just have enough time to eat breakfast.
我们刚好有时间吃早饭。

v.t: a. 明亮的, 聪明的, 鲜明的, 欢快的 / adv. 明亮地, 欢快地
v.s: The minute I have something to drink, I turn bright red.
v.sz: 我一喝了酒就立刻变得通红。
sx: I remember him as a cute, bright little boy.
我印象中的他是个可爱聪明的小男孩。
His victory at this age in an international competition is a good indication of a bright future.
他现在这个年纪，就已经在国际比赛中取胜，前途实在无可限量。

v.t: a. 有能力的, 能的, 能干的
v.s: I never thought he was capable of doing something so cruel.
v.sz: 我从来没想到他能做到那么残忍的事。
sx: It's only the most capable who do the work.
能者多劳。
The baby is not capable of walking yet.
这个婴儿还没有学会走路。

v.t: n. 组合, 合并, 联合
v.s: Here you can see beautiful colour combinations.
v.sz: 这里你可以看到漂亮的颜色组合。
sx: Jazz fusion is a combination of rock and jazz.
融合爵士是摇滚乐与爵士乐的融合。
Cottage cheese and canned peaches are a delicious combination.
干酪加桃子罐头是美味的搭配。

v.t: n. 消费者
v.s: I want to ensure my phone has good customer support.
v.sz: 我想要确定手机能有优秀的客户服务。
sx: If you would like to speak to a customer service representative, please press three.
如果想与客服代表通话，请按三。
Carlos is an employee who is committed to providing excellent customer service.
卡洛斯是一位致力于提供优质客服业务的员工。

v.t: n. 欲望, 要求 / vt. 想要, 请求 / vi. 渴望
v.s: Desire for food and sex is part of human nature.
v.sz: 食色性也（孔子）。
sx: The basic job of an advertising agency is to figure out how to turn a desire into a need.
广告商最基本的工作就是把人的欲望转化成需要。
Follow your desire.
你想要的是最重要的。

v.t: n. 气流, 草稿, 汇票, 草案 / vt. 起草, 征兵
v.s: I am writing a draft of the speech.
v.sz: 我在写演讲的草稿。
sx: We don't sell draft beer.
我们不卖生啤酒。

v.t: a. 喝醉了的 / drink的过去式
v.s: I admit, at that time I was a little drunk.
v.sz: 我承认当时是有点醉。
sx: He must have drunk too much last night.
他昨晚一定是喝多了。
He drunk wine, so he is slightly drunk.
他喝了酒，略有醉意。

v.t: n. 要素, 要点, 本质 / a. 必要的, 重要的, 本质的
v.s: Memory is an essential function of our brain.
v.sz: 记忆是我们大脑的一种主要功能。
sx: In the depths of winter, a hot-water bottle is essential.
在寒冷的冬天，热水袋是必不可少的。
The camera was essential for me.
摄像机对我而言是必需品。

v.t: vi. 失败, 缺乏, 中断, 衰退, 失灵 / vt. 忘记, 使...失望, 缺乏, 不及格 / n. 不及格
v.s: Such a plan is bound to fail.
v.sz: 这样的计划注定会失败的。
sx: The friend who I thought would pass the exam failed it.
那个我认为会通过考试的朋友失败了。
My memory failed me. I just could not remember his name.
我的记性不好。我简直不记得他的名字了。

v.t: a. 熟悉的, 常见的, 亲密的 / n. 熟友, 常客
v.s: Is that an area you are familiar with?
v.sz: 你熟悉这个领域吗？
sx: All of you are familiar with the truth of the story.
你们所有的人都熟悉这个故事的真相。
Your face is familiar to me.
我对你的脸很熟悉。

v.t: a. 犯罪的, 有过失的, 自觉有错的, 心虚的
v.s: Nobody can deny that the prisoner is guilty.
v.sz: 人们不能否认犯人是有罪的。
sx: You make me feel so guilty.
你让我感到很内疚。
If he is innocent, it follows that his wife is guilty.
如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。

v.t: adv. 大量地, 很多地, 大半地
v.s: The taste of wine is largely dependent upon the weather.
v.sz: 葡萄酒的味道很受天气影响。

v.t: n. 媒体, 方法, 媒介 / a. 半生熟的, 中间的
v.s: I believe the medium size will fit you better.
v.sz: 我认为中号会更适合您。
sx: Medium-rare and a potato, please.
麻烦牛排三分熟和一份马铃薯。
You only need a medium size.
您只要中号就够了。

v.t: adv. 完全地, 无瑕疵地, 完整地
v.s: Your conduct is perfectly legal.
v.sz: 你的行为完全合法。
sx: All that you say is perfectly correct.
你说得完全正确。
Tatoeba is back, but not everything will be working perfectly.
Tatoeba 恢复开放，但有些部分可能会出现异常。

v.t: vt. 推荐, 介绍, 劝告, 使受欢迎, 托付
v.s: Could you recommend a nice restaurant near here?
v.sz: 你可以介绍一间附近的好餐厅吗？
sx: What would you recommend we eat?
有没有甚么好菜推介？
What do you recommend to me?
你有什么推荐？

v.t: a. 有关联的, 有关系的, 适当的, 相应的
v.s: I thought his opinion was relevant.
v.sz: 我认为他的意见很中肯。
sx: That would be relevant.
那可能有关系。
Do you have an objection to the source, or a relevant piece of evidence to refute the claim?
你是对来源有异议，还是有相关的证据可以反驳这个说法呢？

v.t: vt. 寻求, 寻找, 探索, 追求, 搜索, 请求 / vi. 寻找, 搜索
v.s: You need to seek help.
v.sz: 你需要寻求协助。
sx: Let's play hide-and-seek!
来玩捉迷藏吧！
They went out to Australia seeking gold.
他们为了找到黄金而前往澳大利亚。

v.t: n. 票, 券, 车票, 标签, 入场券, 证明书 / vt. 加标签于, 为...购票
v.s: Where can I buy an entrance ticket?
v.sz: 我在哪里可以买到门票？
sx: How did you get the free ticket for the car show?
你怎么拿到车展的免费门票的?
To purchase a ticket, you need to enter your personal details.
你要先输入好个人资料，然后才能买票。

v.t: a. 不能的, 不会的
v.s: I am sorry, we are unable to satisfy your demand.
v.sz: 对不起，我们无法满足您的要求。
sx: We were unable to make contact with them until it was too late.
我们联系上他们已经为时已晚。
I was unable to complete the task.
我无法完成这个任务。

v.t: a. 弄翻的, 混乱的, 心烦的 / vt. 弄翻, 颠覆, 推翻, 打乱, 使不适, 使心烦 / vi. 翻倒
v.s: Because my stomach was upset, I took a day off school.
v.sz: 因为肚子不舒服， 我请了一天假不去学校。
sx: She acknowledged she was upset.
她承认她很苦恼。
She is upset.
她心情不好。

v.t: n. 翅膀, 翼, 机翼, 派别 / vt. 给...装上翼, 飞过, 使飞, 空运, 增加...速度 / vi. 飞行
v.s: The plane lost part of its wing.
v.sz: 飞机失去了一部分机翼。
sx: That bird can fly very fast thanks to its huge wings.
那只鸟凭借自己巨大的翅膀能飞得很快。
I found a bird whose wing was severely damaged.
我发现了一只翅膀受了重伤的鸟儿。

v.t: n. 炸弹 / vt. 轰炸, 投弹于 / vi. 失败
v.s: This bomb can kill a lot of people.
v.sz: 这个炸弹可以炸死很多人。
sx: The atomic bomb is the offspring of 20th century physics.
原子弹是二十世纪物理学的产物。
A big bomb fell, and a great many people lost their lives.
大炸弹从天而降，夺走了许多人的生命。

v.t: a. 有创造力的, 创作的, 产生的
v.s: I don't know how long I'll have to wait before I become more creative.
v.sz: 不知道要等多长时间，我的创作能力才能进步。
sx: Tom has a lot of creative ideas.
汤姆有很多有创意的主意。
In WHAT THE CAR?, you play as a car with legs, racing through absurdly creative levels.
在《WHAT THE CAR?》中，您将操纵长著腿的汽车，在离谱又富有创意的关卡中赛跑。

v.t: n. 周期, 循环, 自行车, 一段时间, 整套 / vi. 循环, 轮转, 骑自行车 / vt. 使循环, 使轮转
v.s: Usually I cycle or get the bus to work.
v.sz: 我通常骑自行车或乘公交车去上班。
sx: I cycle to work.
我骑车去工作。
We all like cycling.
我们都喜欢骑自行车。

v.t: a. 教育的, 教育性的
v.s: He proposed a reform in the educational system.
v.sz: 他提议对教育系统进行改革。
sx: Some people say that cartoons on television are educational in themselves.
有人说电视上的卡通本身是有教育意义的。
It is essential that every child have the same educational opportunities.
每一个孩子都应该享有平等的学习机会。

v.t: n. 娱乐, 款待, 娱乐表演
v.s: She is reading one entertainment magazine.
v.sz: 她在看一本娱乐杂志。
sx: The latest entertainment magazine has many Korean influences.
最近的娱乐杂志上很多有关韩流的内容。

v.t: n. 极端, 末端 / a. 极端的, 尽头的, 极度的, 偏激的
v.s: Those who love too much, hate in like extreme.
v.sz: 爱得深，恨得也深。
sx: Your proposal is a bit extreme.
你的建议有点极端。
He holds an extreme opinion on education.
关于教育，他持极端意见。

v.t: n. 容易, 灵巧, 设备
n. 货物
v.s: You can come pick up the goods, or we can bring them to you.
v.sz: 你可以来提货，我们也可以把商品送到您那里。
sx: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
大量生产降低许多商品的价格。
They confirmed to me that there weren't any goods left.
他们向我保证没有任何物品剩下。

v.t: n. 悬挂, 诀窍, 意义 / vt. 悬挂, 附着, 装饰, 垂下, 踌躇, 绞死, 使悬而未决 / vi. 悬着, 垂下, 被绞死, 悬而不决
v.s: Hang on. The ambulance will get here in just a little bit.
v.sz: 挺住。救护车马上就来了。
sx: Hang on, I need to go to the bathroom.
等一下，我得去趟洗手间。
Who did you hang out with last weekend?
你上周末跟谁闲逛了？

v.t: adv. 主要地, 大抵
v.s: The bat's diet consists mainly of insects and fruit.
v.sz: 蝙蝠的食物主要包括昆虫和水果。
sx: Scientists deal mainly with physical matters.
科学家处理大多数物理的事物。
That company deals mainly in imported goods.
这公司主要做进口货物的生意。

v.t: n. 极点, 最大量, 极大 / a. 最高的, 最大的, 最大极限的
v.s: This truck has a maximum load of 5 tons.
v.sz: 这辆卡车最大的载重量是5吨。
sx: Note that the maximum doesn't always exist.
注意，最大值不总是存在的。
Mark your maximum efforts.
尽力而为。

v.t: n. 报纸
v.s: This newspaper is well known in the local area.
v.sz: 这家报社在当地知名度颇高。
sx: A magazine can tell more about a story than a newspaper.
杂志比报纸报导得更深入。
Some people read the newspaper and watch TV at the same time.
有些人边看电视边读报纸。

v.t: n. 画, 绘画, 油漆
v.s: This painting is worth a great deal of money.
v.sz: 这幅画值很多钱。
sx: Tom will be painting the fence tomorrow.
Tom明天将漆栅栏。
The value of the painting was estimated at several million dollars.
这幅画被估价数百万元。

v.t: n. 共和国, 共和政体, 团体, 界
v.s: After the revolution, France became a republic.
v.sz: 革命之后，法国成为了一个共和国。
sx: The Federal Republic of Germany was established in 1949.
德意志联邦共和国建立于1949年。
Do you want Catalonia to become an independent state in the form of a republic?
你希望加泰罗尼亚成为共和国形式的独立国家吗？

v.t: n. 储备品, 贮量, 后备军, 自然保护区, 保留, 拘谨, 节制, 储备金 / vt. 保留, 保存, 预订, 延期, 推迟
v.s: What room would you like to reserve?
v.sz: 您想订什么房间？
sx: I'd like to reserve a room in a hotel.
我想要订房。
Can I reserve a seat to Hawaii for Christmas?
我能不能够订一个圣诞节时去夏威夷的位子?

v.t: n. 排, 行, 街道, 划船, 吵闹 / vt. 使成排, 划, 划船, 参加(赛船), 痛骂 / vi. 划船, 划动, 争吵
v.s: We rowed up the river against the current.
v.sz: 我们在河里划著船逆流而上。
sx: There is no difference between this row of clothes and the one next to it.
旁边一排衣服跟这里的衣服没什么不一样。
A beautiful woman was seated one row in front of me.
一个美丽的女人坐在我前面一排。

v.t: n. 盐, 风趣, 刺激 / a. 含盐的, 咸的, 风趣的, 辛辣的 / vt. 加盐于, 用盐腌
v.s: Limit the consumption of white sugar and salt.
v.sz: 限制白糖和盐的摄取量。
sx: Will you pass me the salt?
请你把盐递给我好吗？
Would you pass the salt, please?
请你把盐递过来好吗？

v.t: a. 害怕的, 担惊受怕的, 惊慌的, 吓坏了的
v.s: I was scared to be alone in the dark.
v.sz: 我害怕一个人处在黑暗之中。
sx: One should not be scared of poverty, and instead, be determined amidst it.
人不要怕穷，要穷中立志.
He was scared you would shoot him.
他害怕你会开枪打他。

v.t: n. 开关, 电闸, 转换, 软枝, 鞭子, 道岔 / vt. 转变, 切换, 摆动, 转换, 使转轨 / vi. 转换, 变换, 摆动
v.s: I was hot, so I switched on the fan.
v.sz: 我很热，就把电风扇打开了。
sx: This device is actuated by a switch.
这个装置是用开关启动的。
You can just switch channels.
那么你频道换掉也行啊。

v.t: n. 领土, 领地, 版图, 地区, 活动范围
v.s: China's territory is vast, thus the types of tea vary.
v.sz: 中国幅员辽阔,因而茶的品种繁多。
sx: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.
军队占领了整片领土。
A perfect map would have to be as big as the territory it represents.
一个完美的地图必须要像它所代表的领土一样大。

v.t: n. 恐吓, 恶兆, 威胁
v.s: Air pollution will be a threat to our survival.
v.sz: 空气污染将会威胁我们的生存。
sx: The threat to Richmond was ended.
对里士满的威胁结束了。

v.t: vt. 影响, 感动, 假装, 模仿, 爱好, 倾向于 / n. 自觉感情
v.s: An increase in the number of cars will affect the urban environment.
v.sz: 车辆增多会影响到城市的环境。
sx: The schedule is only slightly affected by this delay.
日程表只受到了这次延误的轻微影响。
The bad weather affected his health.
恶劣的天气对他的健康带来了影响。

v.t: a. 有扶手的, 武装的, 有防卫器官的
v.s: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.
v.sz: 军队占领了整片领土。
sx: They armed themselves with guns.
他们用枪武装自己。
He's armed to the teeth.
他武装到牙齿。

v.t: n. 小声说的话, 旁白 / adv. 在一边, 离开, 另外
v.s: But you know, I have nothing aside from this.
v.sz: 但你知道，我除了这些以外一无所有！
sx: She pulled me aside.
她把我拉到一边。
Joking aside, how are things going?
言归正传，事情进展得怎么样了？

v.t: n. 协助, 援助
v.s: Thank you for your assistance.
v.sz: 谢谢你帮忙。
sx: We need assistance.
我们需要帮助。

v.t: n. 铃, 钟
v.s: In case of fire, ring the bell.
v.sz: 万一发生火灾，按铃。
sx: Press the bell twice.
按两下铃。
He came in, and at the same time the bell rang.
他进来的同时，铃响了。

v.t: n. 吹, 打击, 殴打, 花开 / v. 吹, 风吹, 吹响, 开花
v.s: Everything will blow over eventually.
v.sz: 一切最终都会过去。
sx: The tree was felled with one hard blow of his ax.
他用斧头重重的斩了一下，那棵树就倒了下来。
Blow out all the candles on the birthday cake at once.
一口气吹灭生日蛋糕上所有的蜡烛。

v.t: n. 男朋友
v.s: My boyfriend and I had sex on the first date.
v.sz: 我和男友第一次约会就发生了性关系。
sx: She and her boyfriend live together.
她跟她男朋友一起住。
Do you have a steady boyfriend?
你有一个固定的男朋友吗？

v.t: a. 小心的, 谨慎的
v.s: You must be careful of the traffic when you cross the street.
v.sz: 你横穿马路要小心。
sx: Be careful not to fall.
小心别摔倒了。
You should be more careful with what you speak about.
你应该更注意你说的话。

v.t: n. 叫声, 哭声, 大叫 / vi. 哭, 叫, 喊 / vt. 叫喊, 大声说, 哭出
v.s: My income is a far cry from his.
v.sz: 我的工资比他少多了。
sx: For what reason did you cry?
你为什么哭了？
Why did you cry so much?
你为甚么哭得这么厉害？

v.t: n. 危险, 威胁
v.s: The old bridge is in danger of collapse.
v.sz: 那座老桥正面临坍塌的危险。
sx: He is aware of the danger.
他意识到他面临危险。
Red, as opposed to green, is a sign of danger.
红色，相对于绿色，是危险的标志。

v.t: n. 递送, 交付, 分娩, 交货, 引渡
v.s: This electrical device must have been damaged during delivery.
v.sz: 这个电子仪器肯定在运输途中损坏了。
sx: I have missed the delivery time, what should I do next?
已经错过了交货时间了，接来下该怎么办？

v.t: vt. 该得到, 值得 / vi. 应得报答
v.s: This point deserves special emphasis.
v.sz: 这个论点值得强调。
sx: They deserve it.
这是他们应得的。
He deserves six of the best for being so rude.
他这样粗鲁，该棒打几下。

v.t: n. 美元, 元(加、澳等国货币单位)
v.s: Do you have change for a dollar?
v.sz: 你有零钱换一元美金吗？
sx: The value of the painting was estimated at several million dollars.
这幅画被估价数百万元。
Do you think you can live on a dollar a day in America?
你觉得你在美国每天只用一美元能生活吗？

v.t: a. 空的, 空虚的, 空腹的, 空洞的 / n. 空的东西, 空车 / vt. 倒空, 使变空, 使排出 / vi. 流空
v.s: You should especially not drink on an empty stomach.
v.sz: 你尤其不该空腹喝酒。
sx: The battery of my MP3-player was empty.
我MP3播放器的电池没电了。
Life is but an empty dream.
人生不过是一场空梦。

v.t: n. 建议, 情况, 例子, 场合 / vt. 引以为例, 举例说明
n. 英里, 很大距离
v.s: My house is only a mile from here.
v.sz: 我的家离这里只有一英里。
sx: This river is one mile across.
这条河宽一英里。
The train is going at a speed of 50 miles per hour.
火车以每小时50英里的速度前行。

v.t: n. 移动, 手势, 动作, 意向, 请求, 提议 / v. 打手势
v.s: My father motioned for me to leave the meeting room.
v.sz: 我父亲示意我离开会议室。
sx: They showed the scene in slow motion.
他们用慢动作把那一幕播了出来。
I motioned for her to sit down.
我对她做了一个手势，叫她坐下。

v.t: n. 奖赏, 奖金, 奖品, 战利品, 捕获 / a. 得奖的 / vt. 珍视, 估价, 捕获, 撬, 撬动
v.s: The grand prize is a kiss from the princess.
v.sz: 一等奖是公主的香吻。
sx: You deserve the prize.
你应该得到这个奖金。
Tom's hope was to win first prize.
汤姆希望赢得第一名。

v.t: a. 合理的, 明理的, 适当的
v.s: You should be more reasonable.
v.sz: 你应该更明智一点。
sx: It's reasonable that you should do that.
你那样做是合理的。
Tom bought this camera for a reasonable price.
Tom用合理的价格买了相机。

v.t: n. 寄存器, 记录, 登记簿, 注册 / vt. 记录, 注册, 提示, 表达, 把...挂号 / vi. 登记, 注册, 挂号
v.s: Should I register for that class?
v.sz: 我应该登记这堂课吗？
sx: No person by that name is listed in the register of the school.
学校的名册里没有这个名字的人。
Sir, please present your passport or identity card, so I can register it.
先生，请出示护照或者身份证，让我登记一下。

v.t: n. 解析, 决心, 坚定, 决定, 决议, 消除, 解答, 分解 / n. 图形分辨率
v.s: The image quality is really bad - the resolution is so low.
v.sz: 画质真的很差 - 分辨率那么低。
sx: My resolution dissolved at the last moment.
到了最后的一刻，我的决心突然动摇了。
Did you make any New Year's resolutions?
你有没有许下什么新年愿望？

v.t: a. 乡下的, 田园的, 乡村风味的
v.s: It seems the rural area will be developed on a large scale.
v.sz: 农村好像要大规模发展了。
sx: Asia has many rural villages.
亚洲有许多乡村。
As figures from the National Development and Reform Committee show, the Internet has developed rapidly in rural China.
来自国家发展和改革委员会的数据显示，互联网在中国农村地区发展迅猛。

v.t: n. 存款, 挽救, 节约 / a. 搭救的, 节约的, 保留的, 补偿的 / prep. 除...之外
v.s: They are saving their money for the purchase of a house.
v.sz: 他们在储钱买房子。
sx: I am saving money in order to study abroad.
我正存钱出国留学。
His parents are saving for his college education.
他的父母为他的大学教育存钱。

v.t: a. 典型的, 象征性的
v.s: I find that it's typical for him to come too late.
v.sz: 我发现他就是会很晚才来这样的人。
sx: They are typical young people.
他们是典型的年轻人。
This is typical.
这是典型的。

v.t: n. 宇宙, 星系, (思想等)范围
v.s: Our world is only a small part of the universe.
v.sz: 我们的世界只不过是宇宙的一小部分。
sx: What is the origin of the universe?
宇宙何以开端？
There's no doubt that the universe is infinite.
宇宙毫无疑问是无限的。

v.t: n. 警告, 预告, 预兆, 通知
v.s: I warned him, but he ignored the warning.
v.sz: 我警告过他，但他不理会警告。
sx: He ignored all of our warnings.
他不顾我们的一再劝告。
She ignored all my warnings.
她忽视了我所有的警告。

v.t: vt. 承认, 接受, 允许进入, 容许 / vi. 开向, 容许, 承认
v.s: I admit this may not be the best way of doing it.
v.sz: 我承认这可能不是最好的方法。
sx: I admit, at that time I was a little drunk.
我承认当时是有点醉。
You are honest to admit your mistake.
你很诚实地承认了你的错误。

v.t: n. 态度, 看法, 姿势
v.s: I hope to improve my attitude to work.
v.sz: 我希望改进自己的工作态度。
sx: You can't fight a good fight with such a defeatist attitude.
抱著失败主义的态度你无法打一场漂亮的仗。
My attitude towards him changed.
我对他的态度变了。

v.t: n. 树枝, 支店, 支流, 分部 / vi. 分支, 出枝 / vt. 分割, 用枝状叶脉刺绣花纹装饰
v.s: The lamp was suspended from the branch of a tree.
v.sz: 灯笼在树枝上吊着。
sx: I cut a branch from the tree.
我从树上砍下了一根树枝。
Our branches extend all over the country.
我们的分店布满全国。

v.t: n. 定义, 精确度, 清晰度
v.s: My camera can shoot high-definition video.
v.sz: 我的录像机可以拍高清视频。
sx: What do you think of this word's definition?
你怎么看待这个词的定义？
To give a definition of a word is more difficult than to give an illustration of its usage.
要为一个字下定义比为字的用法举例更困难。

v.t: n. 图画, 制图, 拉
v.s: Thank you for drawing a bird for me.
v.sz: 谢谢你为我画鸟。
sx: I am poor at drawing.
我不擅长画画。
He is drawing a picture.
他正在画一幅画。

v.t: n. 框, 结构, 体格 / vt. 构成, 设计, 制定, 使适合, 陷害
v.s: This picture frame can make the picture rise in value.
v.sz: 这个画框能让画升值。
sx: The frame is worth more than the painting.
画框比画还值钱。
The entire frame is made of iron.
整个框架由铁金属制成。

v.t: n. 客人, 来宾, 旅客
v.s: Many Chinese people make good guests, especially those from rural areas.
v.sz: 大多数中国人是非常好客的，尤其是住在农村的人。
sx: She was the last guest.
她是最后一个客人。
He should apologize for being rude to the guests.
他应该为自己对客人的粗鲁无礼而道歉。

v.t: n. 天堂, 上帝, 天空
v.s: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
v.sz: 起初，神创造了天地。
sx: How can I get to heaven?
我要怎么上天堂？
But Tatoeba Project is not a word heaven. Please stop adding words.
但是Tatoeba专案不是文字天堂，请不要再加文字了。

v.t: n. 独立, 自立, 自主
v.s: Operation Yoav was a military operation carried out by Israel in its war for independence.
v.sz: 约阿夫行动是以色列独立战争中的一次作战行动。
sx: The US declared independence from Great Britain in 1776.
美利坚合众国于1776年宣布其独立于大不列颠王国。
Our people thirst for independence.
我们的人民渴望独立。

v.t: n. 吻 / vt. 吻 / vi. 接吻
v.s: The grand prize is a kiss from the princess.
v.sz: 一等奖是公主的香吻。
sx: I want to kiss you.
我想亲吻你。
You owe me a kiss.
你欠我一个吻。

v.t: n. 负荷, 担子, 重担, 装载量, 负载, 工作量, 加载 / vt. 装载, 装填, 使担负 / vi. 装货, 上客, 装料
v.s: This truck has a maximum load of 5 tons.
v.sz: 这辆卡车最大的载重量是5吨。
sx: The load of the truck was in excess of three tons.
货车的载货量超过了三吨。
All these new blocks will undoubtedly impact the loading speed of the home page.
这些新模块毫无疑问会影响主页的加载速度。

v.t: n. 小块土地, 地区图, 图, 阴谋, 情节 / vt. 划分, 绘图, 密谋 / vi. 密谋, 策划
v.s: They accused him of being part of the plot.
v.sz: 人们指控他参与了这场阴谋。

v.t: n. 可能性, 可能的事
v.s: He has investigated the possibility of cooperation.
v.sz: 他调查了两方合作的可能性。
sx: The possibility of a lack of connection between the events can be dismissed immediately.
可以立即排除事件之间缺乏关联的可能性
There is not much possibility of his coming on time.
他十有八九不会准时来。

v.t: n. 恢复, 复原, 痊愈, 重获
v.s: You have to be patient about your recovery.
v.sz: 你必须对你的康复有耐心。
sx: I wish you a speedy recovery!
祝你早日痊愈!

v.t: n. 租金, 房租, 出租物, 裂缝, 破裂处, 分裂 / vt. 租用, 租出 / vi. 出租 / a. 分裂的, 破裂的 / rend的过去式和过去分词
v.s: You have to give three months' rent as a deposit.
v.sz: 你必须付三个月的房租作为押金。
sx: The rent can be a bit expensive, but something nearby would be best.
租金贵一点儿没关系，近一些最好。
How much is the rent for one month?
一个月的租金多少？

v.t: vt. 代替, 替换, 放回, 归还
v.s: Because of the problem of air pollution, the bicycle may some day replace the automobile.
v.sz: 因为空气污染的问题，也许有一天自行车会取代汽车。
sx: He left to replace his father.
他代替他的父亲去。
I want to replace him.
我想代替他。

v.t: vt. 表现, 表示, 描绘, 讲述, 代表, 象征, 回忆, 再赠送, 再上演 / vi. 提出异议
v.s: The red lines on the map represent a railway.
v.sz: 地图上的红线代表铁路。
sx: He represented our company at the conference.
他代表我们公司出席了会议。
A perfect map would have to be as big as the territory it represents.
一个完美的地图必须要像它所代表的领土一样大。

v.t: n. 句子, 命题, 宣判 / vt. 宣判, 判决
v.s: Will you please explain the meaning of this sentence to me?
v.sz: 您能为我解释这句句子的意思吗？
sx: The original sentence means the opposite.
意义的原句是相反。
Can you give me another sentence to translate?
你再出个句子让我翻译翻译，好吗？

v.t: a. 学院的, 学术的, 不切实际的 / n. 大学生, 大学教师, 学者, 学会会员
v.s: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.
v.sz: 学术造假比你想象的普遍。
sx: Schoolwork, cultural work and academic work should all be promoted together.
学生工作、文化工作和学术工作应该同时推进。

v.t: a. 正确的, 精确的
v.s: Most important of all a clock has to be accurate.
v.sz: 一个时钟最重要的是准确。
sx: My watch is very accurate.
我的手表很准。
It's not your mother tongue, so your pronunciation will never be accurate.
因为它不是你的母语，你的发音会永远不准。

v.t: vt. 完成, 达到 / vi. 如愿以偿
v.s: In my view, studying hard is the best way to achieve success.
v.sz: 对我来说，努力学习就是最好取得成功的办法。
sx: How do you plan to achieve the goals you set?
你们准备如何达到你们制定的目标？
This company achieved a remarkable increase in turnover last year.
这家公司去年获得显著的营业额增长。

v.t: vt. 买得起, 足以, 给予
v.s: This car was so cheap that he could afford it.
v.sz: 这车便宜得让他能买得起。
sx: I could not afford to buy a bicycle.
我买不起自行车。
How can you afford a place like this?
我们怎么付得起这种地方的钱？

v.t: vt. 假定, 承担, 呈现 / vi. 装腔作势, 僭越
v.s: I assume that you wouldn't want to do that.
v.sz: 我想你不会那么做的吧。
sx: Let's assume this is correct for now.
我们姑且认为它是对的。
I assumed she was his girlfriend.
我以为她是他的女朋友。

v.t: n. 瓶子, 酒瓶 / vt. 装瓶, 抑制, 围困
v.s: In the depths of winter, a hot-water bottle is essential.
v.sz: 在寒冷的冬天，热水袋是必不可少的。
sx: There is no water left in the bottle.
瓶子里面已经没有水了。
She has a bottle of milk every morning.
她每天早上都会喝一瓶牛奶。

v.t: n. 串, 束
v.s: He dropped a bunch of hard tasks on me.
v.sz: 他把那么难做的活儿丢给我。
sx: A bunch of nonsense!
一派胡言！
The young man saved the girl from a bunch of hoodlums.
该名青年将少女从流氓团伙中救了出来。

v.t: n. 种类, 类项
v.s: You need to create two new categories.
v.sz: 需新建两个分类。
sx: A special feature of verbs in the Russian language is the presence of the category of aspect.
俄语动词的一个特征是存在体的范畴。

v.t: n. 闲谈 / vi. 闲谈, 聊天
v.s: Did any cute girl try to chat you up at the bar?
v.sz: 在酒吧有没有美女找你搭讪？
sx: We had a chat for a while.
我们聊了一会儿。
I had a nice chat with her.
我和她聊得很愉快。

v.t: n. 乳酪
v.s: Would you like a bit of chocolate cheese?
v.sz: 想吃一点巧克力奶酪吗？
sx: I want to eat the cheese.
我想吃奶酪。
Do you want some chocolate cheese?
想吃一点巧克力奶酪吗？

v.t: n. 化学药品 / a. 化学的, 化学上用的
v.s: The chemical formula for water is H-O-H.
v.sz: 水的化学式为H-O-H。
sx: This trash bag does not contain any dangerous chemicals.
这个垃圾袋不含任何有害化学物质。
Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。

v.t: a. 竞争的
v.s: Japan is highly competitive in high technology industries.
v.sz: 日本在高科技产业方面的竞争力很强。
sx: Having a competitive mentality can give rise to negative emotions.
攀比心理会让人产生负面情绪。
Sometimes hockey players get so competitive that fights break out.
有时候冰球运动员相互挑衅得太厉害以至于会引发斗殴。

v.t: n. 细节, 详情 / vt. 详述, 选派 / vi. 画详图
v.s: Please tell me in complete detail what occurred, when and where.
v.sz: 请给我统统说清楚什么时候在哪里发生了什么事。
sx: He described the incident in detail.
他详细地描述了事故状况。
I want more detailed information.
我要更多详细的讯息。

v.t: n. 日常饮食, 议会 / vt. 照规定饮食 / vi. 忌食
v.s: Between you and me, the fat ugly man is on a diet.
v.sz: 那个丑男人在节食，这个我们知道就好。
sx: Do I have to change my diet?
我要改变我的饮食吗？
Have you been keeping up a normal diet since the last shot of insulin?
你最后一次注射胰岛素之后有正常饮食吗？

v.t: n. 喜欢的事物 / a. 喜爱的, 宠爱的
v.s: My favourite musical instrument is the electric guitar.
v.sz: 我最喜欢的乐器是电吉他。
sx: This is my favourite project.
这是我最喜欢的项目。
Spring is my favourite season.
春天是我最喜爱的季节。

v.t: n. 水果, 果类, 结果
v.s: I love passion fruit juice.
v.sz: 我爱百香果汁。
sx: Would you all like to drink fruit juice or water?
各位想喝果汁还是水？
Please go to the supermarket to buy some fruit.
请你去超市买些水果来。

v.t: n. 索引, 指针, 指数, 指标 / vt. 编入索引中, 指出 / vi. 做索引
v.s: The application allows you to quickly calculate the ratio of body mass index - BMI.
v.sz: 这项应用程序能让你快速计算身高体重指数（BMI）。

v.t: n. 项目, 条款, 一则, 项
v.s: Did you check all the items on the shopping list?
v.sz: 你把购物单上的全都检查过了吗？
sx: I always buy expensive items on credit.
我买贵的东西时总是赊帐。
If I do not get the item this week, I will make a complaint to PayPal.
如果本周我收不到货，我就向paypal投诉。

v.t: n. 小路, 巷, 弄, 单行道
v.s: Hi, I need a taxi to come to the entrance of No.40, Lane 200, Huashan Road right now.
v.sz: 喂，我要一辆的士，现在就到华山路200弄40号门口。
sx: Leaves lay thick in the lane.
小路上舖满了落叶。
Are there any bike lanes in Algiers?
阿尔及尔有自行车道吗？

v.t: n. 食堂, 伙食, 用膳, 一份食品, 混乱, 乱七八糟, 困境 / vt. 将...弄糟, 妨碍, 使紊乱, 使就餐 / vi. 陷入困境, 搞乱, 用膳
v.s: My room is a mess. I need to tidy it up.
v.sz: 我的房间很乱。我必须把它弄整齐。
sx: If you make a mess, clean it up.
如果你弄乱了，你来打扫。
How do I get out of this mess?
我怎么才能摆脱这种困境？

v.t: adv. 正规地, 合规则, 正常地
v.s: Normally I take the bus to school.
v.sz: 我通常会坐公交车上学。
sx: What do you do normally?
你平时做些什么？
A sentence normally has a subject and a verb.
句子通常有主词和动词。

v.t: n. 反对, 敌对, 相反, 在野党
v.s: The manager shouted out to his players to mark the opposition.
v.sz: 教练对自己的球员大喊，让他盯守对方球员。
sx: The opposition formed a line in the box to try and block Messi from scoring.
对方球员在禁区内组成一道防线，试图阻截梅西的射门。

v.t: n. 父母, 父母亲, 根源
v.s: Please keep your language decent while my parents are here.
v.sz: 我父母在的时候，请你言语注意分寸。
sx: Parents often sacrifice themselves to ensure that their children receive a good education.
父母为了确保孩子受到良好的教育常常牺牲自己。
A parent or teacher should bring home to children the pleasure of reading.
家长或老师应该让孩子们享受阅读的乐趣。

v.t: a. 永久的, 不变的, 固定的, 持久的 / n. 烫发
v.s: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.
v.sz: 正式工比临时工要好。
sx: Form is temporary, class is permanent.
形式是暂时的，等级才是永恒的。
Please give me your permanent address.
请给我你的永久地址。

v.t: adv. 亲自地, 个别地, 当面, 就本人而言, 针对个人地
v.s: I will personally visit you.
v.sz: 我会亲自拜访你。
sx: James Cameron personally did the official promotion!
卡神亲自官宣！

v.t: n. 快乐, 愉快, 令人高兴的事, 娱乐, 希望 / v. (使)高兴
v.s: It is a pleasure to watch a baseball game on TV.
v.sz: 在电视上看棒球比赛是一件乐事。
sx: Some people pursue only pleasure.
有些人只追求快乐。
Did you go abroad for pleasure or on business?
你去国外是玩儿还是出差？

v.t: vt. 宁可, 较喜欢, 提出
v.s: Which do you prefer, spring or autumn?
v.sz: 春天和秋天，你更喜欢哪个？
sx: Do you prefer the blue one or the red one?
你喜欢蓝色的还是红色的？
I prefer to take the train rather than the bus.
与乘公交车相比，我更喜欢乘火车。

v.t: n. 节目, 节目单, 程序, 纲要, 大纲, 计划 / vt. 规划, 拟...计划 / vi. 安排节目, 编程序
v.s: New programmes will appear in the fall on television.
v.sz: 秋季将有新节目在电视上出现。
sx: What programming language does everybody like?
大家都喜欢什么编程语言？
The programme is over.
节目已经完了。

v.t: n. 代表, 众议员, 典型 / a. 描写的, 表现的, 代理的, 代表的, 代议制的, 典型的
v.s: As well as this, the horse is also representative of human talent.
v.sz: 除此之外，马还是人才的代名词。
sx: If you would like to speak to a customer service representative, please press three.
如果想与客服代表通话，请按三。
He attended the meeting as the company representative.
他代表我们公司出席了会议。

v.t: n. 方案, 计划, 组合, 系统, 图解, 诡计, 阴谋 / v. 计划, 设计, 图谋, 策划
v.s: Your help is indispensable for the success of the scheme.
v.sz: 没有你帮忙，计划就不能成功了。
sx: He carried out the scheme faithfully.
他忠实地实行了该计划。

v.t: n. 变化, 移动, 轮班, 手段, 应急办法, 移位 / vt. 替换, 转移, 改变, 推卸, 变速 / vi. 转换, 移动, 转变, 推托, 变速
v.s: Tom is working the night shift.
v.sz: 汤姆上夜班。

v.t: n. 存储器, 储藏, 保管, 库存, 仓库
v.s: My phone needs to have enough storage for my apps.
v.sz: 我的手机需要足够存储空间来下载 App。

v.t: n. 槽, 箱, 柜, 罐, 池塘, 储水池, 坦克 / vt. 储于箱中
v.s: The fuel tank in the car is full.
v.sz: 汽车油箱是满的。
sx: The tank vanished.
坦克失踪了。

v.t: vi. 走向, 有某种的倾向, 易于, 照顾, 注意 / vt. 照料, 护理
v.s: People living in a big city tend to lack exercise.
v.sz: 住在大城市的人们一般都缺乏锻炼。
sx: People tend to look at others with bias.
人们趋向于带着偏见看待他人。
Young people tend to take things too far.
青年人总爱挑战极端。

v.t: a. 紧的, 密封的, 吝啬的, 严厉的 / adv. 紧紧地
v.s: This jacket is a tight fit.
v.sz: 这夹克很合身。
sx: A tent with a floor and a zipper is bug tight.
有垫布与拉链的帐篷可以做到防虫密闭。
Sleep tight, Sean.
肖恩，安稳睡啊。

v.t: n. 运输, 输送, 交通车辆
v.s: The transportation in this city is very convenient.
v.sz: 这个城市的交通方便得很。
sx: This hotel is conveniently located in terms of public transportation.
这间酒店的交通位置很方便。

v.t: adv. 最后, 最终
v.s: Her line of reasoning is attractive, but ultimately fallacious.
v.sz: 她说理的主线引人注目，但从根本上是靠不住的。

v.t: a. 不像的, 不同的 / prep. 不像, 和...不同
v.s: It's unlike him to get so angry.
v.sz: 这么生气不像他。
sx: The two brothers are quite unlike in their appearance.
哥哥和弟弟的样子一点也不像。
The crane, unlike the dog, has never dreamed of flying.
不像狗, 这只鹤从来没有梦想过飞翔。

v.t: n. 周刊, 周报 / a. 每周的, 一周一次的, 周刊的 / adv. 每周, 一周一次
v.s: I log into Tatoeba weekly.
v.sz: 我每周登录 tatoeba 一次。
sx: My dad gives me a weekly allowance that I use to buy comics and ice cream.
我爸爸每周给我零用钱，我会用来买漫画书和冰激凌。

v.t: n. 码, 庭院, 工场
v.s: My house has a small yard.
v.sz: 我的房子有一个小院子。
sx: There is a fence marking the boundary between our yard and the neighbor's.
我家和邻居家以院子之间的篱笆为分界线。
Give him an inch and he'll take a yard.
得寸进尺。

v.t: pron. 任何人 / n. 重要人物
v.s: She can sing better than anybody else in her class.
v.sz: 她唱歌唱得比班上任何一个人好。
sx: Is there anybody who can drive a car?
有人会开车吗？
Anybody may participate.
谁都可以参加。

v.t: n. 钮扣, 按钮 / vi. 扣住 / vt. 钉钮扣于, 扣紧
v.s: In case of fire, break the glass and push the red button.
v.sz: 万一发生火灾，打碎玻璃并按下红色按钮。
sx: Press this red button in case of an accident.
发生意外的话按这个红按钮。
If you press this button the window opens automatically.
按下这个按钮, 窗口会自动打开。

v.t: n. 消费者
v.s: In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
v.sz: 一般来说，消费者喜欢数量胜于质量。
sx: Europeans are the largest consumers of alcohol in the world.
欧洲人是世界上最大的酒精消费者。
The company welcomes feedback from consumers who use their products.
公司欢迎消费者对他们产品的反馈

v.t: n. 计算器, 计算者, 柜台, 筹码 / a. 反方向的, 相反的 / adv. 反方向地, 相反地
v.s: On which counter can I make my appointment?
v.sz: 我可以在哪个柜台预约?
sx: Where is the information counter?
询问处在哪里？
Please pay at this counter.
请在这个柜位付款。

v.t: n. 创造, 创作物, 发明
v.s: Love is what gives joy to all creation.
v.sz: 爱把喜悦带给所有的生命。
sx: The creation of most schools was not to transform society, but to reconstruct society.
大部分学校的创建不是用来转变社会，而是用来重建社会的。

v.t: n. 王冠, 王权, 顶点 / vt. 使成王, 加冕, 居...之顶
v.s: No cross, no crown.
v.sz: 没有困难就没有成功。
sx: The Queen's crown was made of gold.
皇后的后冠是用黄金铸成的。
The girl in the picture is wearing a crown not of gold but of flowers.
画中的女孩头上戴著的是花冠，不是金皇冠。

v.t: n. 不景气, 消沉, 沮丧, 洼地
v.s: She sometimes goes into a mood of depression.
v.sz: 她偶尔有忧郁的心情。
sx: It doesn’t matter what you say, he’ll be acquitted because of depression.
因为他有忧郁症，所以不管你说什么他都会被无罪释放。
During the Depression in the 1930's, many wealthy people lost everything in the stock market crash.
在十九世纪三十年代的大萧条时期，许多富人在股市崩盘中失去了一切。

v.t: vt. 描述, 描绘, 画
v.s: Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?
v.sz: 你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？
sx: Can you describe the situation you were in?
你可以描述一下当时的处境吗？
He described the incident in detail.
他详细地描述了事故状况。

v.t: n. 雇用, 职业, 工作
v.s: The employment policy is a failure.
v.sz: 工作政策是个失败。

v.t: vt. 原谅, 申辩, 做为...的托辞 / n. 致歉, 理由, 饶恕, 借口
v.s: Excuse me, do you know where the economics department library is?
v.sz: 不好意思，请问你知道经济学部图书馆在哪里吗？
sx: Even if I grant that what you say is true, it is no excuse.
即使我承认你说的是真的，但这并不是借口。
Excuse me, do you know what time it is?
不好意思，请问您知道现在几点了吗？

v.t: n. 专家, 行家 / a. 老练的, 内行的, 专门的
v.s: Concerning this word, each expert has a different point of view.
v.sz: 对这个词，专家们各有不同的看法。
sx: Only an expert can tell them apart.
只有专家能区分出它们的不同。
He is an expert at fishing.
他是个钓鱼专家。

v.t: adv. 频繁, 经常地
v.s: How frequently do you check your mail?
v.sz: 你多久看一次邮箱？
sx: The fact that television frequently limits communication within families is already well known.
电视限制家庭成员的沟通的事实已经广为人知。
I have a friend who frequently travels without a ticket.
我有一个经常不带票旅行的朋友。

v.t: n. 高尔夫球 / vi. 打高尔夫球
v.s: My son wants to become a professional golf player.
v.sz: 我的儿子想成为一个专业高尔夫球手。
sx: Is there a golf course near here?
这里附近有没有高尔夫球场？
My mother can play golf very well.
我妈妈高尔夫打得很好。

v.t: adv. 有希望地, 如果希望能实现的话
v.s: To travel hopefully is a better thing than to arrive.
v.sz: 带著希望旅行比达到目的地更为美好。
sx: Hopefully, we can all stay healthy.
希望我们都能保持健康。
Hopefully you'll comply with traffic regulations after this.
希望你们以后严格遵守交通规则。

v.t: vt. 识别, 认为...等同于, 确定, 使参与 / vi. 一致, 认同
v.s: You can identify children's voices without any problem.
v.sz: 你可以毫无问题地辨别孩子们的声音。
sx: She identified him as the murderer.
她确认他是杀人凶手。
They identified the risk factors.
他们确认了风险因素。

v.t: n. 重要, 重要性, 重要地位, 自大
v.s: Some day you will come to realize the importance of saving.
v.sz: 你现在不好好储蓄金钱的话，终有一天会后悔的。
sx: The problem is that the money is not of such importance as the time.
问题在于，金钱没有时间那样重要。
He placed emphasis on the importance of education.
他强调了教育的重要性。

v.t: a. 后者的, 较后的, 近来的
v.s: Practice is as important as theory, but we are apt to value the latter and despise the former.
v.sz: 实践和理论同样重要，但我们倾向于重视后者而忽略前者。
sx: The difference between a standalone sentence and a sentence in the middle of an essay is that the latter has context.
独立的句子和文章中的句子的区别在于后者具备上下文。

v.t: n. 制造业 / a. 制造业的
v.s: We are planning changes to the manufacturing process.
